meta.title: Ponyou 1000 Test Scenarios - Full Internal & Agent Audit

critical_findings.description: Request resolves when respond() is called within timeout window
critical_findings.failureMode: Race condition where respond() is called before _pendingRequests map is populated

critical_findings.description: Pending request map grows when requests are never resolved or timed out (leaked timers)
critical_findings.failureMode: If clearTimeout fails silently, timer keeps Node process alive and callback fires after delete

critical_findings.description: emit() does not await async handlers — fire-and-forget semantics may swallow rejections
critical_findings.failureMode: Critical async processing error in handler goes undetected because emit is fire-and-forget

critical_findings.description: runHealthChecks invokes healthCheck function and records result; catches thrown errors
critical_findings.failureMode: One agent's healthCheck rejection prevents all remaining agents from being checked (no try/catch per agent)

critical_findings.description: LLM API times out on all 3 attempts — error correctly thrown after retries exhausted
critical_findings.failureMode: Retry counter not incremented on timeout, causing infinite retry loop

critical_findings.description: Tool_choice unsupported error triggers fallback from 'required' to 'auto'
critical_findings.failureMode: Tool choice required for safety (e.g., BUY) falls back to auto where LLM may choose no tools

critical_findings.description: swap_token called twice in same step — second call blocked by ONCE_PER_SESSION reservation
critical_findings.failureMode: Race where two swap_token tool calls in same LLM response both check before reservation — double execution

critical_findings.description: selectAgent with safetySensitive=true and non-claude classification escalates to claude
critical_findings.failureMode: safetySensitive=false but risk profile should have escalated — trade executed without review

critical_findings.description: market:update received with DEAD condition triggers emergency_pause on bus
critical_findings.failureMode: Dead market not detected — agents continue trading in zero-liquidity conditions

critical_findings.description: EXTREME market condition triggers emergency_pause with condition='EXTREME'
critical_findings.failureMode: EXTREME condition not in STRATEGY_RULES keys — falls to STRATEGY_RULES.NORMAL and continues trading

critical_findings.description: initProOrchestrator checks isAutomationActive() before setting _proModeActive — blocked if not approved
critical_findings.failureMode: initProOrchestrator runs before automation-state.json is loaded — isAutomationActive reads stale false

critical_findings.description: tryReadJson returns null for all data files — runProAnalysis gracefully populates empty intelligence
critical_findings.failureMode: Code assumes regimeMem.regimes is always an object — Object.entries(null) throws TypeError

critical_findings.description: proBuyDecision requires minConvictionScore=65 — below threshold fails signal convergence
critical_findings.failureMode: conviction_score of 0.65 (float) vs 65 (int) — wrong comparison if score is 0-1 scale

critical_findings.description: proBuyDecision requires 4 converging signals — only 3 pass results in SKIP
critical_findings.failureMode: False positive BUY with only 3 signals — weak conviction trade executed

critical_findings.description: proBuyDecision Kelly signal: should_skip=true overrides effective_fraction — signal not counted
critical_findings.failureMode: Kelly skip flag ignored — trade proceeds despite Kelly deeming it unprofitable

critical_findings.description: proCutlossDecision fast_failure: pnl=-8% in <8 min triggers immediate cut
critical_findings.failureMode: Position drops -7.9% in 7 minutes — misses fast_failure threshold by 0.1%, continues to -15%

critical_findings.description: validateStrategyCandidate with stopLoss > -30% (e.g., -50%) is rejected
critical_findings.failureMode: Strategy with -50% stop-loss approved — potential -50% single trade loss

critical_findings.description: validateStrategyCandidate with positionSize=60% (over 50% max) is rejected
critical_findings.failureMode: Over-concentrated position approved — single trade risk exceeds portfolio safety

critical_findings.description: runAutomationQualification emits 'automation:proposal_ready' when first qualified
critical_findings.failureMode: Proposal not emitted — user never notified that automation is ready for approval

critical_findings.description: approveAutomation fails if not qualified — returns { ok: false, reason }
critical_findings.failureMode: Approval goes through despite not meeting requirements — automation activated prematurely

critical_findings.description: guardAutomatedDecision returns allowed=false with reason when automation NOT active
critical_findings.failureMode: Guard returns allowed=true when automation not active — automated action proceeds without authorization

critical_findings.description: checkAutomationQualification handles completely missing data files gracefully
critical_findings.failureMode: tryReadJson returns null for trades attribution → null.slice(-100) in win rate check throws

critical_findings.description: EXTREME market disables all hunting (active=false, maxTokens=0)
critical_findings.failureMode: EXTREME condition not normalized before lookup; uppercase 'extreme' vs 'EXTREME' mismatch

critical_findings.description: DEAD market condition pauses all hunting (active=false)
critical_findings.failureMode: DEAD fallback to NORMAL if HUNTER_SCHEDULE.DEAD not properly set — continues hunting in dead market

critical_findings.description: hunters:gate_blocked pauses all hunting immediately
critical_findings.failureMode: Gate block could be missed if agentBus subscription fails or handler throws silently

critical_findings.description: DEAD market condition sends hunters:command with active=false
critical_findings.failureMode: Missing fallthrough: if HUNTER_TRIGGER.DEAD is undefined, HUNTER_TRIGGER.NORMAL used instead

critical_findings.description: screening:gate_blocked pauses pipeline and logs reason
critical_findings.failureMode: Silent gate block: if screening:gate_blocked not emitted when gate trips, pipeline continues unsafely

critical_findings.description: runScreeningCycle checks gates before running
critical_findings.failureMode: If _checkAllGates not set (not initialized), code would crash on undefined is not a function

critical_findings.description: _hunterRunning correctly reset in finally block on exception
critical_findings.failureMode: If _hunterRunning is set to true and finally block is somehow skipped (process.exit?), bot stops hunting permanently

critical_findings.description: 25+ KNOWN_SCAM_PATTERNS match across multi-language scam keywords
critical_findings.failureMode: Line 38: Chinese pattern uses specific characters; new variant not in list passes through undetected

critical_findings.description: RugCheck score >= 60 or critical risks >= 1 blocks the token
critical_findings.failureMode: RugCheck API failure (line 224 catch) silently passes the token through without any RugCheck verification

critical_findings.description: All 25+ knowledge bases applied sequentially in filterPreyAdvanced
critical_findings.failureMode: If any step throws unexpectedly, the token processing for that iteration may break (no catch around entire per-token loop)

critical_findings.description: Blacklisted tokens from rug memory are hard-blocked
critical_findings.failureMode: rugMemory is optional — if null/undefined, blacklist check is skipped entirely

critical_findings.description: Blacklisted devs from rug memory block all new tokens from same creator
critical_findings.failureMode: Creator address stored with different case or format in token vs rug memory — string match fails

critical_findings.description: outerShieldScreen flow: RugCheck summary batch -> hard block -> extension check -> trash scoring
critical_findings.failureMode: RugCheck API down: all 4 steps skip, tokens pass through with only trash scoring — no outer shield

critical_findings.description: Token-2022 extension check: freeze authority = instant block
critical_findings.failureMode: RugCheck report format changes — freeze_authority field renamed, check misses it

critical_findings.description: DEAD market: zero sizing, -3% hard stop, no trailing
critical_findings.failureMode: In DEAD market, virtually no trading allowed; -3% stoploss is extremely tight

critical_findings.description: Session drawdown > -15% trips kill switch automatically
critical_findings.failureMode: Transient RPC failure returning usd=0: guard `usd <= 0` at line 116 prevents false trip from 0 reading

critical_findings.description: 3 consecutive swap failures trip the kill switch
critical_findings.failureMode: Network blips causing 3 sequential swap failures trip the kill switch unnecessarily

critical_findings.description: Kill switch survives restart via flag file on disk
critical_findings.failureMode: Flag file in git-managed directory could be cleaned during deploy; state restored via _restoreState from state file

critical_findings.description: 3 rug events in 30-minute window trips circuit breaker for 4 hours
critical_findings.failureMode: Consecutive exits from same token counted as multiple events — a single catastrophic rug may trip breaker

critical_findings.description: initManagementAgent called without runManagementCycle dependency — _runManagementCycle stays null
critical_findings.failureMode: Silent crash or TypeError when downstream code calls runManagementCycle without checking init state

critical_findings.description: handleQuickCommand called with cmd=null from payload.text being null
critical_findings.failureMode: Crash in Telegram handler stops processing for all subsequent messages on that session

critical_findings.description: updateSessionCapital called with currentCapitalUsd = 0 (wallet API returning zero on failure)
critical_findings.failureMode: Without guard, 0 capital would register as -100% P&L, triggering DAILY_STOPLOSS and learning mode

critical_findings.description: updateSessionCapital called with currentCapitalUsd = NaN (computation error in caller)
critical_findings.failureMode: NaN bypass triggers 100% paper loss, corrupting session for rest of day

critical_findings.description: planWalletExecution with mode='sell' and no wallets have position — preferred becomes empty array
critical_findings.failureMode: Empty selected_wallets means sell cannot execute — position stranded with no exit wallet

critical_findings.description: daily_guard_blocked = true — hard skip regardless of token quality
critical_findings.failureMode: Daily guard stays blocked due to stale state (never cleared) — blocks all entries forever

critical_findings.description: circuit_breaker_locked = true — all trading paused, hard skip
critical_findings.failureMode: Circuit breaker lock never releases due to stuck state — permanently blocks all trading

critical_findings.description: learning_mode_active = true — hard skip, no entries during learning analysis
critical_findings.failureMode: Learning mode never auto-disables (e.g., analysis incomplete) — blocks trading indefinitely

critical_findings.description: selectKellyMode with mode3Approved=true but liveTrades=50, winRate=1.0, conviction=0.99, semanticMemory=200 — all thresholds met
critical_findings.failureMode: Mode3 requires winRate >= 1.00 (100%) — impossible to achieve; effectively unreachable

critical_findings.description: normalizeRate with value > 1 (e.g., 85 for 85% stored as percentage) — divides by 100
critical_findings.failureMode: Win rate 1.0 (100%) passes >1 check and becomes 0.01 (1%) — completely wrong interpretation

critical_findings.description: evolvedRulesToOverrides with raw stopLoss=0.15 (positive, as percent) — converts to -0.0015
critical_findings.failureMode: Positive 15 treated as 0.15% stop (<1% magnitude) rather than 15% — wildly different from intended stop

critical_findings.description: addCustomProvider with an id that collides with a built-in PROVIDERS entry
critical_findings.failureMode: Custom provider silently overwrites built-in PROVIDERS[entry.id], breaking downstream validation; no collision warning logged

critical_findings.description: handleProviderError with a 429 rate_limited error triggers fallback chain to the next available provider
critical_findings.failureMode: handleProviderError misclassifies 429 as auth_error; no fallback triggered; rate_limited type not recognized by caller; fallback loops infinitely

critical_findings.description: createLLMClient called for an anthropic-native provider type uses the correct SDK constructor vs OpenAI constructor
critical_findings.failureMode: Anthropic provider routed to OpenAI constructor causing silent failure; or OpenAI provider routed to Anthropic constructor; type check missing edge cases

critical_findings.description: All 11 provider presets fail simultaneously and handleProviderError chain exhausts all fallbacks
critical_findings.failureMode: Fallback chain wraps around to first provider creating infinite retry; or silently returns null/undefined causing downstream NPE; or crashes on last fallback

critical_findings.description: Proxy returns a response with malformed JSON that the calling code expects to parse
critical_findings.failureMode: Proxy response contains trailing comma, unescaped quotes, or truncated JSON; calling code throws on JSON.parse; position management silently fails

critical_findings.description: All 6 role schemas are loaded concurrently and one schema has a corrupt field definition
critical_findings.failureMode: Single corrupt schema causes all 6 schema loads to fail; agent cannot parse any LLM response until fixed

critical_findings.description: readEnv returns undefined for PROVIDER key because .env file does not exist
critical_findings.failureMode: readEnv throws file not found error; bot fails to start; no default provider fallback

critical_findings.description: ListToolsRequestSchema returns 28 registered tools but one handler throws during registration
critical_findings.failureMode: Single failing handler blocks all 28 tool registrations; server starts with 0 tools; clients see empty tool list

critical_findings.description: Codex auto-advances from 'execute' to 'review' when testing artifacts are missing
critical_findings.failureMode: Codex advances to review without testing; task reaches Claude for review without verification; buggy code is approved

critical_findings.description: validateTaskPolicy called for a task with spec artifacts but missing plan and testing artifacts
critical_findings.failureMode: Missing artifact check only warns instead of erroring; task is finalized without complete workflow; policy gate bypassed

critical_findings.description: finalizeTaskWithPolicy called by agent 'gemini' instead of 'claude'
critical_findings.failureMode: Agent name check is case-sensitive and 'Claude' (capitalized) is rejected; or 'gemini' is accidentally allowed to finalize

critical_findings.description: gemini_analyze_file called with a file_path that traverses outside PROJECT_ROOT via '../'
critical_findings.failureMode: path traversal not detected; attacker reads arbitrary files; or startsWith check bypassed with symlink

critical_findings.description: advanceOrchestrationTask called with a stage that is not in the sequential order (skipping from research to decide)
critical_findings.failureMode: Stage is advanced non-sequentially; review step is skipped; code goes to production without review

critical_findings.description: Server starts on port 3000 but the port is already in use by a non-Node process
critical_findings.failureMode: fuser/lsof not available in container; handler fails silently; server never starts; no useful error message

critical_findings.description: Auth token comparison uses regular comparison instead of timingSafeEqual
critical_findings.failureMode: String comparison with !== is timing-vulnerable; attacker can brute-force token character by character

critical_findings.description: Atomic write to config file via atomicWriteJsonAsync while another write is in progress
critical_findings.failureMode: No locking; concurrent writes interleave; config file ends up as mix of both writes; corrupt config

critical_findings.description: Trash-wallets set operation replaces the entire list while concurrent screening reads the old list
critical_findings.failureMode: Non-atomic update; screening reads partially updated list; some trash wallets not filtered; scam tokens pass through

critical_findings.description: Kill stale process via fuser but the stale process is actually the current process (PID reused)
critical_findings.failureMode: fuser kills the newly started server process thinking it's stale; server dies immediately after start

critical_findings.description: Set_strategy for position limits with a value that exceeds the maximum allowed exposure
critical_findings.failureMode: Strategy set without validation; bot opens positions exceeding safe exposure; liquidation risk

critical_findings.description: Config change via dashboard triggers config-writer to write but the bot mid-read from config.js sees partial state
critical_findings.failureMode: config.js reads during tmp+rename window; gets ENOENT or reads incomplete file; entire bot misconfigures

critical_findings.description: Swap confirmation: runSafetyChecks detects SOL balance below gasReserve for a BUY
critical_findings.failureMode: Gas reserve check miscalculates; allows swap with insufficient SOL; transaction fails mid-execution; position partially opened

critical_findings.description: self_update completes git pull and spawns restart, but the restart fails (port in use, config error)
critical_findings.failureMode: Current process exits before confirming restart success; both old and new processes die; bot goes offline

critical_findings.description: Jupiter Ultra /execute endpoint returns status='Failed' after successful /order
critical_findings.failureMode: Failed status not checked; success=true returned despite failed execution; bot thinks swap succeeded

critical_findings.description: getActiveWallet called when no wallet is configured and WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY is not set
critical_findings.failureMode: Returns undefined/null; downstream code tries to use undefined.publicKey; cryptic TypeError

critical_findings.description: Tool handler in toolMap receives unexpected parameter types; coerceBoolean is applied to a parameter that expects coerceString
critical_findings.failureMode: coerceBoolean applied to address parameter converts valid address to boolean 'true'; wrong address used for swap

critical_findings.description: confirmMode intercept via maybeParkAsConfirmIntent for non-SOL input token (should not intercept)
critical_findings.failureMode: Token->SOL sell is intercepted as pending intent; sell is blocked; position cannot be closed

critical_findings.description: Jito bundle not landed (awaitBundleLanding returns landed=false with error status)
critical_findings.failureMode: Non-landed bundle treated as success; bot thinks swap completed; position tracked but never opened

critical_findings.description: trackPosition and recordClose race via concurrent calls; _writeQueue serializes them
critical_findings.failureMode: No serialization; second write overwrites first; position close data lost

critical_findings.description: buildVaultConfig with 4-level nested config fallback; all levels empty
critical_findings.failureMode: Missing fallback at any level returns undefined; downstream vault code crashes on undefined access

critical_findings.description: Circuit breaker trips at BREAKER_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ERRORS=3 for a feature; third consecutive error disables it
critical_findings.failureMode: Breaker trips at 2 errors (off-by-one); or never trips due to counter reset bug

critical_findings.description: demoMode=true and dryRun=true both set; demoMode should imply dryRun regardless
critical_findings.failureMode: demoMode does not set DRY_RUN; demo bot executes real transactions; real SOL lost

critical_findings.description: assertOperationalReadiness throws in live mode when readiness checks fail
critical_findings.failureMode: Warning-level failure does not throw; bot enters live mode with degraded capabilities

critical_findings.description: Token replay via timingSafeEqual: send a stolen token cookie from a different IP/network within the validity window
critical_findings.failureMode: Stolen dashboard tokens can be replayed from any origin until expiry, enabling persistent unauthorized access

critical_findings.description: WebSocket broadcast contains full state including wallet private keys or seed phrases if present in state
critical_findings.failureMode: If state contains sensitive key material, any WebSocket client (including unauthenticated connections) receives it

critical_findings.description: WebSocket connections are accepted without authentication; determine if WS upgrade path checks token
critical_findings.failureMode: Unauthenticated clients can subscribe to full bot state stream including positions, balances, and config

critical_findings.description: IPC command injection via writeAutomationCommand: attacker writes a crafted command to the JSON file that overrides lifecycle
critical_findings.failureMode: If allowlist is missing entries or uses partial matching, arbitrary commands could be injected

critical_findings.description: PRO_THRESHOLDS for buy/sell/cutloss are hardcoded; determine if thresholds can be manipulated via config injection
critical_findings.failureMode: If config injection is possible, thresholds could be set to 0 or negative values bypassing all gates

critical_findings.description: API key redaction in logs: verify key pattern is consistently redacted across all log paths
critical_findings.failureMode: If a new log path or error handler misses redaction, API keys leak to log files

critical_findings.description: DRY_RUN mode for vault sweep: verify dry-run cannot accidentally execute real transfers
critical_findings.failureMode: If DRY_RUN flag is incorrectly evaluated (e.g. type coercion), real transfers could execute during dry-run mode

critical_findings.description: Profit-sweep transfer to external wallet: verify destination address validation
critical_findings.failureMode: If destination validation is missing, funds could be sent to an invalid or attacker-controlled address

critical_findings.description: 2s broadcast loop sends full state; determine if state object contains user-config.json secrets
critical_findings.failureMode: Sensitive config values (API keys, wallet seed, RPC endpoints) may be exposed in state broadcast

critical_findings.description: REST endpoints for status/config/command/toggle: determine if auth middleware is applied to all routes
critical_findings.failureMode: If any route is missing auth middleware, unauthenticated access to sensitive operations is possible

critical_findings.description: ProCutlossDecision: test for infinite loop or recursive evaluation if price keeps dropping
critical_findings.failureMode: If cutloss logic re-evaluates without state checkpoint, a rapidly dropping price could cause infinite re-evaluation

critical_findings.description: Helius API key in WebSocket URL construction: verify key is not exposed in URL logs or error messages
critical_findings.failureMode: If connection error includes full URL in stack trace or error message, API key leaks

critical_findings.description: Environment variable overrides loaded from user-config.json; test for prototype pollution via config JSON
critical_findings.failureMode: If JSON.parse is used without prototype pollution protection, __proto__ payloads could pollute global state

critical_findings.description: Cookie+header auth: verify both must be present; test for bypass by providing only one
critical_findings.failureMode: If auth logic uses OR instead of AND, providing only one factor could bypass auth

critical_findings.description: Kill switch mechanism; test for false triggers or inability to disarm once triggered
critical_findings.failureMode: If kill switch disarming is not implemented, all trading stops permanently until manual intervention

critical_findings.description: Pro-orchestrator buy decision triggers executor.adaptiveSwap; verify the full decision-to-execution pipeline
critical_findings.failureMode: Parameter mapping mismatch (field names, types, units) causes incorrect swap parameters

critical_findings.description: Executor calls Jupiter quote then swap; verify quote parameters match swap execution
critical_findings.failureMode: Quote-to-swap parameter drift causes slippage violations or failed transactions

critical_findings.description: Auth middleware integrates with Express routes; verify middleware executes on all protected routes
critical_findings.failureMode: Route added without auth middleware inclusion; administrative endpoints accessible without token

critical_findings.description: Vault sweep triggers executor for transfer; verify vault sweep parameters correctly enter execution pipeline
critical_findings.failureMode: Transfer amount precision (lamports vs SOL) mismatch causes incorrect sweep amounts

critical_findings.description: Dashboard API routes handle errors; verify Express error middleware catches all route errors
critical_findings.failureMode: Unhandled promise rejections in async routes crash the dashboard process

critical_findings.description: Kill switch triggers automation control to stop; verify kill-switch properly communicates with automation system
critical_findings.failureMode: Automation control ignores kill-switch signal if running in a separate process

critical_findings.description: Risk policy enforces constraints on pro-orchestrator decisions; verify policy violations block trades
critical_findings.failureMode: Risk policy uses stale data (old portfolio value) allowing trades that exceed actual risk limits

critical_findings.description: Runtime mode (live/demo/simulation) affects all module behaviors; verify consistent mode enforcement
critical_findings.failureMode: Module implements its own mode check differently, allowing real trades in simulation mode

critical_findings.description: Honeypot checker results feed into trash-layer filtering; verify check results correctly block tokens
critical_findings.failureMode: Honeypot check API failure is treated as 'not a honeypot', allowing dangerous tokens through

critical_findings.description: Network partition: RPC connection drops for extended period (5+ minutes)
critical_findings.failureMode: Unhandled connection errors cascade through dependent modules causing crash loop

critical_findings.description: Disk full: state files, logs, and data files cannot be written
critical_findings.failureMode: Unhandled write exceptions cause crash; partial writes corrupt state file

critical_findings.description: Jupiter quote API returns zero or extremely large amountOut
critical_findings.failureMode: Zero amount causes division by zero in price calculations; extremely large amount drains wallet

critical_findings.description: Neural risk model receives 100% win-rate history (no loss data for risk calculation)
critical_findings.failureMode: Kelly criterion recommends infinite bet size with no loss data

critical_findings.description: Kill switch triggers and then network is restored with large position still open
critical_findings.failureMode: Kill switch auto-recovers on network restore, immediately executing against lethal conditions

critical_findings.description: Executor confirms a transaction that later fails (confirmation timeout vs actual failure)
critical_findings.failureMode: Executor assumes success based on submission confirmation; state reflects trade that never landed

critical_findings.description: No connection pool or fallback to secondary RPC endpoint (missing RPC failover)
critical_findings.failureMode: Single RPC endpoint failure causes complete loss of on-chain data stream

critical_findings.description: Dashboard has no HTTPS support (missing TLS configuration)
critical_findings.failureMode: All dashboard traffic, including auth tokens, transmitted in plaintext over network

scenarios.description: Fire-and-forget emit with no listeners registered on topic — verifies super.emit returns false and no crash
scenarios.expectedBehavior: emit() returns false silently; no unhandled error thrown
scenarios.failureMode: EventEmitter throws 'unhandled error' if no listener registered and error event is emitted
scenarios.prerequisites: AgentBus singleton, no listener on a custom topic

scenarios.description: Request resolves when respond() is called within timeout window
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Promise resolves with the response value passed to respond()
scenarios.failureMode: Race condition where respond() is called before _pendingRequests map is populated
scenarios.prerequisites: A subscriber on the topic that calls respond() synchronously

scenarios.description: Request rejects when timeout expires before respond() is called
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Promise rejects with Error containing 'timed out after' message after timeoutMs
scenarios.failureMode: pending entry is leaked if clearTimeout or delete fails; memory growth over time
scenarios.prerequisites: A request with 10ms timeout where nobody calls respond()

scenarios.description: Request with empty string topic should reject immediately
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Promise rejects with 'topic is required' without hitting EventEmitter
scenarios.failureMode: Empty string passes type check and emits on global topic, causing silent cross-talk
scenarios.prerequisites: None

scenarios.description: Request with non-string topic (number, null, object) rejects immediately
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Promise rejects with 'topic is required' for any non-string type
scenarios.failureMode: Number or object topic coerces to string and causes unexpected topic match
scenarios.prerequisites: None

scenarios.description: Handler that throws synchronously inside emit does not prevent other handlers from running
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Node EventEmitter wraps each handler — one throwing does not affect others
scenarios.failureMode: Uncaught exception in a handler terminates all subsequent handlers for same topic
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple listeners on same topic; first listener throws

scenarios.description: Multiple subscribers on same topic all receive emitted payload
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All subscribers receive identical payload object reference
scenarios.failureMode: Payload mutation in one subscriber affects other subscribers (shared object reference)
scenarios.prerequisites: 3+ subscribers on a topic; one mutates payload

scenarios.description: subscribe returns a function that removes the handler when called
scenarios.expectedBehavior: After calling unsubscribe, handler is no longer invoked for that topic
scenarios.failureMode: off() removes wrong handler (index confusion) if same function is registered twice
scenarios.prerequisites: A subscribed handler that increments a counter

scenarios.description: Calling unsubscribe() multiple times is idempotent and does not throw
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Second call to unsubscribe does nothing; no error emitted
scenarios.failureMode: Node EventEmitter.off on an already-removed listener throws or causes negative listener count
scenarios.prerequisites: A subscribed handler; unsubscribed once

scenarios.description: Repeated subscribe() without unsubscribe() accumulates handlers — verify maxListeners warning
scenarios.expectedBehavior: EventEmitter emits 'possible EventEmitter memory leak' warning when >50 listeners per topic
scenarios.failureMode: Unbounded listener growth causes memory leak and degraded emit performance
scenarios.prerequisites: setMaxListeners(50) is set in constructor (line 25)

scenarios.description: Pending request map grows when requests are never resolved or timed out (leaked timers)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each request creates Map entry + setTimeout — both must be cleaned on timeout or respond()
scenarios.failureMode: If clearTimeout fails silently, timer keeps Node process alive and callback fires after delete
scenarios.prerequisites: Request with very long timeout; respond() never called

scenarios.description: Race between respond() and timeout expiration — response arrives milliseconds after timeout
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Race loser is harmless: either promise resolves first and timer is cleared, or timeout wins and respond() is no-op
scenarios.failureMode: Both resolve and reject are called on same promise, causing unhandled rejection
scenarios.prerequisites: Respond() called on same tick as timeout expiry (wall-clock race)

scenarios.description: Concurrent respond() calls for same reqId — second call should be no-op
scenarios.expectedBehavior: First respond() wins, clears timer, resolves promise; second returns false
scenarios.failureMode: Missing early return allows double-resolve on same promise
scenarios.prerequisites: A pending request; respond() called twice rapidly

scenarios.description: emit() does not await async handlers — fire-and-forget semantics may swallow rejections
scenarios.expectedBehavior: emit() returns synchronously; async handler rejections become unhandled promise rejections
scenarios.failureMode: Critical async processing error in handler goes undetected because emit is fire-and-forget
scenarios.prerequisites: An async handler that throws after await; no try/catch in handler

scenarios.description: Handler that returns a Promise — EventEmitter ignores return value
scenarios.expectedBehavior: EventEmitter discards handler return value regardless of type
scenarios.failureMode: Promise returned by handler may contain rejection that becomes unhandled
scenarios.prerequisites: Handler is async function that could reject

scenarios.description: Emit payload with _reqId collision — accidental reuse of a request ID from emit in request()
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each request increments _reqId; fire-and-forget emit should never set _reqId on payload to avoid false matching
scenarios.failureMode: If emit payload happens to contain _reqId field, respond() could wrongly match a pending request
scenarios.prerequisites: A pending request; someone emits payload with matching _reqId

scenarios.description: Emit on topic 'error' triggers special EventEmitter behavior — throws if no listener for 'error'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: EventEmitter throws uncaught exception if 'error' event emitted with no listener
scenarios.failureMode: Agent code that emits { topic: 'error' } would crash process
scenarios.prerequisites: No 'error' listener registered on bus

scenarios.description: respond() called for already-completed (timed out) request — no-op but timer already cleared
scenarios.expectedBehavior: respond() returns false since reqId not found in _pendingRequests
scenarios.failureMode: Race where timer fires, deletes entry, then respond() tries to access deleted timer reference
scenarios.prerequisites: Timed-out request; respond() called after timeout

scenarios.description: request() with 0 timeoutMs should reject immediately without starting timer
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Promise rejects with timeout error for timeoutMs=0 (setTimeout(fn, 0) still fires on next tick)
scenarios.failureMode: timeoutMs=0 creates immediate timer that fires on next tick, not synchronously — not actually immediate
scenarios.prerequisites: None

scenarios.description: Multiple concurrent requests with different topics all resolve correctly
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each request gets unique _reqId; respond() routes response to correct promise
scenarios.failureMode: Sequential ID collision after wrap-around (Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) causes cross-wiring
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple concurrent requests on different topics

scenarios.description: getActiveTopics returns correct list of topics that have listeners
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns array of topic strings from EventEmitter.eventNames()
scenarios.failureMode: Topics remain in eventNames after all listeners removed if once() was used
scenarios.prerequisites: Listeners registered on at least one topic

scenarios.description: pendingCount accurate when requests are pending and after cancellation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: pendingCount reflects exact number of entries in _pendingRequests map
scenarios.failureMode: Map entry deleted on timeout but pendingCount read before delete — stale count
scenarios.prerequisites: At least one pending request

scenarios.description: Emit with undefined payload — handler receives undefined as argument
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Handler executes with undefined; no TypeError thrown by EventEmitter
scenarios.failureMode: Handler that destructures payload throws TypeError from undefined destructuring
scenarios.prerequisites: A subscriber that destructures payload without defaults

scenarios.description: Nested request inside a respond handler — request inside response handler deadlocks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Nested request creates a new pending entry; outer respond() completes first
scenarios.failureMode: Synchronous request inside respond handler blocks event loop and prevents response delivery
scenarios.prerequisites: Handler calls agentBus.request() inside a respond() callback

scenarios.description: Emitter reaches Node.js default maxListeners (16) for a single topic without warning override
scenarios.expectedBehavior: setMaxListeners(50) suppresses warning up to 50 listeners per topic

scenarios.description: registerAgent with valid role and name creates agent entry with default stopped status

scenarios.description: registerAgent with invalid role throws descriptive error listing valid roles
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Throws Error with message containing 'Invalid agent role' and all 7 valid roles
scenarios.failureMode: Invalid role silently accepted causing downstream role-based routing to malfunction

scenarios.description: registerAgent for already-registered name updates fields without resetting status
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Existing entry updated with new role/module/healthCheck; status and errorCount preserved

scenarios.prerequisites: Agent already registered with running status and errorCount > 0

scenarios.description: setAgentStatus with valid status updates agent status and sets startedAt on first 'running' transition
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Status updated; startedAt set to ISO string only on first transition to 'running'
scenarios.failureMode: startedAt overwritten on every status='running' call, losing original start time
scenarios.prerequisites: Agent registered with status='stopped'

scenarios.description: setAgentStatus with invalid status string returns false without modifying agent
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns false; agent state unchanged
scenarios.failureMode: Invalid status partially applied before validation check
scenarios.prerequisites: Agent registered; status not in VALID_STATUSES set (line 19)

scenarios.description: setAgentStatus for unregistered agent returns false
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns false; no agent found for name
scenarios.failureMode: Silent no-op gives caller false sense that status was changed
scenarios.prerequisites: Name not in _agents map

scenarios.description: setAgentStatus with status='error' increments errorCount and stores detail
scenarios.expectedBehavior: errorCount incremented; lastError set to detail string
scenarios.failureMode: errorCount overflow after 2^53 errors stops increments (practically unreachable)
scenarios.prerequisites: Agent registered; setAgentStatus called with 'error' and non-empty detail

scenarios.description: updateAgentHealth merges healthData with existing health object
scenarios.expectedBehavior: New keys added; existing keys preserved; lastHeartbeat updated
scenarios.failureMode: Deep merge mutates nested objects across calls causing cross-contamination
scenarios.prerequisites: Agent with existing health data

scenarios.description: updateAgentHealth for unregistered agent returns false silently
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns false; no state changed
scenarios.failureMode: Caller assumes health was recorded and proceeds with stale data
scenarios.prerequisites: Unregistered agent name

scenarios.description: runHealthChecks invokes healthCheck function and records result; catches thrown errors
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each healthCheck called in sequence; errors caught and recorded as failed health result
scenarios.failureMode: One agent's healthCheck rejection prevents all remaining agents from being checked (no try/catch per agent)
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple agents registered, some with healthCheck function, one throws

scenarios.description: runHealthChecks handles non-function healthCheck values (null, string, etc.) gracefully
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Agents with non-function healthCheck are skipped; no error thrown
scenarios.failureMode: typeof healthCheck === 'function' does not distinguish async vs sync correctly
scenarios.prerequisites: An agent registered with healthCheck set to a non-function value

scenarios.description: getDashboardSummary counts status categories correctly with edge cases
scenarios.expectedBehavior: running, degraded, stopped, errored counts match actual agent states; timestamp is ISO
scenarios.failureMode: Agents with status not in VALID_STATUSES are uncounted (status was set by bug)
scenarios.prerequisites: Agents in various states (running, degraded, stopped, error)

scenarios.description: getDashboardSummary with zero registered agents returns zero counts
scenarios.expectedBehavior: total=0, running=0, degraded=0, stopped=0, errored=0, agents=[]
scenarios.failureMode: Division by zero or null pointer in dashboard consumer with empty agents array
scenarios.prerequisites: No agents registered (clean registry after reset)

scenarios.description: getAgentStatus returns structured object with all expected fields
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns object containing name, role, status, startedAt, lastHeartbeat, health, errorCount, lastError
scenarios.failureMode: Missing fields in return value cause dashboard or health monitor to crash
scenarios.prerequisites: Registered agent with some history

scenarios.description: getAgentStatus for unregistered name returns null
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns null
scenarios.failureMode: Caller accesses .name or .status on null, throwing TypeError
scenarios.prerequisites: Name not in _agents map

scenarios.description: getAgentsByRole returns correct agent names for a given role
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns array of agent names matching the role
scenarios.failureMode: Case-sensitive role comparison: 'GENERAL' vs 'general' returns empty

scenarios.description: getAgentsByRole with role having no agents returns empty array
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns [] — no agents found for role
scenarios.failureMode: Caller iterating over result assumes at least one element, crashes
scenarios.prerequisites: No agents registered with the queried role

scenarios.description: Concurrent registerAgent calls for same name from multiple initialization paths race
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Last writer wins without corruption; status not reset by earlier write after later write
scenarios.failureMode: Race where both paths see _agents.has(name) false and both set different role values

scenarios.description: getAllAgentStatuses returns snapshot unaffected by concurrent mutations
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns array of current entries; mutations after iteration start may or may not be included
scenarios.failureMode: Caller modifies returned array assuming it's a live reference, causing side effects

scenarios.description: setAgentStatus sets lastHeartbeat timestamp for every valid status change
scenarios.expectedBehavior: lastHeartbeat updated to current ISO string on every status change including redundant ones
scenarios.failureMode: lastHeartbeat not updated if status is same as current — agents appear stale
scenarios.prerequisites: Agent in 'running' status; setAgentStatus called with 'running' again

scenarios.description: Full lifecycle transition: stopped → starting → running → degraded → error → stopping → stopped
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All valid transitions succeed; errorCount increments after 'error' transition
scenarios.failureMode: Transitions like starting→stopped or degraded→running silently fail as invalid
scenarios.prerequisites: Agent registered; all VALID_STATUSES available

scenarios.description: runHealthChecks records checkedAt timestamp on successful health results
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Health result includes checkedAt timestamp from within updateAgentHealth
scenarios.failureMode: checkedAt is the time healthCheck completed, not when runHealthChecks started — may mismatch
scenarios.prerequisites: An agent with a healthCheck that returns synchronously

scenarios.description: registerAgent with empty name string should be rejected or handled
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Empty string name creates entry in Map; may shadow null lookups
scenarios.failureMode: Empty name creates unreachable entry; getAgentStatus('') returns wrong data
scenarios.prerequisites: None

scenarios.description: registerAgent called without role argument (undefined) throws error
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Throws 'Invalid agent role' since undefined not in VALID_ROLES

scenarios.description: getDashboardSummary 'total' count mismatches individual status sum if agent has unhandled status value
scenarios.expectedBehavior: total = running + degraded + stopped + errored; but status counts only these four categories
scenarios.failureMode: If an agent has status='starting', it counts in total but not in any category — hidden agent
scenarios.prerequisites: An agent with status='starting' or 'stopping' that is not in the four dashboard categories

scenarios.description: LLM returns valid JSON tool arguments that parse correctly via JSON.parse
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Arguments parsed and passed to executeTool function; execution proceeds normally
scenarios.failureMode: JSON.parse throws on malformed JSON; jsonrepair fallback may introduce subtle corruption
scenarios.prerequisites: LLM response contains tool_calls with arguments field

scenarios.description: LLM returns invalid JSON arguments that jsonrepair can fix
scenarios.expectedBehavior: jsonrepair successfully parses; warning 'Repaired broken JSON args' logged
scenarios.failureMode: jsonrepair changes semantic meaning of arguments (e.g., trailing comma changes array length)
scenarios.prerequisites: LLM response with tool_call arguments containing single quotes or trailing commas

scenarios.description: LLM returns completely unparseable JSON arguments; both JSON.parse and jsonrepair fail
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Warning logged; empty object {} used as fallback; agent continues
scenarios.failureMode: Tool called with {} instead of actual intended arguments — may execute on default/null values

scenarios.description: getToolsForRole('MANAGER') returns only MANAGER_TOOLS subset
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns tools filtered to MANAGER_TOOLS set (swap_token, get_token_info, etc.)

scenarios.description: getToolsForRole('SCREENER') returns SCREENER_TOOLS including all ANALYSIS_ONLY_TOOLS

scenarios.description: Intent pattern regex matches goal string and returns correct tool subset

scenarios.description: Goal matches multiple intents — only first matching intent's tools are returned (no union)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Only the first sequentially matched intent's tools are in the result set
scenarios.failureMode: Cross-intent goal gets only partial tool set; needed tool from second intent missing
scenarios.prerequisites: Goal matches at least two INTENT_PATTERNS, e.g. 'swap and blacklist'

scenarios.description: LLM API times out on all 3 attempts — error correctly thrown after retries exhausted
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Throws 'LLM API timed out after N attempts' after 3 consecutive timeouts with 2s delays
scenarios.failureMode: Retry counter not incremented on timeout, causing infinite retry loop
scenarios.prerequisites: config.llm.timeoutMs set; LLM endpoint unresponsive

scenarios.description: System role unsupported error triggers mode switch from 'system' to 'user_embedded' exactly once

scenarios.prerequisites: Provider returns system_role_unsupported; config is in 'system' mode

scenarios.description: Tool_choice unsupported error triggers fallback from 'required' to 'auto'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: toolChoice changed from 'required' to 'auto'; attempt retried

scenarios.description: swap_token called twice in same step — second call blocked by ONCE_PER_SESSION reservation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: First tool_call_id allowed; second returns { blocked: true, reason: 'Executed once already.' }
scenarios.failureMode: Race where two swap_token tool calls in same LLM response both check before reservation — double execution
scenarios.prerequisites: LLM returns two tool_calls requesting swap_token

scenarios.description: Blocked tool call returns string result not a thrown error — loop continues normally
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Blocked tool returns structured { blocked: true } result; toolResults array includes it; loop doesn't break

scenarios.prerequisites: swap_token blocked via ONCE_PER_SESSION

scenarios.description: Tool output compression applied via compressToolOutput before adding to messages

scenarios.description: shouldRequireRealToolUse returns false for CONFIG_READ_ONLY_INTENTS regardless of agentType
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Pattern matches 'show config' or 'check settings' — returns false even for non-MANAGER agents

scenarios.description: MUTATING_TOOL_INTENTS correctly identifies 'buy', 'sell', 'deploy', 'close', 'swap' as requiring real tools
scenarios.expectedBehavior: shouldRequireRealToolUse returns true for goals containing these keywords

scenarios.description: LLM returns no choices in response for all retries — response.choices?.length is falsy

scenarios.description: LLM returns content without tool_calls but mustUseRealTool is true — nudge retry logic engages
scenarios.expectedBehavior: noToolRetryCount incremented; NUDGE message pushed; loop continues; after 2 nudges returns 'No tool call made.'

scenarios.description: LLM returns empty content and no tool_calls — message popped and loop continues without nudge

scenarios.description: Tool name not found in tools/definitions.js — executeTool returns error result not throw

scenarios.description: 2-second retry delay between invoke attempts when agent throws non-terminal error

scenarios.prerequisites: initOrchestratorAgent called; _initialized = true; bus subscription active

scenarios.description: Duplicate market:update with same condition does NOT emit market_adapt again (dedup by condition equality)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Early return on line 62: if condition === _lastMarketCondition, emit skipped
scenarios.failureMode: Rapid duplicate market updates cause multiple unnecessary pipeline adaptations
scenarios.prerequisites: Two consecutive market:update events with same condition value

scenarios.description: market:update with undefined condition falls back to STRATEGY_RULES.NORMAL
scenarios.expectedBehavior: update?.condition || 'NORMAL' resolves to NORMAL; NORMAL rules applied
scenarios.failureMode: Market update containing condition=null yields 'null' string, not matching any KEY → falls through to NORMAL
scenarios.prerequisites: market:update payload has no condition field or condition is null

scenarios.description: strategy:switch event changes _activeStrategy and appends to _strategyHistory
scenarios.expectedBehavior: _activeStrategy updated; history entry pushed with from, to, reason, timestamp
scenarios.failureMode: _strategyHistory grows unbounded (only last 10 shown in health but no cap in subscription)
scenarios.prerequisites: Subscribed to orchestrator:strategy_switch; or agentBus emits the event

scenarios.description: strategy:switch received with null payload — _activeStrategy set to undefined without crash
scenarios.expectedBehavior: payload?.strategy returns undefined; _activeStrategy = undefined; updateAgentHealth still called
scenarios.failureMode: strategyHistory push with null 'to' field will cause dashboard rendering to crash
scenarios.prerequisites: agentBus emits orchestrator:strategy_switch with no payload object

scenarios.description: runOrchestratorCycle with DEAD market correctly returns null and emits cycle_skip
scenarios.expectedBehavior: rules.trade=false; emits 'orchestrator:cycle_skip' with reason; returns null
scenarios.failureMode: Cycle continues despite DEAD regime — wasteful processing and potential bad trades
scenarios.prerequisites: _fullAutomationMode=true; getMarketIntelFn returns DEAD condition

scenarios.description: Transition from HOT → COLD adapts pipeline correctly — reduces maxPositions from 3 to 1
scenarios.expectedBehavior: market_adapt payload contains rules.preferTypes=['fundamental', 'conviction'] and maxPositions=1, aggressiveness='low'
scenarios.failureMode: Positions opened under HOT regime exceed COLD limits and are not force-closed
scenarios.prerequisites: Market update from HOT→COLD received through bus

scenarios.description: management:llm_exit_executed updates orchestator health with lastTradeOutcome
scenarios.expectedBehavior: updateAgentHealth called with lastTradeOutcome set to payload; totalTradesTracked incremented
scenarios.failureMode: _strategyHistory.length used for tracking — this counts strategy switches, not trades
scenarios.prerequisites: Agent management completes exit and emits via bus

scenarios.description: orchestrator:full_automation toggle event flips _fullAutomationMode
scenarios.expectedBehavior: If payload.enabled is true -> ON; false -> OFF; undefined -> toggle (!_fullAutomationMode)
scenarios.failureMode: Rapid toggling can send multiple contradictory events before first is processed
scenarios.prerequisites: Bus listener for orchestrator:full_automation registered

scenarios.description: pro:intelligence_ready with null/undefined payload silently ignored (early return)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: if (!intel) return; no processing of null payload
scenarios.failureMode: Null-check at line 120 passes for empty object {} — downstream code runs on empty intel
scenarios.prerequisites: agentBus emits 'pro:intelligence_ready' with null payload

scenarios.description: Pro intel received with regime_recommendations is logged and stored in health
scenarios.expectedBehavior: regimeRecs filtered by type='regime_preference' and stratRecs filtered by type='strategy_preference'; health updated
scenarios.failureMode: Recommendations with unknown type silently ignored — regime intelligence lost
scenarios.prerequisites: pro:intelligence_ready emitted with valid recommendations array

scenarios.description: Pro intel older than PRO_INTEL_MAX_AGE_MS is considered stale and not used in getRecommendedStrategy
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Date.now() - _proIntel._receivedAt >= 600000 → intelFresh = false; pro intel not consulted
scenarios.failureMode: Stale pro intel used despite being 20+ minutes old — wrong recommendations for current conditions
scenarios.prerequisites: _proIntel set with _receivedAt more than 10 minutes ago

scenarios.description: getRecommendedStrategy with fresh pro intel selects highest winRate strategy as proPreferred
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Strategies filtered by recommendation='ACTIVE' AND winRate>=0.45; sorted desc by winRate; first selected
scenarios.failureMode: Strategy with winRate=0.44 and very high profit factor excluded by >=0.45 threshold — misses good strategy
scenarios.prerequisites: Fresh _proIntel with strategies data; _proModeActive may be true

scenarios.description: getRecommendedStrategy identifies DEGRADED strategies from pro intel and lists them as proAvoided
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Strategies with recommendation='DEGRADED' are added to proAvoided array
scenarios.failureMode: DEGRADED strategies not avoided — orchestrator may switch to a known-degraded strategy
scenarios.prerequisites: Fresh _proIntel with strategies where some have recommendation='DEGRADED'

scenarios.description: getRecommendedStrategy falls back to auto strategy when getStrategyFn throws
scenarios.expectedBehavior: try/catch swallows error; falls back to manual STRATEGY_RULES-based strategy
scenarios.failureMode: Swallowed error hides real problem (e.g., corrupt strategy registry) — operator never knows
scenarios.prerequisites: getStrategyFn throws; catch block at line 177 is empty

scenarios.description: runOrchestratorCycle without _initialized returns null immediately
scenarios.expectedBehavior: !_initialized check at line 209 returns null; no processing
scenarios.failureMode: Cycle runs before init completes — race between import and bus subscriptions
scenarios.prerequisites: initOrchestratorAgent() not yet called

scenarios.description: runOrchestratorCycle with !_fullAutomationMode returns null without processing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: !_initialized || !_fullAutomationMode → returns null early
scenarios.failureMode: Manual mode orchestrator cycle runs and makes unintended automated changes
scenarios.prerequisites: initOrchestratorAgent called but fullAutomationMode not set

scenarios.description: runOrchestratorCycle emits strategy_switch only when strategy.id actually changes
scenarios.expectedBehavior: strategy.id !== _activeStrategy?.id check prevents duplicate emit for same strategy
scenarios.failureMode: Same strategy re-emitted every cycle, flooding event bus with redundant switch events
scenarios.prerequisites: _fullAutomationMode=true; getMarketIntelFn returns same condition every call

scenarios.description: runOrchestratorCycle catches internal errors and returns null — does not throw
scenarios.expectedBehavior: try/catch logs error.message via log(); returns null
scenarios.failureMode: Error without .message property (e.g., throw 'string') — log receives undefined
scenarios.prerequisites: Any function called inside cycle throws

scenarios.description: EXTREME market condition triggers emergency_pause with condition='EXTREME'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: rules.trade=false; agentBus emits 'orchestrator:emergency_pause' with condition='EXTREME'
scenarios.failureMode: EXTREME condition not in STRATEGY_RULES keys — falls to STRATEGY_RULES.NORMAL and continues trading
scenarios.prerequisites: Market update with condition='EXTREME'

scenarios.description: getOrchestratorDashboard returns correct state including strategyHistory (last 5)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns object with agent, fullAutomation, activeStrategy, marketCondition, strategyHistory (sliced to 5), rules
scenarios.failureMode: strategyHistory not sliced (unbounded array) — dashboard memory grows linearly
scenarios.prerequisites: Orchestrator initialized with some strategy history

scenarios.description: HOT market update sets aggressiveness='high' and maxPositions=3 — concurrent hunt screener capacity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: market_adapt payload includes aggressiveness='high' and maxPositions=3
scenarios.failureMode: High aggression leads to too many simultaneous positions exceeding portfolio capacity
scenarios.prerequisites: Market transitions to HOT; _fullAutomationMode=true

scenarios.description: Duplicate subscribe calls for same handler lead to double invocation on emit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each subscribe call adds same handler reference; EventEmitter invokes it once per registration
scenarios.failureMode: subscribe called multiple times accidentally (e.g., re-initialization) causing duplicate handling
scenarios.prerequisites: initOrchestratorAgent called twice (no re-init guard at top)

scenarios.description: Pro intel payload contains no recommendations array but non-null — empty filter, no crash
scenarios.expectedBehavior: .filter(r => r.type === 'regime_preference') on undefined/null throws? Actually intel.recommendations || [] protects
scenarios.failureMode: intel.recommendations = undefined => [] used; intel.recommendations = null => [] used; OK for both
scenarios.prerequisites: pro:intelligence_ready with payload missing recommendations field

scenarios.description: COLD market correctly limits to 1 position with conviction/fundamental only
scenarios.expectedBehavior: market_adapt contains preferTypes=['fundamental', 'conviction'], maxPositions=1, aggressiveness='low'
scenarios.failureMode: Scalping strategies still selected in COLD regime due to strategy registry overriding STRATEGY_RULES
scenarios.prerequisites: Market transitions to COLD condition

scenarios.description: initProOrchestrator checks isAutomationActive() before setting _proModeActive — blocked if not approved
scenarios.expectedBehavior: isAutomationActive() returns false → _proModeActive=false; agent status set to 'stopped' with awaiting message
scenarios.failureMode: initProOrchestrator runs before automation-state.json is loaded — isAutomationActive reads stale false
scenarios.prerequisites: automation-state.json has automationActive=false or doesn't exist

scenarios.description: automation:activated event upgrades pro mode from stopped to running and runs analysis
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Listener sets _proModeActive=true; setAgentStatus running; runProAnalysis called; intel emitted via pro:intelligence_ready
scenarios.failureMode: Analysis returns null; no intel emitted — downstream orchestrator never gets recommendation
scenarios.prerequisites: agentBus emits 'automation:activated'

scenarios.description: automation:revoked event downgrades pro mode to stopped immediately
scenarios.expectedBehavior: _proModeActive=false; setAgentStatus 'stopped' with revocation message
scenarios.failureMode: Pro analysis running at time of revocation — race between analysis completing and mode turning off
scenarios.prerequisites: agentBus emits 'automation:revoked'

scenarios.description: tryReadJson for non-existent file returns null without throwing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: fs.existsSync returns false → returns null; no crash from fs.readFileSync
scenarios.failureMode: Empty file exists but contains no JSON — JSON.parse throws, caught by catch block, returns null
scenarios.prerequisites: File path doesn't exist on disk

scenarios.description: tryReadJson for corrupt JSON file returns null silently (catch swallows parse error)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: JSON.parse throws; catch block returns null; no error propagated
scenarios.failureMode: Corrupt JSON silently returns null — caller treats as 'no data' instead of 'read error'
scenarios.prerequisites: File exists but contains invalid JSON

scenarios.description: tryReadJson returns null for all data files — runProAnalysis gracefully populates empty intelligence
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All tryReadJson return null; all iterations over regimes, narratives, etc. are no-ops; empty intelligence returned
scenarios.failureMode: Code assumes regimeMem.regimes is always an object — Object.entries(null) throws TypeError
scenarios.prerequisites: No data files exist (first run scenario)

scenarios.description: regime-memory.json has 'observations' key instead of 'regimes' — fallback path works
scenarios.expectedBehavior: regimeMem.regimes || regimeMem.observations || {} — observations used if regimes missing
scenarios.failureMode: Key name mismatch 'regime_memory' not matching 'regimes' or 'observations' — entire regime analysis skipped
scenarios.prerequisites: regime-memory.json with key 'observations' instead of 'regimes'

scenarios.description: proBuyDecision requires minConvictionScore=65 — below threshold fails signal convergence
scenarios.expectedBehavior: convScore=50 < 65 → signal not counted → convergingSignals does not increment
scenarios.failureMode: conviction_score of 0.65 (float) vs 65 (int) — wrong comparison if score is 0-1 scale
scenarios.prerequisites: conviction.conviction_score = 50

scenarios.description: proBuyDecision conviction signal passes at exact boundary (65)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: convScore=65 >= 65 → signal counted → convergingSignals incremented
scenarios.failureMode: Boundary off-by-one: >= vs > means 65 included vs excluded
scenarios.prerequisites: conviction.conviction_score = 65

scenarios.description: proBuyDecision requires 4 converging signals — only 3 pass results in SKIP
scenarios.expectedBehavior: convergingSignals=3 < requiredSignalsConverging=4 → action='SKIP'
scenarios.failureMode: False positive BUY with only 3 signals — weak conviction trade executed
scenarios.prerequisites: 3 out of 8 signals pass thresholds

scenarios.description: proBuyDecision all 8 signals pass — action='BUY' with confidence 100%
scenarios.expectedBehavior: convergingSignals=8 >= 4 → action='BUY'; confidence=100; reasons array contains all 8 reasons
scenarios.failureMode: confidence calculation rounds to 100 even if only 7 pass (Math.round(7/8*100)=88, correct)
scenarios.prerequisites: All signal thresholds met: conviction, aggregate, Kelly, rug, workflow, volatility, narrative, liquidity

scenarios.description: proBuyDecision Kelly signal: should_skip=true overrides effective_fraction — signal not counted
scenarios.expectedBehavior: kelly?.should_skip is true → condition fails even if effective_fraction >= minKellyEdge
scenarios.failureMode: Kelly skip flag ignored — trade proceeds despite Kelly deeming it unprofitable
scenarios.prerequisites: kelly.effective_fraction >= 0.08 but kelly.should_skip = true

scenarios.description: proBuyDecision liquidity signal: liquidity=1999 < minLiquidityUSD=2000 — signal fails at boundary
scenarios.expectedBehavior: (liquidity || 0) >= 2000 → false → signal not counted
scenarios.failureMode: Low liquidity trade passes despite insufficient depth to exit
scenarios.prerequisites: liquidity=1999

scenarios.description: proCutlossDecision fast_failure: pnl=-8% in <8 min triggers immediate cut
scenarios.expectedBehavior: safeHold <= 8 && safePnl <= -8 → action='CUTLOSS' with type='fast_failure'
scenarios.failureMode: Position drops -7.9% in 7 minutes — misses fast_failure threshold by 0.1%, continues to -15%
scenarios.prerequisites: pnlPct=-8, holdMinutes=7

scenarios.description: proCutlossDecision conviction_collapse: entry-drop >=25pts + pnl <= -10% triggers cut
scenarios.expectedBehavior: convCollapse >= 25 && safePnl <= -10 → action='CUTLOSS' with type='conviction_collapse'
scenarios.failureMode: conviction_collapse check uses >= for convCollapse but comparison variable is hardcoded 25, not from thresholds
scenarios.prerequisites: entryConviction=80, current conviction.score=50 (drop=30), pnlPct=-10

scenarios.description: proCutlossDecision regime_adjusted: HOT market allows wider stop (-18%) than NORMAL (-15%)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: regimeCutLoss = -18 for HOT; pnl=-18 triggers cut; pnl=-17 holds
scenarios.failureMode: Regime not found in regimeAdjustedCutLoss — falls through to standardCutLossPnL (-15)
scenarios.prerequisites: marketCondition='HOT'; pnl=-17 (between -18 and -15)

scenarios.description: proCutlossDecision with non-numeric pnlPct (NaN/undefined) uses 0 as safe fallback
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Number.isFinite(Number(undefined)) → false → safePnl=0; no cut triggered
scenarios.failureMode: Non-numeric pnl prevents cutloss from firing — position could go to -100% undetected
scenarios.prerequisites: pnlPct=undefined or 'abc'

scenarios.description: proCutlossDecision all conditions pass — action='HOLD' is correct
scenarios.expectedBehavior: No cut condition matches → returns { action: 'HOLD' }
scenarios.failureMode: False positive cutloss — position closed unnecessarily, missing profit
scenarios.prerequisites: pnl=-2%, holdMinutes=30, marketCondition='NORMAL', conviction stable

scenarios.description: proSellDecision conviction_decay: delta <= -20 triggers exit signal
scenarios.expectedBehavior: entryConv - currentConv <= -20 → exitSignals++ and 'conviction_decayed' in reasons
scenarios.failureMode: conviction_entry is 0 (default) when position has no stored entry conviction — delta computed as current-0 = large positive, no decay
scenarios.prerequisites: position.conviction_entry=80, current conviction=55 → delta=-25

scenarios.description: proSellDecision regime_downgrade: marketCondition='DEAD' triggers forced exit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: marketCondition === 'DEAD' AND regimeDowngradeExit=true → exitSignals++
scenarios.failureMode: regimeDowngradeExit cannot be overridden per-position — all positions forced to exit in DEAD
scenarios.prerequisites: marketCondition='DEAD'; thresholds.sell.regimeDowngradeExit=true

scenarios.description: proSellDecision trailing_stop: peak >= 8% and pnl <= 60% of peak triggers exit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: peakPnl=10, pnlPct=5, pnl <= 10*0.6=6 → 5<=6 true → exit signal
scenarios.failureMode: Trailing formula pnlPct <= peakPnl * 0.6 may be too tight — 41% retracement from peak triggers exit
scenarios.prerequisites: position.peak_pnl_pct=10, position.pnl_pct=5

scenarios.description: proSellDecision profit_sweep: pnl >= 45% triggers exit signal
scenarios.expectedBehavior: pnlPct=50 >= 45 → exitSignals++ with reason 'profit_sweep'
scenarios.failureMode: Profit sweep at 45% may miss larger runs — position sold at 45% that would reach 200%
scenarios.prerequisites: pnlPct=50

scenarios.description: proSellDecision single exit signal (1) results in HOLD — needs minimum 2
scenarios.expectedBehavior: exitSignals=1 < 2 → shouldExit=false → action='HOLD'
scenarios.failureMode: Only one trigger activated but position should exit — delays exit until more signals converge
scenarios.prerequisites: Only conviction_decay triggers; narrative_velocity does not (no narrative_entry stored)

scenarios.description: proSellDecision 3+ exit signals produce urgency='HIGH'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: exitSignals >= 3 → urgency='HIGH'
scenarios.failureMode: HIGH urgency does nothing different from MEDIUM — same code path, no expedited execution
scenarios.prerequisites: conviction_decay + narrative_death + regime_dead all trigger

scenarios.description: validateStrategyCandidate with non-object candidate returns invalid with reason
scenarios.expectedBehavior: !candidate || typeof candidate !== 'object' → { valid: false, reason: 'Candidate is not an object' }
scenarios.failureMode: null candidate crashes caller that assumes return always has .valid field
scenarios.prerequisites: candidate=null or 'string'

scenarios.description: validateStrategyCandidate with stopLoss > -30% (e.g., -50%) is rejected
scenarios.expectedBehavior: sl=-50 < -30 → { valid: false, reason: 'Stop-loss terlalu longgar: -50%' }
scenarios.failureMode: Strategy with -50% stop-loss approved — potential -50% single trade loss
scenarios.prerequisites: candidate.rules.stopLossPct = -50

scenarios.description: validateStrategyCandidate with takeProfit=300% (over 200% max) is rejected
scenarios.expectedBehavior: tp=300 > 200 → { valid: false, reason: 'Take-profit tidak realistis: 300%' }
scenarios.failureMode: Unrealistic take-profit approved — position never closes, ties up capital indefinitely
scenarios.prerequisites: candidate.rules.takeProfitPct = 300

scenarios.description: validateStrategyCandidate with positionSize=60% (over 50% max) is rejected
scenarios.expectedBehavior: posSize=60 > 50 → { valid: false, reason: 'Position size terlalu besar: 60%' }
scenarios.failureMode: Over-concentrated position approved — single trade risk exceeds portfolio safety
scenarios.prerequisites: candidate.rules.positionSizePct = 60

scenarios.description: validateStrategyCandidate with conviction=64 (below min 65) is rejected
scenarios.expectedBehavior: conv=64 < 65 → { valid: false, reason: 'Conviction terlalu rendah: 64/65' }
scenarios.failureMode: Low-conviction strategy approved — insufficient evidence leads to unreliable strategy
scenarios.prerequisites: candidate.conviction = 64

scenarios.description: validateStrategyCandidate with name shorter than 8 characters is rejected
scenarios.expectedBehavior: name.length < 8 → { valid: false, reason: contains 'min 8 karakter' }
scenarios.failureMode: Short/nonsensical strategy name approved — dashboard shows unreadable strategy names
scenarios.prerequisites: candidate.name = 'test'

scenarios.description: validateStrategyCandidate with empty evidence.sources is rejected
scenarios.expectedBehavior: evidenceSources.length === 0 → { valid: false, reason: 'Tidak ada evidence sources' }
scenarios.failureMode: No evidence requirement — strategy created from speculation, not data
scenarios.prerequisites: candidate.evidence.sources = [] or undefined

scenarios.description: validateStrategyCandidate with only signal field (no other rules) — needs 2 more rule keys
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ruleKeys (excluding signal, name, type, source) < 2 → rejected
scenarios.failureMode: Strategy with just a signal field approved — no stop-loss, take-profit, or sizing rules
scenarios.prerequisites: candidate.rules = { signal: 'some_signal' } — only 1 key, need 2+ after excluding

scenarios.description: runProAnalysis returns cached result when ANALYSIS_CACHE_TTL_MS (2 min) not expired
scenarios.expectedBehavior: If cache exists and age < 120000ms, returns _analysisCache without re-reading files
scenarios.failureMode: Stale cache returned despite data files having changed on disk — stale intelligence used
scenarios.prerequisites: runProAnalysis called once; second call within 2 minutes

scenarios.description: clearProAnalysisCache forces fresh analysis on next runProAnalysis call
scenarios.expectedBehavior: _analysisCache = null; _analysisCacheTime = 0; next call re-reads all files
scenarios.failureMode: Cache not cleared when data files change — stale regime/narrative analysis persists
scenarios.prerequisites: Any state after runProAnalysis was called

scenarios.description: Regime analysis computes score correctly: winRate*0.6 + (avgPnl>0 ? 0.4 : 0)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: winRate=0.60, avgPnl=5 → score = 0.36 + 0.4 = 0.76
scenarios.failureMode: Negative avgPnl still adds 0.4 — regime with negative PnL gets same bonus as positive
scenarios.prerequisites: regime-memory.json with trades, wins, avg_pnl_pct data

scenarios.description: Regime recommendation: winRate >= 0.55 = PREFERRED; >= 0.40 = NEUTRAL; else AVOID
scenarios.expectedBehavior: wins/trades = 0.55 -> PREFERRED; 0.40 -> NEUTRAL; 0.39 -> AVOID
scenarios.failureMode: Boundary at 0.55 off by epsilon: 0.54999 rounds to NEUTRAL, barely missing PREFERRED
scenarios.prerequisites: regime data with winRate near boundary values

scenarios.description: Narrative recommendation: winRate >= 0.50 AND rugs=0 → STRONG_BUY
scenarios.expectedBehavior: wr=0.50, rugs=0 → 'STRONG_BUY'
scenarios.failureMode: rugs=0 but winRate=0.499 → falls to 'BUY' — barely misses STRONG_BUY
scenarios.prerequisites: coin-conviction.json with narrative data

scenarios.description: Narrative rugs >= 2 produces 'AVOID' regardless of winRate
scenarios.expectedBehavior: rugs >= 2 → 'AVOID' — even if winRate is high, rug-count overrides
scenarios.failureMode: rugs=2 but winRate=0.60 → still AVOID; no exception for high-quality narratives with few rugs
scenarios.prerequisites: narrative data with rugs=2, winRate=0.60

scenarios.description: Strategy recommendation: pf >= 1.15 AND wr >= 0.50 → ACTIVE
scenarios.expectedBehavior: pf=1.15, wr=0.50 → 'ACTIVE'; pf=1.14 → 'WATCH'; wr=0.49 → 'WATCH'
scenarios.failureMode: Strategy with pf=1.14 and wr=0.55 falls to WATCH — conservative threshold blocks active use
scenarios.prerequisites: strategy-registry.json with strategy performance data

scenarios.description: Execution quality analysis correctly computes successRate per provider
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Provider with 8 successes out of 10 attempts → successRate = 0.8
scenarios.failureMode: execution-quality-memory.json has 'entries' array but providers expected — key mismatch skips analysis
scenarios.prerequisites: execution-quality-memory.json with provider data

scenarios.description: validateStrategyReadiness checks minClosedTrades=50 and fails when only 49 unique trades exist
scenarios.expectedBehavior: unique.length=49 < 50 → tradePassed=false; detail shows 49/50
scenarios.failureMode: Dedup logic (key by position_key::closed_at) is too aggressive — valid duplicate mint entries are excluded

scenarios.description: verify avgPnl computation across all trades — negative PnL summing correctly
scenarios.expectedBehavior: verified.reduce sum of pnl_pct / verified.length = correct average
scenarios.failureMode: pnl_pct vs pnlPercent field name mismatch causes some trades to have 0 PnL, skewing average
scenarios.prerequisites: Mixed pnl_pct and pnlPercent field names in trade data

scenarios.description: validateStrategyReadiness 'Regime Competence' checks all 4 required regimes exist with >=5 trades each
scenarios.expectedBehavior: seenRegimes.size >= 4, missingRegimes empty, lowTradeRegimes empty → regimePassed=true
scenarios.failureMode: Regime in regime-memory.json has 'trade_count' but code reads 'trades' — 0 detected, fails

scenarios.description: validateStrategyReadiness 'Conviction Foundation' checks minAvgObservationsPerCoin >= 5
scenarios.expectedBehavior: totalObs / coinEntries.length >= 5 → convictionPassed includes this check

scenarios.expectedBehavior: swaps computed from metrics.json counters + execution-quality.json provider records; >= 40 passes
scenarios.failureMode: Double-counting: swaps from metrics.counters.swaps_executed AND from providers both counted — inflated total
scenarios.prerequisites: metrics.json and execution-quality.json both have overlapping swap data

scenarios.description: validateStrategyReadiness 'Data Maturity' fails if data age < 30 days
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ageDays=25 < 30 → maturityPassed=false
scenarios.failureMode: oldestDate parsed incorrectly due to timezone offset — computed age off by hours

scenarios.description: validateStrategyReadiness 'Data Maturity' fails if strategy cooldown < 72 hours

scenarios.description: validateStrategyReadiness 'Data Maturity' requires >=3 files with timestamp data
scenarios.expectedBehavior: filesWithData >= 3 → part of maturityPassed check
scenarios.failureMode: Only 2 data files exist with timestamps; maturity fails despite adequate age
scenarios.prerequisites: 2 of the 5 required data files exist

scenarios.description: validateStrategyReadiness summary correctly reports blocked components count

scenarios.prerequisites: Some components failed validation

scenarios.description: getProDashboard returns null intelligence when _proModeActive is false
scenarios.expectedBehavior: _proModeActive=false → intel from runProAnalysis() is null → intelligence=null
scenarios.failureMode: Dashboard shows full intelligence even when pro mode inactive — misleading display
