scenarios.description: checkAutomationQualification when ALL requirements met — qualified=true, all 8 in passed array
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All 8 checks pass; failed array empty; qualified=true; progressPct=100
scenarios.failureMode: One requirement fails due to field name mismatch in data files — false negative
scenarios.prerequisites: All data files complete: metrics.json, trade-attribution.json, coin-conviction.json, lessons.json, rug-memory.json, market-intelligence.json, strategy-registry.json

scenarios.description: Market exposure hours check reads from multiple fallback fields in metrics.json
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reads total_market_hours || market_exposure_hours || uptime_hours || (total_cycles*5/60) || 0 (line 113-118)
scenarios.failureMode: All fields missing — defaults to 0h/1000h; fails with progress message

scenarios.description: Closed trades count reads from trade-attribution.json 'trades' array
scenarios.expectedBehavior: attribution.trades.length checked against REQUIREMENTS.minClosedTrades (500)
scenarios.failureMode: trade-attribution.json has key 'entries' instead of 'trades' — count=0, fails check
scenarios.prerequisites: trade-attribution.json exists but uses key 'entries'

scenarios.description: Conviction samples check sums observation_count across all coins AND requires min 20 unique coins
scenarios.expectedBehavior: totalSamples >= 100 AND coinList.length >= 20 → passed
scenarios.failureMode: AND logic: if 95 samples across 25 coins → fails sample count; if 100 samples across 19 coins → fails coin count
scenarios.prerequisites: coin-conviction.json with coins data

scenarios.description: Lessons learned count reads 'lessons' or 'entries' array from lessons.json
scenarios.expectedBehavior: lessons.lessons || lessons.entries || [] — both key patterns supported
scenarios.failureMode: lessons.json has key 'items' — not in fallback chain → count=0, fails
scenarios.prerequisites: lessons.json may use different key names

scenarios.description: Rug patterns count reads 'patterns' array from rug-memory.json
scenarios.expectedBehavior: rugMemory.patterns.length >= 30 → passed
scenarios.failureMode: rug-memory.json missing 'patterns' key — undefined.length throws TypeError
scenarios.prerequisites: rug-memory.json exists but structure different from expected

scenarios.description: Market regimes check uses Set over snapshots/history with condition filter
scenarios.expectedBehavior: regimes.size >= 4 includes all 4 conditions; passed list shows actual regimes
scenarios.failureMode: Empty market-intelligence.json (no snapshots/history) → regimes.size=0 → fails
scenarios.prerequisites: market-intelligence.json with market history data

scenarios.description: Win rate check slices last 100 trades and requires >=45% win rate and >=50 trades minimum
scenarios.expectedBehavior: recentTrades (last 100) filtered by pnl_pct > 0 for wins; wins/length >= 0.45 AND length >= 50
scenarios.failureMode: AND logic: 50 trades with 44% win rate → fails. 100 trades with 44% win rate → also fails. 49 trades with 45% → also fails
scenarios.prerequisites: trade-attribution.json with at least 50 trades

scenarios.description: Evolved strategies counts strategies with source='evolution' or generation > 0
scenarios.expectedBehavior: evolved.filter(s => s.source==='evolution' || s.generation > 0).length >= 3 → passed
scenarios.failureMode: Strategies evolved via different mechanism (source='evolved' misspelling) not counted
scenarios.prerequisites: strategy-registry.json with strategies data

scenarios.description: runAutomationQualification emits 'automation:proposal_ready' when first qualified
scenarios.expectedBehavior: results.qualified=true AND !_automationState.proposalSent → agentBus emits proposal_ready with proposal object
scenarios.failureMode: Proposal not emitted — user never notified that automation is ready for approval
scenarios.prerequisites: checkAutomationQualification returns qualified=true; proposalSent=false

scenarios.description: runAutomationQualification does NOT re-emit proposal if already sent (dedup)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: qualified=true and proposalSent=true → no emit; just updates state
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicate proposal sent every qualification check — user spammed with approval requests
scenarios.prerequisites: Previous qualification already set proposalSent=true

scenarios.description: approveAutomation fails if not qualified — returns { ok: false, reason }
scenarios.expectedBehavior: !_automationState.qualified → return { ok: false, reason: 'Not qualified yet' }
scenarios.failureMode: Approval goes through despite not meeting requirements — automation activated prematurely
scenarios.prerequisites: Qualification not yet met or never checked

scenarios.description: approveAutomation sets proposalApproved=true, automationActive=true, emits 'automation:activated'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: State updated; saveAutomationState called; agentBus emits 'automation:activated' with approvedAt timestamp
scenarios.failureMode: Save fails silently (catch block in saveAutomationState) — state lost on restart
scenarios.prerequisites: Qualified=true

scenarios.description: rejectAutomation resets proposalSent to false — allows future re-proposal
scenarios.expectedBehavior: proposalApproved=false; automationActive=false; proposalSent=false
scenarios.failureMode: proposalSent remains true — after reject, user is never asked again even if they want to reconsider
scenarios.prerequisites: Proposal previously sent

scenarios.description: revokeAutomation deactivates automation, emits 'automation:revoked', records reason
scenarios.expectedBehavior: automationActive=false; proposalApproved=false; revokedAt set; agentBus emits 'automation:revoked'
scenarios.failureMode: RevokedAt overwrites previously saved revoke timestamp from earlier revocation
scenarios.prerequisites: Automation was previously active

scenarios.description: guardAutomatedDecision returns allowed=false with reason when automation NOT active
scenarios.expectedBehavior: !_automationState.automationActive → { allowed: false, reason: includes progress info }
scenarios.failureMode: Guard returns allowed=true when automation not active — automated action proceeds without authorization
scenarios.prerequisites: Automation state has automationActive=false

scenarios.description: guardAutomatedDecision returns allowed=true when all conditions satisfied
scenarios.expectedBehavior: automationActive=true → { allowed: true }
scenarios.failureMode: guardAutomatedDecision bypasses proposalApproved check — only checks automationActive
scenarios.prerequisites: automationActive=true; proposalApproved=true

scenarios.description: Automation state persists across restarts via automation-state.json load/save
scenarios.expectedBehavior: loadAutomationState on module init reads file; saveAutomationState writes after each mutation
scenarios.failureMode: Corrupt automation-state.json causes all defaults — automation resets to unqualified
scenarios.prerequisites: automation-state.json exists with valid JSON

scenarios.description: Save state uses atomicWriteJson — prevents partial writes on crash
scenarios.expectedBehavior: atomicWriteJson writes to temp file then renames atomically
scenarios.failureMode: atomicWriteJson throws → catch block logs error but state changes are lost after restart
scenarios.prerequisites: Disk write failure or permission issue

scenarios.description: checkAutomationQualification handles completely missing data files gracefully
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All tryReadJson return {} or []; all checks fail with 0 or empty counts; no crash
scenarios.failureMode: tryReadJson returns null for trades attribution → null.slice(-100) in win rate check throws
scenarios.prerequisites: No data files exist (clean install)

scenarios.description: Market intelligence file exists but has no snapshots/history — regimes set empty, fails check
scenarios.expectedBehavior: marketIntel.snapshots || marketIntel.history || [] returns empty array; forEach never runs; regimes.size=0
scenarios.failureMode: forEach on empty array causes no error; regimes.size=0 correctly fails the requirement
scenarios.prerequisites: market-intelligence.json exists with empty or no snapshots array

scenarios.description: Win rate check with exactly 50 trades and exactly 45% wins — boundary test
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 50 trades, 23 wins (46%) → winRate=0.46 >= 0.45 AND recentTrades.length=50 >= 50 → passed
scenarios.failureMode: 23/50 = 0.46 but floating point shows 0.4599999... < 0.45 due to FP precision
scenarios.prerequisites: trade-attribution.json with 50 trades, 23 wins

scenarios.description: Consecutive qualification checks: first fails, then passes after data accumulates — proposalSent flips
scenarios.expectedBehavior: First call: failed → qualified=false, no proposal. Second call: all pass → qualified=true, proposal sent
scenarios.failureMode: Race: second call's checkAutomationQualification completes before first call's state update
scenarios.prerequisites: Initially missing some requirements; data files updated between calls

scenarios.description: Strategy-registry.json has 'entries' key but code reads 'strategies' — evolved count = 0
scenarios.expectedBehavior: strategyReg.strategies || strategyReg.entries || [] → both checked, entries fallback works
scenarios.failureMode: Strategy registry uses top-level array (not object) — neither strategies nor entries match
scenarios.prerequisites: strategy-registry.json is array format instead of { strategies: [...] }

scenarios.description: buildProposal generates correctly structured proposal with all required fields
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns object with title, summary, requirements, whatChanges (6 items), risks (4 items), actions, qualifiedAt
scenarios.failureMode: whatChanges or risks hardcoded — not updated when automation rules change
scenarios.prerequisites: Qualification results object

scenarios.description: HOT market condition triggers maxTokens=25 with all sources enabled via HUNTER_SCHEDULE
scenarios.expectedBehavior: When market condition is HOT, runHuntersExpedition uses schedule.active=true, sources=["all"], minScore=25, maxTokens=25
scenarios.failureMode: Missing HUNTER_SCHEDULE.HOT entry or misconfigured maxTokens would cast wrong net width
scenarios.prerequisites: Market update with condition=HOT published to agentBus

scenarios.description: COLD market condition restricts to pump.fun only, minScore=45, maxTokens=8
scenarios.expectedBehavior: runHuntersExpedition filters to pump.fun source only, requires higher minScore, returns max 8 tokens
scenarios.failureMode: COLD market may still hunt broadly if schedule entry is misconfigured or overwritten
scenarios.prerequisites: Market update with condition=COLD on bus

scenarios.description: EXTREME market disables all hunting (active=false, maxTokens=0)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Schedule returned with active=false, sources empty, no expedition runs
scenarios.failureMode: EXTREME condition not normalized before lookup; uppercase 'extreme' vs 'EXTREME' mismatch
scenarios.prerequisites: Market update with condition=EXTREME

scenarios.description: DEAD market condition pauses all hunting (active=false)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: runHuntersExpedition returns [] immediately when _currentSchedule.active===false
scenarios.failureMode: DEAD fallback to NORMAL if HUNTER_SCHEDULE.DEAD not properly set — continues hunting in dead market
scenarios.prerequisites: Market update with condition=DEAD

scenarios.description: Unknown market condition falls back to NORMAL defaults
scenarios.expectedBehavior: HUNTER_SCHEDULE lookup returns NORMAL when condition key not found; active=true, sources=["all"], maxTokens=15
scenarios.failureMode: Unknown condition could crash if HUNTER_SCHEDULE[condition] is undefined and code accesses .active on undefined
scenarios.prerequisites: Market update with unknown condition string (e.g. 'UNKNOWN' or undefined)

scenarios.description: hunters:command bus message overrides market-based schedule
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Subscribe handler sets _currentSchedule directly from cmd payload regardless of market condition
scenarios.failureMode: Race condition: market:update arrives after hunters:command and overwrites the explicit command
scenarios.prerequisites: Screening agent emits hunters:command with specific sources, then market:update fires with different condition

scenarios.description: hunters:gate_blocked pauses all hunting immediately
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Gate blocked handler sets _currentSchedule.active=false with the payload reason, overrides any market condition
scenarios.failureMode: Gate block could be missed if agentBus subscription fails or handler throws silently
scenarios.prerequisites: Kill switch or rug breaker trips, emitting hunters:gate_blocked

scenarios.description: initHuntersAgent called twice does not re-subscribe or re-initialize
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Second call returns immediately due to _initialized guard; no duplicate subscriptions
scenarios.failureMode: Missing guard would create duplicate bus subscriptions, causing prey to be emitted multiple times per expedition
scenarios.prerequisites: initHuntersAgent() called, then called again

scenarios.description: runHuntersExpedition when _currentSchedule is null uses safe defaults (minScore=30, maxTokens=15)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 85-89 check `_currentSchedule?.minScore || 30` falling back to defaults when no schedule set
scenarios.failureMode: Null _currentSchedule with no fallback for sources uses ['all'] which is correct but minScore/maxTokens may vary
scenarios.prerequisites: No market update or command received before calling runHuntersExpedition

scenarios.description: runHuntersExpedition catches expedition errors and returns empty array
scenarios.expectedBehavior: try/catch block catches, logs error, updates health, returns [] without crashing agent
scenarios.failureMode: Error in updateAgentHealth inside catch block could mask original error and crash
scenarios.prerequisites: runHunterExpedition throws (network failure, API error)

scenarios.description: Empty prey result emits nothing to bus and logs appropriately
scenarios.expectedBehavior: When prey.length === 0, no hunters:prey_ready event emitted; health updated with 0 count
scenarios.failureMode: Empty result not logged clearly; downstream agents may hang waiting for prey that never arrives
scenarios.prerequisites: No tokens found across all hunting sources

scenarios.description: Priority tokens (_hunter_score >= 50) counted and logged separately
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Priority tokens filtered and count logged: 'X priority'; top 3 printed if present
scenarios.failureMode: Scoring threshold edge: _hunter_score exactly 49.999 vs 50 — integer score may truncate differently
scenarios.prerequisites: Hunt returns mix of low and high-scoring tokens

scenarios.description: Health tracking updates after each expedition with duration and stats
scenarios.expectedBehavior: updateAgentHealth called with lastExpedition, lastPreyCount, lastDurationMs, hunterStats
scenarios.failureMode: Health update after error (catch block) only sets lastError, not lastExpedition — monitoring may show stale data
scenarios.prerequisites: Any expedition run, success or failure

scenarios.description: getHuntersPrey() delegates to getCachedPrey from hunter-agent.js
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns cached prey array; empty array if TTL expired
scenarios.failureMode: No error handling if getCachedPrey throws; direct delegation means no logging wrapper
scenarios.prerequisites: Previous expedition cached some tokens

scenarios.description: HOT market schedule sets minScore=25, catching tokens that would be missed in NORMAL (30)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Tokens with score 25-29 get through in HOT but would be blocked in NORMAL/COLD
scenarios.failureMode: No integration test verifying the same hunt produces different results under different market conditions
scenarios.prerequisites: Token pool with scores between 25-30

scenarios.description: NORMAL schedule sources=['all'] includes pump.fun despite COLD being pump.fun only
scenarios.expectedBehavior: NORMAL sources=['all'] resolves to full 7-eye hunt; COLD sources=['pumpfun'] restricts
scenarios.failureMode: The string 'all' in sources is passed verbatim to runHunterExpedition which passes to strategy.sources
scenarios.prerequisites: Market condition switches between NORMAL and COLD

scenarios.description: Prey dispatch includes marketCondition in bus event payload
scenarios.expectedBehavior: hunters:prey_ready emitted with prey, source, marketCondition, timestamp
scenarios.failureMode: Missing marketCondition in payload when _currentSchedule is null; _currentSchedule?.marketCondition || 'UNKNOWN'
scenarios.prerequisites: Expedition returns at least one token

scenarios.description: Agent registry status set to running on init and each expedition
scenarios.expectedBehavior: setAgentStatus called with AGENT_NAME='hunters' and 'running' status
scenarios.failureMode: Agent registry not imported or setAgentStatus throws; init continues silently
scenarios.prerequisites: initHuntersAgent called

scenarios.description: Gate blocked reason propagates through dashboard and health tracking
scenarios.expectedBehavior: lastGateBlock and gateBlockedAt stored via updateAgentHealth; dashboards show reason
scenarios.failureMode: Dashboard displays stale schedule if gate block is never cleared
scenarios.prerequisites: Gate_blocked event received

scenarios.description: MinScore from command overrides market default
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Explicit strategy passed to runHuntersExpedition uses its own minScore, not _currentSchedule
scenarios.failureMode: Screening agent sends cmd with different minScore than HUNTER_SCHEDULE — which takes priority depends on call path
scenarios.prerequisites: Screening agent emits hunters:command with non-default minScore

scenarios.description: No schedule set and no explicit strategy — uses _currentSchedule fallback chain
scenarios.expectedBehavior: strategy.minScore defaults to 30 (_currentSchedule?.minScore || 30), maxTokens 15, sources ['all']
scenarios.failureMode: If _currentSchedule is an object with minScore=0, the `|| 30` fallback treats 0 as falsy and uses 30 incorrectly
scenarios.prerequisites: Schedule with minScore=0 set (e.g., from EXTREME/DEAD)

scenarios.description: Agent bus subscription to market:update handles missing or malformed payload
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 54: update?.condition || 'NORMAL' protects against missing condition field
scenarios.failureMode: update is undefined/null: update?.condition returns undefined, defaults to NORMAL — may mask real market state
scenarios.prerequisites: Bus message with empty payload {} published to market:update

scenarios.description: Gate blocked event with no reason defaults gracefully
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 70: payload?.reason || 'gate_blocked' — default reason used if payload is null
scenarios.failureMode: Null payload on gate blocked would set schedule.reason='gate_blocked' — informative enough but loses context
scenarios.prerequisites: Gate_blocked event with null payload

scenarios.description: getHuntersDashboard returns schedule definitions and current state
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns agent info (name, role, initialized), current schedule, stats from getHunterStats(), and full HUNTER_SCHEDULE
scenarios.failureMode: Dashboard may show stale _currentSchedule if schedule was never set — displays null
scenarios.prerequisites: Any state of agent initialization

scenarios.description: Multiple simultaneous market:update events handled correctly (no lost updates)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each market:update triggers schedule recalculation; last one wins
scenarios.failureMode: Rapid market updates may cause async race conditions if runHuntersExpedition reads _currentSchedule mid-update
scenarios.prerequisites: Rapid market condition changes (HOT->NORMAL->COLD within seconds)

scenarios.description: Market update triggers hunters command with correct thresholds per HUNTER_TRIGGER
scenarios.expectedBehavior: HOT triggers sources=[search,pumpfun,jupiter], minScore=25, maxTokens=25 emitted to bus
scenarios.failureMode: Market condition string mismatch 'HOT' vs 'hot' causes fallback to NORMAL
scenarios.prerequisites: Market update with condition='HOT'

scenarios.description: Duplicate market condition does not re-command hunters (idempotency check)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 75: if condition === _lastMarketCondition, return early — no bus emission
scenarios.failureMode: Idempotency could cause missed updates if condition changes and quickly changes back to original
scenarios.prerequisites: Same market condition received twice consecutively

scenarios.description: DEAD market condition sends hunters:command with active=false
scenarios.expectedBehavior: HUNTER_TRIGGER.DEAD.command is false; emits hunters:command with active=false and reason
scenarios.failureMode: Missing fallthrough: if HUNTER_TRIGGER.DEAD is undefined, HUNTER_TRIGGER.NORMAL used instead
scenarios.prerequisites: Market:update with condition='DEAD'

scenarios.description: Coinective market condition uses HUNTER_TRIGGER.NORMAL as fallback
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 78: HUNTER_TRIGGER[condition] || HUNTER_TRIGGER.NORMAL — commands hunters with NORMAL params
scenarios.failureMode: Unknown condition silently maps to NORMAL; may not be appropriate if market is crashing
scenarios.prerequisites: Market update with unrecognized condition string

scenarios.description: trash:cleaned_prey received and injects tokens into screening pipeline
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Handler updates health with lastPreyReceived, preyCount, trashStats; logs passed/total ratio
scenarios.failureMode: If trash:cleaned_prey is emitted but no subscriber in screening pipeline, tokens are lost
scenarios.prerequisites: Trash layer emits trash:cleaned_prey with tokens array

scenarios.description: screening:gate_blocked pauses pipeline and logs reason
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Handler logs gate block, updates health with lastGateBlock and gateBlockedAt
scenarios.failureMode: Silent gate block: if screening:gate_blocked not emitted when gate trips, pipeline continues unsafely
scenarios.prerequisites: Gate trips (kill switch, rug breaker)

scenarios.description: runScreeningCycle checks gates before running
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Calls _checkAllGates('screening'); if blocked returns gate.reason immediately
scenarios.failureMode: If _checkAllGates not set (not initialized), code would crash on undefined is not a function
scenarios.prerequisites: initScreeningAgent must be called first

scenarios.description: runScreeningCycle error catches and returns error string without crashing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: try/catch logs error, updates health, returns 'Error: ${message}'
scenarios.failureMode: Error in log() call inside catch could mask original error
scenarios.prerequisites: _runScreeningCycle throws exception

scenarios.description: runScreeningCycle emits cycle_start event before running
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 115: agentBus.emit('screening:cycle_start') with silent flag and timestamp
scenarios.failureMode: Event emitted before gate check? No — gate check lines 105-109 run first, then event emitted at 115
scenarios.prerequisites: Gates pass, screening cycle starts

scenarios.description: runScreeningCycle when not initialized returns error string
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 100-103: if !_runScreeningCycle, log error and return 'Screening agent not initialized'
scenarios.failureMode: Caller checking return value for string 'Screening agent not initialized' is fragile
scenarios.prerequisites: Calling runScreeningCycle before initScreeningAgent

scenarios.description: Screening agent double init prevented by _initialized guard
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Second initScreeningAgent call returns immediately
scenarios.failureMode: Missing guard: _runScreeningCycle and _checkAllGates would be overwritten if re-initialized with different refs
scenarios.prerequisites: initScreeningAgent called twice

scenarios.description: onMarketUpdate when no prior condition stores it correctly
scenarios.expectedBehavior: First market update stores condition in _lastMarketCondition and emits hunters:command
scenarios.failureMode: If _lastMarketCondition starts as null and first update is 'NORMAL', hunters get NORMAL command (correct)
scenarios.prerequisites: First market update after initialization

scenarios.description: Empty trash:cleaned_prey payload with no tokens is handled gracefully
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Handler logs 0 tokens, updates health, continues without error
scenarios.failureMode: Handler might attempt to process empty tokens array; downstream pipeline might misinterpret 0 tokens as error
scenarios.prerequisites: Trash layer emits cleaned_prey with empty tokens array

scenarios.description: Market update with undefined payload defaults to NORMAL
scenarios.expectedBehavior: update?.condition || 'NORMAL' — undefined condition maps to NORMAL hunting
scenarios.failureMode: Undefined market state should arguably pause, not default to NORMAL hunting
scenarios.prerequisites: market:update emitted with undefined payload

scenarios.description: HOT market JUPITER source included in hunt command
scenarios.expectedBehavior: HUNTER_TRIGGER.HOT.sources includes 'jupiter'; NORMAL only has 'search' and 'pumpfun'
scenarios.failureMode: HOT adds Jupiter source for wider net; if Jupiter API is slow, it could delay entire expedition
scenarios.prerequisites: Market condition changes to HOT

scenarios.description: HOT vs NORMAL trigger differences correctly applied
scenarios.expectedBehavior: HOT: minScore=25, maxTokens=25, 3 sources. NORMAL: minScore=30, maxTokens=15, 2 sources
scenarios.failureMode: If HUNTER_TRIGGER entries are accidentally swapped, hunt aggressiveness is inverted
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify HUNTER_TRIGGER HOT vs NORMAL entries in source

scenarios.description: Gate blocked updateAgentHealth after screening cycle fails
scenarios.expectedBehavior: When gate blocks, health records lastGateBlock; result returned as gate.reason string
scenarios.failureMode: gate.blocked might return undefined reason; line 107 uses gate.reason without fallback
scenarios.prerequisites: Gate check returns blocked but without reason field

scenarios.description: Health lastResult truncated to 100 chars to prevent bloated state
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 121: lastResult truncated to 100 chars via slice(0, 100)
scenarios.failureMode: If result is not a string, .slice would throw — but line checks typeof result === 'string'
scenarios.prerequisites: Screening cycle returns long result string

scenarios.description: Market update from COLD to HOT correctly re-enables Jupiter source
scenarios.expectedBehavior: COLD sends command with active=true, sources=[pumpfun]; HOT sends again with active=true, sources=[search,pumpfun,jupiter]
scenarios.failureMode: Idempotency guard (condition===lastMarketCondition) correctly allows change since COLD != HOT
scenarios.prerequisites: Market goes from COLD to HOT

scenarios.description: EXTREME market sent to hunters as pause command
scenarios.expectedBehavior: HUNTER_TRIGGER.EXTREME.command=false; emits hunters:command active=false with reason 'Market EXTREME'
scenarios.failureMode: EXTREME market still allows screening to run but no new tokens come from hunters
scenarios.prerequisites: Market:update with EXTREME

scenarios.description: huntDexScreenerSearch cycles through 45+ query keywords to avoid API fatigue
scenarios.expectedBehavior: _queryIdx increments each call, modulo HUNT_QUERIES.length, query cycles through all keywords
scenarios.failureMode: Race condition: _queryIdx is a shared module-level variable, concurrent expedition calls could skip queries
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple hunt expeditions running concurrently

scenarios.description: DexScreener API failure returns empty array without crashing expedition
scenarios.expectedBehavior: fetchDS returns null on non-200; huntDexScreenerSearch checks !data?.pairs and returns []
scenarios.failureMode: fetchDS retry logic: retries once with 500ms backoff; if all retries fail, returns null
scenarios.prerequisites: DexScreener API returns 429 or 5xx

scenarios.description: DexScreener returns malformed JSON handled gracefully
scenarios.expectedBehavior: fetch: res.json() throws -> caught by try/catch -> returns null -> caller returns []
scenarios.failureMode: fetch() itself may not throw on non-JSON responses; res.json() throws, but caller checks data?.pairs which is undefined
scenarios.prerequisites: DexScreener returns HTML error page or empty body

scenarios.description: Dedup by mint across 7 hunting sources prevents duplicate tokens
scenarios.expectedBehavior: collectResults checks seenMints Set: if mint already added from any source, skip
scenarios.failureMode: Same token found by search + pumpfun sources — only first source gets credit; dedup works but source attribution skews stats
scenarios.prerequisites: Token appears in multiple source results (e.g., launched on pump.fun, found by both search and pumpfun)

scenarios.description: SOL, USDC, USDT, WSOL excluded from results via SKIP_SYMBOLS
scenarios.expectedBehavior: collectResults checks token.symbol in SKIP_SYMBOLS Set; SOL_MINT also checked explicitly
scenarios.failureMode: Case sensitivity: symbol 'sol' vs 'SOL' — check uses .toUpperCase() so case-insensitive
scenarios.prerequisites: API returns SOL or stablecoin pairs in search results

scenarios.description: MIN_LIQUIDITY ($500) filter applied to all sources
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each hunt function checks token.liquidity < MIN_LIQUIDITY before adding; newest uses MIN_LIQUIDITY * 0.5
scenarios.failureMode: Tokens with liquidity exactly $499.99 excluded; tokens with $500 (integer) included — edge is handled by >= check
scenarios.prerequisites: Tokens with liquidity near $500 threshold

scenarios.description: MIN_SWAPS (5) filter removes tokens with no real trading activity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each source filters token.swaps < MIN_SWAPS; gainers use MIN_SWAPS * 3 for stricter filter
scenarios.failureMode: Tokens with swaps === 4 excluded; a legitimate token that just passed 5 swaps is included — border cases matter
scenarios.prerequisites: Token pool with low-swap tokens

scenarios.description: Age filter: tokens < 5 min old excluded from all hunting
scenarios.expectedBehavior: MIN_TOKEN_AGE_MINUTES=5; tokens younger skipped to avoid snipe-launch tokens
scenarios.failureMode: Token with no created_at timestamp passes age filter (condition checks token.created_at exists first)
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with no created_at field vs token aged 4 minutes

scenarios.description: Age filter: tokens > 7 days old excluded
scenarios.expectedBehavior: MAX_TOKEN_AGE_HOURS=168; tokens created > 7 days ago filtered out
scenarios.failureMode: No created_at timestamp: token passes age filter entirely, could be a very old token that was just rediscovered
scenarios.prerequisites: Very old token with missing created_at field

scenarios.description: computeHunterScore ranges from 0-100 with 6 weighted dimensions
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Liquidity (25) + Volume (25) + Buy/Sell ratio (15) + Token age (15) + MCAP (10) + pump.fun bonus (5) + Narrative match (5) = 100 max
scenarios.failureMode: Score can exceed 100 if dimensions are not properly capped; Math.min(100, score) protects at end
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with perfect scores across all dimensions

scenarios.description: Liquidity depth scoring correctly maps thresholds to points
scenarios.failureMode: Score 0 for liq>=50000 means 'no penalty' but could be confusing for dashboard; 0 is correct behavior
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with very deep liquidity >$50k

scenarios.description: Volume quality scoring with swap count multiplier
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Vol>=100k && swaps>=100 → 25pts, Vol>=10k && swaps>=20 → 18pts, Vol>=1k && swaps>=5 → 10pts
scenarios.failureMode: High volume with very few swaps (1 trade of $100k) gets 0pts — correctly treats as suspicious
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with high volume but very few swaps

scenarios.description: Buy/sell ratio scoring: balanced (0.4-0.6) = 15pts, acceptable (0.3-0.7) = 8pts, unbalanced = 3pts
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ComputeHunterScore checks token.buys/total ratio and scores accordingly
scenarios.failureMode: Edge case: total=0 leads to divide-by-zero? Line 148 checks total > 0 before division
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with 100% buys or 100% sells

scenarios.description: pump.fun ecosystem bonus adds 5 points for DEX matches
scenarios.expectedBehavior: DEX ID containing 'pumpswap', 'pump.fun', 'pumpfun', 'pump', 'pump swap' gets +5
scenarios.failureMode: New DEX aggregator that routes through pump.fun may not match; false negatives
scenarios.prerequisites: Token launched on pump.fun but DEX ID is a variant not in list

scenarios.description: huntGainers filters: min 5% price movement, skips if >500% 1h or >1000% 6h
scenarios.expectedBehavior: maxChange < 5 → skip; change1h > 500 or change6h > 1000 → skip (already pumped)
scenarios.failureMode: Token pumped 400% in 1h but now dumping: change1h=400 (still <500) so not skipped, potentially buying top
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with aggressive pump just below 500% threshold

scenarios.description: huntNewest fetches token profiles API first, then batch-fetches pair data
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Fetch /token-profiles/latest/v1 → filter Solana → batch query /latest/dex/tokens/{mints}
scenarios.failureMode: Token profiles API changes format or returns empty; array check needs Array.isArray
scenarios.prerequisites: Token profiles endpoint available and returning data

scenarios.description: huntNewest limits to tokens < 6 hours old only
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ageMin > 360 minutes → skip (not newest anymore)
scenarios.failureMode: Token creation timestamp in milliseconds vs seconds: ageMin calculation assumes seconds, if timestamp is ms the age is massively inflated
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with created_at in milliseconds rather than seconds

scenarios.description: huntGeckoTerminal with different data shape than DexScreener
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Maps GeckoTerminal response attributes to unified token format; fallback defaults for missing fields
scenarios.failureMode: GeckoTerminal API response structure may change (nested attributes, different field names); mapping fragile
scenarios.prerequisites: GeckoTerminal trending pools endpoint returning valid data

scenarios.description: huntGeckoTerminal handles missing mint gracefully
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Multiple fallbacks for mint extraction: relationships.base_token.data.id → attrs.address → null; skip if null
scenarios.failureMode: GeckoTerminal changes response format — all mints become null, Gecko source returns 0 tokens silently
scenarios.prerequisites: GeckoTerminal response with different nesting structure

scenarios.description: huntSmartMoney imports dexscreener.js dynamically to avoid circular dependency
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Dynamic import at call time, not module load time — getSmartMoneyInflow called once per expedition
scenarios.failureMode: Dynamic import failing silently: catch block returns [] — smart money source drops out without alert
scenarios.prerequisites: Previous hunt succeeded, smart money wallet tracking active

scenarios.description: Smart money tokens get base score of 40 + wallet count and buy ratio bonuses
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Base 40, +25 for >=3 wallets, +18 for 2, +10 for 1, +15 for >=0.8 buy ratio, +10 for weighted score >3
scenarios.failureMode: Score boost from smart money can push low-liquidity tokens to PRIORITY tier — may inject risky low-liq tokens
scenarios.prerequisites: Smart money wallets tracked with buy activity

scenarios.description: huntJupiter with no token list from Jupiter API returns empty gracefully
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Check !Array.isArray(jupTokens) || jupTokens.length === 0 → return []
scenarios.failureMode: Jupiter API might return an object with tokens key instead of array; type check catches it
scenarios.prerequisites: Jupiter quote API returning non-array response

scenarios.description: Concurrent expedition guard prevents overlapping hunts
scenarios.expectedBehavior: _hunterRunning flag checked at line 609; if true, returns [] immediately
scenarios.failureMode: Race condition: two expeditions queued simultaneously both see _hunterRunning=false and proceed
scenarios.prerequisites: Long-running expedition in progress when cron fires again

scenarios.description: _hunterRunning correctly reset in finally block on exception
scenarios.expectedBehavior: finally block at line 701 sets _hunterRunning = false regardless of success/failure
scenarios.failureMode: If _hunterRunning is set to true and finally block is somehow skipped (process.exit?), bot stops hunting permanently
scenarios.prerequisites: Expedition throws unhandled exception (not caught by try/catch)

scenarios.description: All 7 sources are run in parallel via Promise.allSettled
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 7 parallel Promise.allSettled calls: search, pumpfun, gainers, newest, gecko, smartmoney, jupiter
scenarios.failureMode: One slow source (e.g., GeckoTerminal 8s timeout) delays collection but doesn't block others due to allSettled
scenarios.prerequisites: All 7 sources configured and available

scenarios.description: collectResults handles non-array values gracefully (allSettled rejection)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Checks results.status === 'fulfilled' && Array.isArray(results.value); returns 0 if not
scenarios.failureMode: Fulfilled but value is null -> second check catches it; correctly returns 0 added
scenarios.prerequisites: Promise settles fulfilled but returns null instead of array

scenarios.description: Token sorting: by hunter score desc, then liquidity desc
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Sort comparator: if scores differ, higher score first; if equal, higher liquidity first
scenarios.failureMode: Tokens with equal score and liquidity stay in insertion order (not stable sort guaranteed by V8)
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple tokens with identical scores and liquidity

scenarios.description: Hunting stats accumulate across expeditions
scenarios.expectedBehavior: _hunterStats.cycles++, totalFound += allTokens.length, priorityFound += priorityTokens.length
scenarios.failureMode: Stats accumulate unbounded — no reset or pruning mechanism for long-running bots
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple expedition cycles

scenarios.description: Prey cache TTL of 10 minutes: expired cache returns empty array
scenarios.expectedBehavior: getCachedPrey checks if Date.now() - cachedAt > 10 min; if so, resets cache to []
scenarios.failureMode: If _preyCachedAt is set but Date parsing fails, comparison may be wrong; uses new Date(string).getTime()
scenarios.prerequisites: Cache set, then 10+ minutes pass

scenarios.description: injectHunterPrey filters by minScore >= 25 and max 15 injections
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Filters hunterTokens to _hunter_score >= 25, then slices to maxInject(15); dedup by mint against screeningTokens
scenarios.failureMode: If hunterTokens has scores but no _hunter_score field (older format), all are rejected — injects 0
scenarios.prerequisites: Hunter expedition produced tokens but they lack _hunter_score field

scenarios.description: injectHunterPrey with empty screeningTokens still returns hunter tokens
scenarios.expectedBehavior: existingMints set built from screeningTokens (empty); newPrey filtered and returned
scenarios.failureMode: If screeningTokens is null, line 716 uses null?.map which returns undefined; spread at 728 handles via || []
scenarios.prerequisites: Null screening tokens array

scenarios.description: huntPumpFun uses 2 parallel DexScreener queries for broader coverage
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Promise.allSettled on two queries: search?q=sol and search?q=meme; results merged with dedup
scenarios.failureMode: Both queries may return overlapping results — dedup via seen Set handles correctly
scenarios.prerequisites: DexScreener API available

scenarios.description: Gainer tokens boosted by momentum score (max +10 for % move/10)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: hunterScore.score + Math.min(10, maxChange/10); a 50% mover gets +5, 100%+ mover gets +10
scenarios.failureMode: Already-pumped tokens filtered (change1h>500 or change6h>1000) but within range, boost may overvalue
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with strong 1h price movement (e.g., 80%)

scenarios.description: GeckoTerminal sorts by volume descending, not by score
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 447: sort by (b.volume || 0) - (a.volume || 0) — highest volume first
scenarios.failureMode: Inconsistent sorting strategy: Gecko uses volume, main sort uses score; order in final merge depends on main sort
scenarios.prerequisites: Gecko source returns multiple tokens

scenarios.description: mapPair sets _hunter_source based on which hunt function called it
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each hunt function calls mapPair(pair, 'source_name') where source is 'search:query', 'pumpfun', 'gainers', etc.
scenarios.failureMode: Multiple hunt functions call mapPair — source tracking enables debugging per-source contribution
scenarios.prerequisites: Any hunt function runs

scenarios.description: 25+ KNOWN_SCAM_PATTERNS match across multi-language scam keywords
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Patterns for Chinese, Russian, Korean, Spanish scam terms; honeypot naming patterns; zero-width char detection; pump keywords; AI-gibberish patterns
scenarios.failureMode: Line 38: Chinese pattern uses specific characters; new variant not in list passes through undetected
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with Chinese scam keywords in name/symbol

scenarios.description: Weight >= 8 scam patterns cause hard block; lower weight only flags
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Lines 163-173: if weight >= 8, scamBlocked=true and token skipped; else token._trash_flags pushed
scenarios.failureMode: Pattern weight 8 is hard block threshold; pattern weight 7 only flags — single point difference is arbitrary
scenarios.prerequisites: Token matching weight-7 pattern (e.g., testnet pattern weight=8, while coin.*coin weight=4)

scenarios.description: Copycat detection against 20+ legitimate Solana projects
scenarios.expectedBehavior: LEGITIMATE_PROJECTS array checked via symbol match; micro-cap copycats (mcap < $100k) blocked as impersonation
scenarios.failureMode: New legitimate project not in list (e.g., new memecoin) — copycat of that project is not detected
scenarios.prerequisites: Token impersonating a well-known project not in LEGITIMATE_PROJECTS list

scenarios.description: researchTokenOnline catches liquidity traps: high liq + zero volume
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 104-111: liquidity > $10k and volume=0 and swaps=0 → 'liquidity_trap' critical flag → block
scenarios.failureMode: Legitimate token with locked liquidity that happens to have 0 volume for short period gets falsely blocked
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with large LP but no trading activity yet

scenarios.description: High liquidity + low swaps detected as wash traded
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 96-102: liquidity > $1k and swaps < 10 → 'suspicious_activity' high flag
scenarios.failureMode: Token that just launched and has initial LP seeding but no organic swaps yet gets flagged as wash trading
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with seeded LP but very few swaps

scenarios.description: researchTokenOnline catch block ensures research failure does not block pipeline
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Empty catch block at line 113: any error in research returns empty flags, pipeline continues
scenarios.failureMode: Best-effort research: all API calls fail silently, no flags generated, trash passes through without online verification
scenarios.prerequisites: DexScreener API unavailable or timeout

scenarios.description: Token age anomaly: <2min old with >$100k liquidity flagged but not blocked
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Lines 228-236: ageMin < 2 && liquidity > 100000 → anomaly flag added to _trash_flags, token still passes
scenarios.failureMode: Such tokens are extremely suspicious (flash rug potential) but only flagged, not blocked — could slip through downstream
scenarios.prerequisites: Token aged 90 seconds with $200k liquidity

scenarios.description: RugCheck score >= 60 or critical risks >= 1 blocks the token
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Lines 211-215: signals.rug_score >= 60 || signals.critical_risks >= 1 → rugCheckBlocked++ and continue
scenarios.failureMode: RugCheck API failure (line 224 catch) silently passes the token through without any RugCheck verification
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with RugCheck score 60+ and RugCheck API available

scenarios.description: Honeypot detection via RugCheck risk names blocks immediately
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Lines 218-222: risk.name includes 'honeypot', 'freeze', or 'mint' → honeypotBlocked++
scenarios.failureMode: Case sensitivity in risk.name check: risk.name 'Honeypot' (capitalized) vs 'honeypot' — .includes is case-sensitive
scenarios.prerequisites: RugCheck returned risk with name 'Honeypot Detection' (capital H)

scenarios.description: Copycat variant with suffix detected and blocked via LEGITIMATE_PROJECTS match
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Lines 86-92: symbol startsWith legit project but not identical, and liq < $5k → copycat_variant high flag
scenarios.failureMode: Partial match: 'BONK2' matches BONK, but 'BONKER' also matches BONK startsWith — false positive on unrelated project
scenarios.prerequisites: Token symbol like 'BONK2' with low liquidity

scenarios.description: preScreenBatch call passes rugMemory and recentRugs context to trash-filter
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 195: getRugMemory() and getPerformanceHistory() fetched; passed to preScreenBatch for context-aware scoring
scenarios.failureMode: getRugMemory or getPerformanceHistory throws — line 196 calls preScreenBatch which could fail
scenarios.prerequisites: Rug memory file corrupted or unreadable

scenarios.description: trash:all_blocked event emitted when no tokens survive filtering
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Lines 144-146: if cleaned.length === 0, emit trash:all_blocked with total and timestamp
scenarios.failureMode: Empty blocked: downstream agents waiting for cleaned_prey may hang; all_blocked listeners must be present
scenarios.prerequisites: All incoming prey tokens blocked by trash layer

scenarios.description: Zero-width character detection blocks tokens with invisible chars
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Pattern /[​-‍﻿]/ (zero-width space, joiner, non-joiner) weight=10 → hard blocks any token with these chars
scenarios.failureMode: Some legitimate tokens may use zero-width chars in name for branding; blocked incorrectly
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with zero-width characters in name

scenarios.description: 4+ non-ASCII character pattern flags suspicious international scam names
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Pattern /[^\x00-\x7F]{4,}/ weight=5: token name with 4+ non-ASCII chars gets flagged
scenarios.failureMode: Legitimate international token with Japanese/Korean name gets flagged as suspicious
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with 4+ Unicode characters in symbol

scenarios.description: All 25+ knowledge bases applied sequentially in filterPreyAdvanced
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Steps 1-5: scam patterns, online research, pre-screen batch, RugCheck, age anomaly — each layer filters or flags
scenarios.failureMode: If any step throws unexpectedly, the token processing for that iteration may break (no catch around entire per-token loop)
scenarios.prerequisites: Any token passing through trash layer

scenarios.description: 7 scoring dimensions with correct max points per dimension
scenarios.expectedBehavior: liquidity(25) + supply(20) + age(15) + priceAction(20) + nameHygiene(10) + feeIntegrity(15) + distribution(15) = 120 theoretical max, clamped to 100
scenarios.failureMode: Maximum raw score = 120 but finalScore clamped to 100 — market multiplier at 1.0 means scores >100 are possible before clamping
scenarios.prerequisites: Token scoring across all dimensions

scenarios.description: Market-condition multipliers adjust thresholds per regime
scenarios.expectedBehavior: EXTREME: 1.30, HOT: 0.85, NORMAL: 1.00, COLD: 1.15, DEAD: 1.40 — higher multiplier means more restrictive
scenarios.failureMode: DEAD multiplier 1.40 means a raw score of 71 becomes 100 (BLOCKED) — tokens that would be WARN in NORMAL get BLOCKED in DEAD
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with raw score ~71 in DEAD market

scenarios.description: Tier boundaries: ALLOW(0-25), FLAG(26-50), WARN(51-75), BLOCK(76-100)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: tierFor: <=25 ALLOW, <=50 FLAG, <=75 WARN, >75 BLOCK
scenarios.failureMode: Score exactly 25: ALLOW (<=25). Score 25.5: FLAG (>25). Integer scoring avoids fractional edge cases
scenarios.prerequisites: Token scoring exactly at tier boundary

scenarios.description: Hard-block gates: missing mint, dust liquidity, zero swaps, dust MCAP
scenarios.expectedBehavior: checkHardBlocks: !token.mint → block; liq < $500 → block; swaps < 1 → block; mcap > 0 && mcap < $1000 → block
scenarios.failureMode: MCAP check is `mcap > 0 && mcap < MIN_MCAP_USD` — if mcap is 0 (unknown), token passes because first condition fails
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with mcap=0 (not yet tracked)

scenarios.description: Supply data missing or zero forces block with reason
scenarios.expectedBehavior: checkHardBlocks: supply <= 0 or not finite → 'supply_invalid' block
scenarios.failureMode: Token with extremely large supply (1e12) passes, but potentially a dilution risk
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with supply = 0 or null

scenarios.description: Token age < 30 seconds hard-blocked as 'too_young'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: computeAgeSeconds < 30 → hard block with reason including seconds old
scenarios.failureMode: Token with no created_at passes this gate entirely (ageSec===null, checked only if ageSec !== null)
scenarios.prerequisites: Token under 30 seconds old with creation timestamp

scenarios.description: 5m price change > 1500% triggers hard block as 'already gone'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: checkHardBlocks: Math.abs(p5m) > MAX_PRICE_CHANGE_5M_PCT (1500) → block
scenarios.failureMode: Token pumped 1501% in 5m blocked; 1499% passes to dimension scoring (but gets 20pts in priceAction for >1500 anyway)
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with extreme 5m price movement

scenarios.description: Blacklisted tokens from rug memory are hard-blocked
scenarios.expectedBehavior: checkHardBlocks: rugMemory.blacklisted_tokens.includes(token.mint) → 'blacklisted_token'
scenarios.failureMode: rugMemory is optional — if null/undefined, blacklist check is skipped entirely
scenarios.prerequisites: Token previously recorded as rug in rug-memory.json

scenarios.description: Blacklisted devs from rug memory block all new tokens from same creator
scenarios.expectedBehavior: checkHardBlocks: rugMemory.blacklisted_devs.includes(token.creator) → 'blacklisted_dev'
scenarios.failureMode: Creator address stored with different case or format in token vs rug memory — string match fails
scenarios.prerequisites: Creator previously rugged another token, new token from same creator

scenarios.description: LP/MCAP ratio < 2% flagged as rug-prone (score +8)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreLiquidity: lpRatio < 0.02 → +8 pts and 'rug-prone' reason
scenarios.failureMode: LP/MCAP ratio 0.0199 gives +8; ratio 0.0200 passes to next tier (+4) — thin margin for significant scoring diff
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with liquidity much lower than market cap

scenarios.description: LP/MCAP ratio > 80% flagged as over-collateralized honeypot
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreLiquidity: lpRatio > 0.80 → +3 pts and 'over-collateralized, possible honeypot' reason
scenarios.failureMode: Legitimate token with LP=MCAP (no price discovery yet) incorrectly flagged as honeypot
scenarios.prerequisites: Token where 100% of market cap is in LP (very new token)

scenarios.description: Supply scoring: near-zero token price triggers dilution risk penalty
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreSupply: mcap/supply < 1e-9 → +6 pts 'massive supply dilution'; < 1e-7 → +3 pts 'very low token price'
scenarios.failureMode: Token with mcap=0 (unknown): pricePerToken = 0/supply = 0; 0 < 1e-9 true → adds dilution points even without data
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with unknown market cap but known supply

scenarios.description: Whale-sized avg buy triggers supply concentration +5
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreSupply: avgBuySize > $10k → +5 pts 'whale-sized avg buy'; > $5k → +3pts 'large avg buy'
scenarios.failureMode: Single legitimate whale buying during distribution phase triggers concentration penalty
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with one large buyer making multiple purchases

scenarios.description: Extreme buy imbalance (>90% buys) detected as self-buying +6
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreSupply: h1Buys/h1Total > 0.90 → +6 pts 'likely self-buying'
scenarios.failureMode: Legitimate token in organic accumulation phase (strong buying pressure) incorrectly penalized
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with h1 buys > 90% of total transactions

scenarios.description: Age scoring: brand new token (<30s) gets max 15 pts 'insufficient data'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreAge: ageSec < 30 → full 15 pts + 'insufficient data' reason
scenarios.failureMode: Token 29 seconds old gets 15 pts; token 31 seconds old gets 12 pts — abrupt cliff at 30s boundary
scenarios.prerequisites: Token aged exactly 30 seconds

scenarios.description: Sniper frenzy detection: >30 swaps/min on token <1h old gets +5
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreAge: swapsPerMin > 30 → +5 'sniper frenzy'; >15 → +3 'elevated velocity'
scenarios.failureMode: Token with organic bot trading (arbitrageurs) may show >30 swaps/min — false positive 'sniper frenzy'
scenarios.prerequisites: Token under 1 hour old with high swap velocity

scenarios.description: 5m divergence pattern: 5m↑ + 1h↓ = exit liquidity trap
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scorePriceAction: p5m > 100 && p1h < -30 → +8 pts 'exit liquidity trap'
scenarios.failureMode: Token recovering from a dip (5m green, 1h still red) incorrectly flagged as exit liquidity trap
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with >100% 5m pump but -30%+ 1h drop

scenarios.description: Name hygiene: unicode spam symbol hard-scored at 10 pts + block
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreNameHygiene: isUnicodeSpam(true) → return {score:10, block:true}
scenarios.failureMode: Token with legitimate accented character (e.g., 'Cafecito Token') may trigger >30% non-ASCII threshold
scenarios.prerequisites: Token symbol with >30% non-ASCII characters

scenarios.description: All-caps spam detection for tokens with 20+ char all-caps symbols
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreNameHygiene: isAllCapsSpam → symbol === symbol.toUpperCase() && /^[A-Z0-9_]+$/ && length >= 20 → 10 pts + block
scenarios.failureMode: Blocked only if length >= 20; all-caps symbol with length 19 passes through — arbitrary boundary
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with 19-char all-caps symbol

scenarios.description: Fee integrity: avg trade fee < $0.001 flagged as impossible-to-be-organic dust
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreVolume: expectedFee < 0.001 → +12 pts 'dust, impossible to be organic'
scenarios.failureMode: Token with extremely low price but legitimate volume (e.g., 0.0000001 SOL/token) — every trade is small absolute value
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with many small-value trades

scenarios.description: Swap storm detection: swap/vol ratio > 0.1 = wash trading
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreVolume: swapVolRatio > 0.1 → +10 pts 'swap storm, wash'; > 0.05 → +6 'suspicious'; > 0.02 → +2 'elevated'
scenarios.failureMode: Legitimate memecoin with many small retail trades could have high swap/vol ratio — false wash positive
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with many small trades relative to total volume

scenarios.description: Bot pump signature: very few swaps for very high volume
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreVolume: swapVolRatio < 0.0005 && swaps < 10 && vol > $50k → +10 'bot pump signature'
scenarios.failureMode: Legitimate whale making few large trades arrives at token — triggers bot pump detection
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with 2 swaps totaling $100k volume

scenarios.description: Distribution scoring: pump > 300% 1h then dump > 20% 5m = distribution trap
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreDistribution: p1h > 300 && p5m < -20 → +12 pts 'pump & dump distribution'
scenarios.failureMode: Token pumping 300% then correcting 20% is natural price discovery in volatile memecoins — not necessarily distribution
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with classic pump-and-dump pattern

scenarios.description: Boost/Ads AFTER pump (>100%) = distribution signal
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreDistribution: token.boosts > 0 && priceChange1h > 100 → +10 pts Boost distribution signal
scenarios.failureMode: Boost before pump gets negative score (reward), boost after pump gets +10 — timing is everything but hard to verify
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with boost count > 0 and >100% 1h pump

scenarios.description: Many buyers + falling price = whales distributing into buy pressure
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreDistribution: h1Buys > 50 && p1h < -30 → +10 pts 'whales distributing into buyers'
scenarios.failureMode: Token with strong sell pressure that also has many buyers (natural market) flagged as distribution
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with >50 buys/hour and >30% price drop

scenarios.description: Volume 10x MCAP detection for manufactured volume
scenarios.expectedBehavior: scoreVolume: vol/mcap > 10 → +8 'manufactured'; >5 → +5 'suspicious'; >2 → +2 'elevated'
scenarios.failureMode: Token with small MCAP but genuine viral volume (e.g., MCAP $5k, vol $100k) flagged as manufactured
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with volume/MCAP ratio > 10

scenarios.description: outerShieldScreen flow: RugCheck summary batch -> hard block -> extension check -> trash scoring
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Step 1: rugCheckBatchScreen; Step 2: hard-block critical/scores >= 60; Step 3: token-2022 extension check; Step 4: scoreTrash + rugcheck dimension
scenarios.failureMode: RugCheck API down: all 4 steps skip, tokens pass through with only trash scoring — no outer shield
scenarios.prerequisites: Tokens being screened with RugCheck API available

scenarios.description: Token-2022 extension check: freeze authority = instant block
scenarios.expectedBehavior: checkTokenExtensions: rugReport.freeze_authority true → block=true, reason mentions freeze
scenarios.failureMode: RugCheck report format changes — freeze_authority field renamed, check misses it
scenarios.prerequisites: Token-2022 token with freeze authority enabled

scenarios.description: Token-2022 permanent delegate detection blocks token confiscation risk
scenarios.expectedBehavior: checkTokenExtensions: risk.name includes 'permanent_delegate' → block=true, Indonesian warning
scenarios.failureMode: Risk description in Indonesian: user-facing messages may confuse English-speaking operators
scenarios.prerequisites: Token-2022 with permanent delegate

scenarios.description: Token-2022 non-transferable check blocks soulbound tokens
scenarios.expectedBehavior: checkTokenExtensions: risk includes 'non_transferable' or 'soulbound' → block=true
scenarios.failureMode: Non-transferable tokens are legitimate for certain use cases (identity, governance) but Ponyou cannot sell them — correct to block
scenarios.prerequisites: Non-transferable token-2022

scenarios.description: Helius rate limiter prevents API abuse with 2 concurrent slots, 1.5s interval
scenarios.expectedBehavior: heliusAcquire: waits for inflight slot; calculates next available timeslot; sleeps if needed
scenarios.failureMode: Helius free tier burst capacity exceeded: sequential fetches spaced 1.5s apart, max 2 concurrent
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple concurrent callers requesting Helius data

scenarios.description: Helius circuit breaker opens after 3 consecutive 429s for 5 minutes
scenarios.expectedBehavior: helius429Hit increments streak; at threshold 3, sets CB open for 5 min; heliusAcquire throws immediately
scenarios.failureMode: Circuit stays open for full 5 min even after Helius recovers — must wait cooldown or manual reset
scenarios.prerequisites: 3 consecutive Helius 429 responses

scenarios.description: Helius success resets 429 streak and closes circuit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: heliusSuccess: sets _helius429Streak=0; if circuit was open, closes it and logs
scenarios.failureMode: Circuit closed after single success even if underlying rate issue persists — may oscillate open/close
scenarios.prerequisites: Circuit open due to 429s, then a success response arrives

scenarios.description: Shyft fallback used when Helius circuit is open
scenarios.expectedBehavior: gatherRugSignals: if heliusCircuitOpen and SHYFT_API_KEY configured, call getFreshFundedCountShyft
scenarios.failureMode: Shyft API may have different data quality; fallback marked as 'helius_circuit_open:shyft_fallback_used' in reason
scenarios.prerequisites: Helius circuit open, Shyft key configured

scenarios.description: DexScreener-only mode skips all Helius/Shyft wallet analysis
scenarios.expectedBehavior: SCREENING_MODE === 'dexscreener' → skip fresh holders, sybil, bundle checks; _data_quality='dexscreener'
scenarios.failureMode: This mode disables all on-chain behavioral signals; only DexScreener LP lock + wash trade remain
scenarios.prerequisites: SCREENING_MODE env var set to 'dexscreener'

scenarios.description: Fresh funded holder detection with 24-hour window from launch
scenarios.expectedBehavior: getFreshFundedCount: checks if earliest SOL funding of each top 8 holder is within launchTs +/- maxAgeHours
scenarios.failureMode: Helius txns fetch may miss early transactions (rate limited) — fresh holder count could be under-reported
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with holder owners array and launch timestamp

scenarios.description: Sybil cluster detection: top holders funded by same wallet = cluster signal
scenarios.expectedBehavior: getSameFunderCluster: for top 10 holders, find earliest SOL funder; cluster count = max holders sharing funder
scenarios.failureMode: Legitimate CEX withdrawal: multiple holders funded from same CEX hot wallet appear as sybil cluster
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with holders and Helius API available

scenarios.description: Bundle buyer detection: % of supply bought in first 60s of pool creation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: getBundleBuyersPct: fetch SWAP txns within launchTs + 60s window; count distinct receivers as bundle heuristic
scenarios.failureMode: Window too narrow: professional sniper bots may buy within seconds; 60s captures most but could miss fast snipes
scenarios.prerequisites: Token mint and pool creation timestamp

scenarios.description: Bundle heuristic: >1 distinct receiver in one tx = bundle buy activity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: getBundleBuyersPct: distinctReceivers.size > 1 means bundle tx; all associated buys counted as bundle
scenarios.failureMode: Airdrop distribution: contract distributing to multiple wallets in one tx is also >1 receiver — false bundle positive
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with early distribution transaction

scenarios.description: Wash trade scoring: extreme buy/sell imbalance with low unique traders
scenarios.expectedBehavior: getWashTradeScore: buys/sells ratio > 5 or < 0.2 → +30; >3 or < 0.33 → +15; micro-trades add +10
scenarios.failureMode: Total < 20 transactions returns wash_score=0 immediately — tokens with 19 txns get a pass on wash analysis
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with >20 h1 transactions

scenarios.description: extractFeatureVector produces 17 boolean features from rug signals
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Features: high_top10, fresh_holders, dust_holders, has_freeze, has_mint, creator_heavy, bundle_buy, bundled_launch, top20_concentrated, same_funder, transfer_fee_high, transfer_hook, permanent_delegate, non_transferable, default_frozen, lp_unlocked, wash_trade
scenarios.failureMode: Adding new feature requires updating both extractFeatureVector AND toNumericVector in rug-anomaly.js
scenarios.prerequisites: Rug signals object with any fields

scenarios.description: learnPatterns requires minimum 3 rugs before pattern learning activates
scenarios.expectedBehavior: MIN_OCCURRENCES_TO_LEARN = 3; rugs.length < 3 → return {learned:0, note:'not enough history'}
scenarios.failureMode: New bot: must accumulate 3 rug entries before pattern learning starts — cold start period with no learned protection
scenarios.prerequisites: rug-memory.json with 0-2 entries

scenarios.description: Confidence scoring formula balances support, breadth, and count
scenarios.expectedBehavior: computeConfidence: 22% base + (support * 0.38) + (breadth * 0.18) + (countScore * 0.22); clamped 0.15-0.95
scenarios.failureMode: Pattern with count=3 and support=100% gets high confidence even if it's a coincidence
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple rug entries with overlapping feature vectors

scenarios.description: Auto-approval: confidence >= 0.8 AND count >= 5 promotes pattern automatically
scenarios.expectedBehavior: learnPatterns: reviewed = confidence >= 0.8 && count >= 5 → weight up to 35, review_status='approved'
scenarios.failureMode: Auto-approval bypasses human review for patterns that may be coincidental (5 rugs sharing 1 common feature)
scenarios.prerequisites: 5+ rug entries with high-confidence feature overlap

scenarios.description: Unreviewed patterns capped at 18 weight vs approved 35 weight
scenarios.expectedBehavior: UNREVIEWED_WEIGHT_CAP=18, LEARNED_WEIGHT_CAP=35; pending patterns have lower max scoring impact
scenarios.failureMode: Soft patterns still contribute up to 18 score points — enough to push a token from WARN to BLOCK
scenarios.prerequisites: Token matching only unreviewed learned patterns

scenarios.description: matchPatterns combines seed + learned patterns, matching all features with AND logic
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All required features must match (every): if pattern has features [A,B], token must have both A and B true
scenarios.failureMode: AND logic is strict: pattern with 3+ features requires all 3 to match — a rug with 2/3 features is missed
scenarios.prerequisites: Token matching some but not all features of a known pattern

scenarios.description: RugCheck report request with 2 retries and exponential backoff
scenarios.expectedBehavior: fetchRugCheck: retries up to 2 times with 1.2s * i delay; 429 triggers 4s * i extended delay
scenarios.failureMode: RugCheck free API rate limit: at scale (100+ tokens), sequential fetches with delays may hold up pipeline
scenarios.prerequisites: RugCheck endpoint available

scenarios.description: 404 token (not indexed) returns gracefully, not an error
scenarios.expectedBehavior: fetchRugCheck: 404 → return { not_found: true }; getRugCheckReport returns { indexed: false }
scenarios.failureMode: Very new tokens not indexed by RugCheck pass through without any RugCheck verification
scenarios.prerequisites: Token not yet indexed by RugCheck.xyz

scenarios.description: RugCheck report maps risk levels to score_impact: critical=30, danger=15, warn=5
scenarios.expectedBehavior: getRugCheckReport: each risk mapped with score_impact based on level; total_risk_score accumulated
scenarios.failureMode: New risk level not in {critical, danger, warn} falls through → score_impact undefined; not catastrophic since used only for total
scenarios.prerequisites: RugCheck report with risks array

scenarios.description: Batch screen processes tokens in chunks of 8 to avoid rate limits
scenarios.expectedBehavior: rugCheckBatchScreen: tokens split into chunks of 8; each chunk processed via Promise.all for parallelism
scenarios.failureMode: Chunks processed sequentially: chunk 1 (8 tokens) -> wait all -> chunk 2. Total time: (n/8) * max_per_token_latency
scenarios.prerequisites: 10+ tokens being batch-screened

scenarios.description: RugCheck cache capped at 500 entries with LRU eviction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: putCache: after .set(), if size > 500, find oldest entry (sorted by ts) and delete it
scenarios.failureMode: LRU eviction sorts full cache entries each time — O(500 log 500) sort per eviction, may slow down at scale
scenarios.prerequisites: Cache filled with 500+ entries

scenarios.description: Anomaly detection requires 10+ rug corpus to produce scores
scenarios.expectedBehavior: detectAnomaly: corpus.length < 10 → return {anomaly_score:0, anomaly_detected:false}
scenarios.failureMode: First 9 rugs: anomaly detection is silent; no protection against novel rug patterns until corpus grows
scenarios.prerequisites: rug-memory.json with <10 entries

scenarios.description: Cosine similarity sigmoid mapping: 0.5 sim -> 25 score, 0.7 -> 60, 0.85 -> 85
scenarios.expectedBehavior: anomalyScore = min(100, maxSim * 100 * (maxSim > 0.5 ? 1.2 : 0.8)) — score jumps significantly above 0.5 threshold
scenarios.failureMode: Token with 0.49 similarity to closest rug gets 39 score; token with 0.51 gets 61 — massive difference at 0.5 boundary
scenarios.prerequisites: Rug corpus with 10+ entries, token signals available

scenarios.description: hasAnyActiveFlag shortcuts anomaly check for zero-flag tokens
scenarios.expectedBehavior: toNumericVector(signals).some(v > 0) — if all 17 dimensions are 0, skip full similarity computation
scenarios.failureMode: Token with no active flags is clearly not anomalous, but misses similarity to rugs that also had zero flags
scenarios.prerequisites: Token signals with all 17 features false/0

scenarios.description: Anomaly score threshold 50+ triggers anomaly_detected=true, triggering downstream LLM analysis
scenarios.expectedBehavior: detectAnomaly returns anomaly_detected=true when anomalyScore >= 50
scenarios.failureMode: Score 49.5 rounds to 50 (due to Math.round) — correct; score 49 rounds to 49 — anomaly not detected
scenarios.prerequisites: Token signals producing anomaly score near 50

scenarios.description: LLM analysis only fires when rug corpus has 25+ entries
scenarios.expectedBehavior: MIN_RUG_CORPUS = 25; rugCorpusSize < MIN_RUG_CORPUS → skipped with 'insufficient_rug_corpus' reason
scenarios.failureMode: Bot with 24 rugs: LLM analysis skipped, ambiguous tokens (score 25-55) not evaluated by LLM
scenarios.prerequisites: rug-memory.json with <25 entries

scenarios.description: LLM analysis times out at 8 seconds to avoid blocking screening cycle
scenarios.expectedBehavior: AbortController with 8000ms timeout; on timeout, catch returns {verdict:'error', adjustment:0, skipped:true}
scenarios.failureMode: LLM provider slow (15s response) — timeout fires, analysis skipped, token passes with no LLM adjustment
scenarios.prerequisites: LLM client configured and available

scenarios.description: LLM responses parsed: 'RUG'=+20, 'SUSPICIOUS'=+8, 'SAFE'=-5 adjustment
scenarios.expectedBehavior: parseRugVerdict: RUG adj+20, SUSPICIOUS adj+8, SAFE adj-5, unknown adj=0
scenarios.failureMode: LLM returns 'NOT RUG' — parseRugVerdict checks for 'RUG' but excludes 'NOT RUG' and 'ANTI-RUG' via guard
scenarios.prerequisites: LLM returns classification string

scenarios.description: HOT market: wider stops (-22% SL, -30% CL), larger probe (0.20), higher sweep (55%)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: adjustByMarket(HOT): probeSizeFraction=0.20, hotBoost=0.10, stopLoss=-22%, cutLoss=-30%, sweep=55%
scenarios.failureMode: HOT market wide stops: in volatile hot market, -22% stoploss may be too wide for frequent false signals
scenarios.prerequisites: marketCondition='HOT'

scenarios.description: COLD market: tighter stops (-10% SL, -16% CL), smaller probe (0.15), lower sweep (25%)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: adjustByMarket(COLD): probeSizeFraction=0.15, coldPenalty=0.20, stopLoss=-10%, cutLoss=-16%, sweep=25%
scenarios.failureMode: COLD market tight stops: natural memecoin volatility may trigger -10% SL frequently, causing many premature exits
scenarios.prerequisites: marketCondition='COLD'

scenarios.description: DEAD market: zero sizing, -3% hard stop, no trailing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: adjustByMarket(DEAD): probeSizeFraction=0, minFraction=0, stopLoss=-3%, cutLoss=-5%, trailingTrigger=0, sweep=0
scenarios.failureMode: In DEAD market, virtually no trading allowed; -3% stoploss is extremely tight
scenarios.prerequisites: marketCondition='DEAD'

scenarios.description: Strategy stoploss overrides market-adjusted defaults
scenarios.expectedBehavior: buildRiskPolicy: if strategyParams.stoploss is finite and between -0.01 and -0.50, convert to % and use; hardCutLoss = stoploss * 1.6
scenarios.failureMode: strategyParams.stoploss = -0.60 (below -0.50): not applied, market default used — strategy intent overridden
scenarios.prerequisites: Active strategy with stoploss parameter

scenarios.description: Strategy trailing stop enabled: positive_offset and positive_distance override defaults
scenarios.expectedBehavior: buildRiskPolicy: strategyParams.trailing_stop.enabled=true → trigger=offset*100, drop=distance*100
scenarios.failureMode: Decimal-to-percent conversion: offset=0.05 → trigger=5% (correct); offset=5 (already pct) → trigger=500% (broken)
scenarios.prerequisites: Strategy with trailing_stop config

scenarios.description: High conviction (>=70) and confidence (>=45) boosts probe size by +0.05
scenarios.expectedBehavior: buildRiskPolicy: convictionScore>=70 && confidenceScore>=45 → probeSizeFraction += 0.05, clamped 0.1-0.6
scenarios.failureMode: Probe size boost could push allocation above intended risk budget for the position
scenarios.prerequisites: conviction object with score>=70 and confidence>=45

scenarios.description: Rug score >= hardBlockRugScore (30) sets flagTolerance=0, zero flags allowed
scenarios.expectedBehavior: rugScore >= 30 → entry.flagTolerance=0; rugScore >= 20 → flagTolerance=0 and probe clamped to 0.25
scenarios.failureMode: flagTolerance=0 means any downstream flag blocks entry; rugScore exactly 20 uses threshold at line 142-144
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with rug score between 20-30

scenarios.description: 2+ flags force flagTolerance=0 and cap probe size at 0.25
scenarios.expectedBehavior: flagCount >= 2 → entry.flagTolerance=0, probeSizeFraction = min(probeSizeFraction, 0.25)
scenarios.failureMode: Flag count includes trash flags from trash-layer; a token with 2 minor flags gets aggressive penalty
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with 2+ trash flags

scenarios.description: evaluateExitPolicy: hardCutLoss triggers at or below configured percentage
scenarios.expectedBehavior: evaluateExitPolicy: pnl <= policy.exit.hardCutLossPct → hardCutLoss=true with reason string
scenarios.failureMode: Exact boundary: pnl exactly -22% when CL=-22% triggers (<=). Tiny floating point: -21.9999% vs -22% could differ
scenarios.prerequisites: Position P&L at cut loss threshold

scenarios.description: Trailing stop activates when peak >= trigger and PNL drop exceeds configured distance
scenarios.expectedBehavior: evaluateExitPolicy: trailingDropPct > 0 && peak >= trailingTriggerPct && pnl <= (peak - trailingDropPct)
scenarios.failureMode: Trailing drop in 'absolute' mode: peak=15%, drop=5%, trigger=5% → triggered when pnl <= 10% (correct for trailing from peak)
scenarios.prerequisites: Position in profit with trailing stop enabled

scenarios.description: Profit sweep eligible when PNL >= profitSweepPct
scenarios.expectedBehavior: evaluateExitPolicy: profitSweepPct > 0 && pnl >= profitSweepPct → profitSweepEligible=true
scenarios.failureMode: Sweep at exactly threshold: pnl=35% when sweep=35% → eligible (>=). Partial TP logic uses this flag
scenarios.prerequisites: Position P&L above profit sweep threshold

scenarios.description: Session drawdown > -15% trips kill switch automatically
scenarios.expectedBehavior: reportBalance: ((usd - baseline) / baseline) * 100 <= -15 → trip() with reason='drawdown'
scenarios.failureMode: Transient RPC failure returning usd=0: guard `usd <= 0` at line 116 prevents false trip from 0 reading
scenarios.prerequisites: Session baseline set, balance drops >15%

scenarios.description: 3 consecutive swap failures trip the kill switch
scenarios.expectedBehavior: recordSwapOutcome: !success → _consecutiveErrors++ → if >= 3 → trip('consecutive_errors')
scenarios.failureMode: Network blips causing 3 sequential swap failures trip the kill switch unnecessarily
scenarios.prerequisites: 3 consecutive failed swap attempts

scenarios.description: Successful swap resets consecutive error counter
scenarios.expectedBehavior: recordSwapOutcome: success=true → _consecutiveErrors = 0; state persisted
scenarios.failureMode: One success between failures correctly resets counter; requires 3 consecutive failures from that point
scenarios.prerequisites: Some failed swaps recorded, then a success

scenarios.description: Kill switch survives restart via flag file on disk
scenarios.expectedBehavior: trip() writes kill-switch.flag JSON; isKilled() reads it; restart sees flag and stays killed
scenarios.failureMode: Flag file in git-managed directory could be cleaned during deploy; state restored via _restoreState from state file
scenarios.prerequisites: Kill switch tripped, then process restarts

scenarios.description: reportBalance guards against usd=0 (RPC failure) with early return
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Line 116: !Number.isFinite(usd) || usd <= 0 || _sessionStartUsd == null → return false (no trip)
scenarios.failureMode: If RPC consistently returns 0, kill switch never trips but bot keeps losing money trading with 0 balance reading
scenarios.prerequisites: RPC returning 0 for wallet balance

scenarios.description: Session baseline can be set once; second call with same value is idempotent
scenarios.expectedBehavior: setSessionBaseline: if !Number.isFinite(usd) || usd <= 0, return without setting
scenarios.failureMode: Baseline set very low (e.g., $1) means drawdown calculation is based on tiny reference — trip may never trigger
scenarios.prerequisites: Initialization call to setSessionBaseline

scenarios.description: Flag file unreadable returns generic kill state (fail-safe)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: readKillState: catch block returns { reason: 'unknown', detail: 'flag file unreadable' } — still considered killed
scenarios.failureMode: Corrupted flag file prevents resume even after manual recovery; must delete flag file manually
scenarios.prerequisites: Flag file exists but is corrupted

scenarios.description: reset() clears flag file, state file, and in-memory counters
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Deletes both FLAG_FILE and STATE_FILE; resets _consecutiveErrors=0, _sessionStartUsd=null
scenarios.failureMode: File deletion fails silently (permissions) — flag persists but log says reset complete
scenarios.prerequisites: Killed bot with flag and state files present

scenarios.description: 3 rug events in 30-minute window trips circuit breaker for 4 hours
scenarios.expectedBehavior: createRugCircuitBreaker: maxEvents=3, windowMs=30min, lockDurationMs=4h; events array tracked; at 3rd event, locked until now+4h
scenarios.failureMode: Consecutive exits from same token counted as multiple events — a single catastrophic rug may trip breaker
scenarios.prerequisites: 3 rug exits within 30 minutes

scenarios.description: Events older than window are pruned automatically
scenarios.expectedBehavior: _prune: remove events with ts < (now - windowMs); array stays lean
