scenarios.failureMode: Window sliding: if events at t=0, t=10min, t=25min, t=40min — at t=40min, t=0 event pruned, only 2 events remain (within 30min)
scenarios.prerequisites: Rug events spread longer than the window

scenarios.description: Circuit breaker lock prevents new entries but does NOT stop active position monitoring
scenarios.expectedBehavior: isLocked() returns true; used by index.js checkAllGates to skip new entries. Rug-monitor still runs
scenarios.failureMode: 4-hour lock is long; if market recovers quickly, bot misses opportunities for 4 hours
scenarios.prerequisites: Circuit breaker tripped

scenarios.description: getStatus returns lock state, remaining minutes, and lock reason
scenarios.expectedBehavior: getStatus: { locked, lockedUntil, resumeInMin, lockReason, recentCount, maxEvents, windowMs }
scenarios.failureMode: resumeInMin computed as Math.ceil((lockedUntil - now) / 60000) — at 3.5 minutes remaining, reports 4 minutes (ceil)
scenarios.prerequisites: Breaker in locked state

scenarios.description: reset() clears events, lock state, and reason completely
scenarios.expectedBehavior: reset: events.length=0, lockedUntil=0, lockReason=null — circuit fully open
scenarios.failureMode: Manual reset after fixing root cause allows immediate trading; must be called explicitly
scenarios.prerequisites: Tripped breaker

scenarios.description: recordExit with mint and reason tracks which token triggered the exit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: recordExit(mint, reason): pushes {mint, reason, ts} to events array
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicate mints counted as separate events if they exit multiple times (e.g., partial close then full close)
scenarios.prerequisites: Position exited (rug detected)

scenarios.description: detectDevSell: deployer dev balance drop exceeding thresholds raises severity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: detectDevSell: deltaPct <= thresholds.high → HIGH, <= thresholds.medium → MEDIUM, <= thresholds.low → LOW
scenarios.failureMode: Dev selling naturally to raise funds looks identical to rug pull to this detector — false positives
scenarios.prerequisites: Deployer token balance tracked at entry

scenarios.description: detectLpMovement: deployer removing liquidity triggers HIGH severity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: detectLpMovement: removeLiquidityBy === deployerWallet → SEVERITY.HIGH
scenarios.failureMode: Legitimate LP management by deployer (rebalancing) also triggers HIGH severity — immediate false alarm
scenarios.prerequisites: Deployer wallet known, LP address tracked

scenarios.description: detectAuthorityChange: new mint_authority detected after entry = HIGH severity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: detectAuthorityChange: atEntry mint_authority null, current set → HIGH (unless transferred to burn)
scenarios.failureMode: Token revoking mint authority (set to null): not detected as severity (reverse direction not a risk)
scenarios.prerequisites: Token authorities snapshot at entry

scenarios.description: detectHolderDump: cumulative holder sell-off within 5-minute window triggers severity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: detectHolderDump: cumulative tokens sold / snapshotTotal * 100; deltaPct <= thresholds → severity
scenarios.failureMode: Holder dump detection depends on top-holder snapshot at entry — if snapshot is stale, may miss or misreport
scenarios.prerequisites: Top-holder snapshot taken at position entry

scenarios.description: attachPosition subscribes to Geyser stream for real-time monitoring
scenarios.expectedBehavior: attachPosition: if geyserStream.subscribe exists, subscribe to deployer_token_account, lp_address, and mint
scenarios.failureMode: Geyser stream disconnection: subscriptions silently drop, polling continues but real-time alerts lost
scenarios.prerequisites: Geyser stream configured and connected

scenarios.description: Polling interval defaults to 30 seconds for active position checks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: pollingMs = (config.pollingIntervalSec || 30) * 1000; _schedulePolling uses setTimeout for loop
scenarios.failureMode: 30-second poll interval: deployer could drain 90% of LP within 30 seconds before poll detects it
scenarios.prerequisites: Position attached to monitor

scenarios.description: detachPosition cleans up polling and Geyser subscriptions
scenarios.expectedBehavior: detachPosition: clears polling timeout, unsubscribes all Geyser subs, marks state.shutdown=true, deletes from Map
scenarios.failureMode: If geyserStream is null or unsubscribe throws, catch block in for loop continues — individual sub may leak
scenarios.prerequisites: Position monitored and then closed

scenarios.description: Max wins (default 3) or max losses (default 3) per day triggers pending_decision state
scenarios.expectedBehavior: recordDailyTradeOutcome: wins >= maxWinsPerDay OR losses >= maxLossesPerDay → status='pending_decision'
scenarios.failureMode: Win/loss counts from both thresholds can trigger simultaneously — only the threshold that hits first matters
scenarios.prerequisites: Win or loss count reaches configured daily limit

scenarios.description: Midnight reset: state.date field changes, state resets to defaults
scenarios.expectedBehavior: loadState: if parsed.date !== dateKey(nowMs) → return defaultState(nowMs) — fresh state per day
scenarios.failureMode: Timezone issues: dateKey uses toISOString().slice(0,10) which is UTC. If operator is in -5, day resets at 7PM local, not midnight
scenarios.prerequisites: Guard configured and active, crossing UTC midnight

scenarios.description: decideDailyTradeGuard('continue') acknowledges threshold and continues trading
scenarios.expectedBehavior: decideDailyTradeGuard: action='continue' → ack threshold key in acknowledgedThresholds, status='continued', pendingDecision cleared
scenarios.failureMode: Continue decision does NOT reset counters; it only acknowledges — trade could hit another loss and need another continue
scenarios.prerequisites: Guard in pending_decision state

scenarios.description: decideDailyTradeGuard('stop') stops trading for the day
scenarios.expectedBehavior: decideDailyTradeGuard: action='stop' → status='stopped', pendingDecision cleared
scenarios.failureMode: 'stop' sets status='stopped' but does NOT reset state; isDailyTradeGuardEntryBlocked returns blocked until midnight reset
scenarios.prerequisites: Guard in pending_decision state

scenarios.description: isDailyTradeGuardEntryBlocked returns blocked with reason when status is pending_decision or stopped
scenarios.expectedBehavior: isDailyTradeGuardEntryBlocked: enabled && blocked → return block=true, reason includes count/limit
scenarios.failureMode: When not enabled, returns {blocked:false} immediately — guard disabled means no protection
scenarios.prerequisites: Guard in pending_decision or stopped state

scenarios.description: Events log capped at 100 entries to prevent unbounded growth
scenarios.expectedBehavior: recordDailyTradeOutcome: after push, if events.length > 100, events = events.slice(-100)
scenarios.failureMode: High-frequency trading could hit 100 events quickly, losing early-day history
scenarios.prerequisites: 100+ trade outcomes recorded in single day

scenarios.description: Guard counts only enabled trades; disabled guard returns triggered=false always
scenarios.expectedBehavior: recordDailyTradeOutcome: !cfg.enabled → return {..., triggered: false} immediately without updating state
scenarios.failureMode: Win/loss tracking is skipped when disabled — cannot retroactively enable to see today's trade history
scenarios.prerequisites: Daily trade guard disabled in config

scenarios.description: isPartialTPLanded prevents duplicate TP execution for same position+attempt
scenarios.expectedBehavior: isPartialTPLanded: check state[`${positionKey}::${attempt}`]?.landed; returns true if already submitted
scenarios.failureMode: If state file is deleted between mark and check, TP could execute twice (race condition risk)
scenarios.prerequisites: Partial TP previously marked as landed

scenarios.description: markPartialTPLanded uses file lock for atomicity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: markPartialTPLanded: withFileLock -> load -> set key -> save -> release
scenarios.failureMode: File lock mechanism: if path doesn't exist or lock acquisition fails, operation may fail silently
scenarios.prerequisites: Partial TP to be marked landed

scenarios.description: clearPartialTPGuard removes all records for a position after full close
scenarios.expectedBehavior: clearPartialTPGuard: iterate all keys, delete those starting with `${positionKey}::`
scenarios.failureMode: Position key with special regex characters (dots, parens) could cause issues if key parsing changes; simple string startsWith is safe
scenarios.prerequisites: Position with multiple partial TP records, now fully closed

scenarios.description: prunePartialTPGuard removes entries older than 7 days
scenarios.expectedBehavior: prunePartialTPGuard: maxAgeDays=7; entries with ts < cutoff (7 days ago) are deleted
scenarios.failureMode: If entry has no ts field (older format), val.ts is undefined -> undefined < cutoff is false -> never pruned
scenarios.prerequisites: Entries older than 7 days in guard state

scenarios.description: NORMAL market: probeSizeFraction=0.05, confidence floors=25/40/50 for shadow/probe/active
scenarios.expectedBehavior: DEFAULT_POLICY: shadowConfidenceFloor=25, probeConfidenceFloor=40, activeConfidenceFloor=50, probeSizeFraction=0.05
scenarios.failureMode: These are reasonable defaults but could be too aggressive for small accounts
scenarios.prerequisites: Default risk policy construction

scenarios.description: trailing_stop.enabled=false explicitly disables trailing stop
scenarios.expectedBehavior: buildRiskPolicy: strategyParams.trailing_stop.enabled=false → trailingTriggerPct=0, trailingDropPct=0
scenarios.failureMode: Strategy setting 'enabled': false vs 'enabled': 'false' — false !== 'false' for the === comparison
scenarios.prerequisites: Strategy with trailing_stop explicitly disabled

scenarios.description: COLD market clamps stoploss to max -10% even if strategy wants wider
scenarios.expectedBehavior: adjustByMarket(COLD) sets SL=-10%; then buildRiskPolicy line 167: Math.max(hardStopLossPct, -10) — strategy SL of -15% becomes -10%
scenarios.failureMode: COLD market forces -10% max stoploss regardless of strategy intent — strategy may expect wider loss tolerance
scenarios.prerequisites: COLD market with strategy requesting wider stoploss

scenarios.description: COLD market clamps take profit to max 130%
scenarios.expectedBehavior: buildRiskPolicy: condition==='COLD' && immediateTakeProfitPct is finite → takeProfitPct = min(takeProfitPct, 130)
scenarios.failureMode: Strategy with 200% TP in COLD market gets clamped to 130% — position may close earlier than strategy expects
scenarios.prerequisites: COLD market with strategy TP > 130%

scenarios.description: initManagementAgent called without runManagementCycle dependency — _runManagementCycle stays null
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Agent registers as 'running' but runManagementCycle returns 'Management agent not initialized' when called
scenarios.failureMode: Silent crash or TypeError when downstream code calls runManagementCycle without checking init state
scenarios.prerequisites: Call initManagementAgent({}) with missing runManagementCycle

scenarios.description: screening:decision event fires with null/undefined payload — symbol and mint both missing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Agent logs fallback string and updates health with pendingBuyReview=true and lastScreeningDecision=null
scenarios.failureMode: Crash from accessing payload.symbol on null, or downstream LLM review receives undefined candidate
scenarios.prerequisites: agentBus emits screening:decision with payload=null or payload={}

scenarios.description: management:llm_sell event fires with token field that is null — .slice(0,8) on null in log
scenarios.expectedBehavior: log statement catches via payload?.token?.slice(0,8) optional chaining so no crash; lastLLMSell = payload
scenarios.failureMode: If optional chaining is removed or payload shape changes, TypeError: Cannot read properties of null
scenarios.prerequisites: agentBus emits management:llm_sell with payload={} or payload={token:null}

scenarios.description: management:llm_entry_executed receives payload with amount_sol that is NaN from failed swap
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Agent logs the value as-is (NaN rendered as 'NaN SOL') and updates lastEntry=payload
scenarios.failureMode: NaN propagates to downstream position tracking, corrupting position sizing or P&L calculations
scenarios.prerequisites: Swap execution returns amount_sol: NaN in payload

scenarios.description: management:heartbeat fires with positions=0 but actual open positions exist — agent rest desync
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Agent records positionsMonitored=0 but continues; emergencySignals updates normally
scenarios.failureMode: Position monitoring falsely reports zero, causing management cycle to skip exit checks
scenarios.prerequisites: Index.js emits heartbeat with stale position count after state file corruption

scenarios.description: management:emergency_exit payload missing symbol or reason — emergency signal with no context
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Log emits '[object Object]' or partial text; emergencyCount increments via updateAgentHealth

scenarios.description: management:llm_review_complete fires with payload containing tokenCount=0 — empty portfolio review

scenarios.description: management:llm_buy and management:llm_sell fire for same token within same cycle — buy-then-sell race
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Both events processed in order; lastLLMBuy and lastLLMSell both updated; downstream may execute both

scenarios.description: management:heartbeat payload contains emergencySignals=99 (artificially high count)

scenarios.description: general:telegram event with payload missing _reqId — response channel unavailable

scenarios.description: handleQuickCommand called with cmd=null from payload.text being null

scenarios.description: dashboard_query received with query = '/agents' — quick command match returns agent statuses

scenarios.description: CLAUDE.md file read returns empty string — kb content is empty but no error thrown

scenarios.description: Knowledge base file contains >3000 characters — only first 3KB included, critical config after offset lost

scenarios.description: updateSessionCapital called with currentCapitalUsd = 0 (wallet API returning zero on failure)

scenarios.description: pnlPct exactly equals dailyTargetPct — boundary condition for pause_target

scenarios.description: checkSessionGate called with pausedUntil = 'not-a-date' string — new Date() returns Invalid Date

scenarios.description: dailyResults exceeds 60 entries (B6 cap) — bot runs more than 60 days without plan reset

scenarios.failureMode: Empty string is rejected causing validation failure; or empty string is passed through causing downstream null checks to fail
scenarios.prerequisites: Schema field with nullable_string type

scenarios.description: extractLessonsFromStructuredOutput with 8 field names collects duplicate lessons across overlapping fields
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Duplicate lessons are deduplicated; only unique lessons are returned; order is preserved
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicates not filtered causing redundant lessons in system prompt; identical lessons waste context window
scenarios.prerequisites: LLM response with lesson data in multiple fields

scenarios.description: SCREENER role schema validates a token observation with extremely high market cap (1 trillion)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: schema accepts valid scientific notation or large number; no overflow in JSON parsing
scenarios.failureMode: Number overflow during JSON parsing; value truncated to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; validation rejects valid high-value observation
scenarios.prerequisites: SCREENER schema loaded; LLM returns high-value token data

scenarios.description: LOSS_ANALYSIS schema receives an observation where loss reason is in Indonesian (Bahasa) mixed with English
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Schema accepts the mixed-language content as valid string; no language or encoding restrictions on string fields
scenarios.failureMode: Non-ASCII characters stripped or mangled during validation; loss reason becomes unreadable
scenarios.prerequisites: LOSS_ANALYSIS schema; mixed-language LLM response

scenarios.description: All 6 role schemas are loaded concurrently and one schema has a corrupt field definition
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Schema loading validates each schema independently; corrupt schema is logged and skipped; remaining 5 schemas load correctly
scenarios.failureMode: Single corrupt schema causes all 6 schema loads to fail; agent cannot parse any LLM response until fixed
scenarios.prerequisites: structured-output.js loaded; one schema has invalid field definition

scenarios.description: validateProvider returns success but the provider key in .env has trailing whitespace
scenarios.expectedBehavior: validateProvider or readEnv trims whitespace from .env values before validation
scenarios.failureMode: Key is read with trailing newline/space; API call fails with auth_error; provider appears valid but all requests fail
scenarios.prerequisites: .env file with trailing whitespace on PROVIDER key

scenarios.description: Proxy server crashes mid-request leaving hanging HTTP connection
scenarios.expectedBehavior: HTTP client times out after socket timeout; no resource leaks; server can restart immediately
scenarios.failureMode: TCP socket remains in CLOSE_WAIT state; port unavailable for restart; client hangs indefinitely
scenarios.prerequisites: Active request being processed by proxy

scenarios.description: buildSystemPrompt is called with positions containing a position that has null wallet_address
scenarios.expectedBehavior: position with null wallet_address is still included in prompt; format handles null gracefully showing 'N/A' or empty string
scenarios.failureMode: Null wallet_address causes TypeError in string formatting; position is omitted from prompt; agent doesn't know about active position
scenarios.prerequisites: Position recorded without wallet_address

scenarios.description: compressToolOutput receives null or undefined data
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns empty object or null gracefully; does not throw TypeError on .method() calls
scenarios.failureMode: Null check missing; crashes with 'Cannot read property of null'; calling code has no compressed output
scenarios.prerequisites: Tool returns null; compressToolOutput called unconditionally

scenarios.description: handleProviderError with connection_error type (DNS failure, network unreachable)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: connection_error is identified; fallback triggers immediately without retry on same provider; error type is logged
scenarios.failureMode: connection_error treated as transient and retried 3 times on same provider before fallback; each retry adds 10s delay
scenarios.prerequisites: Provider endpoint DNS resolution failure

scenarios.description: model_not_found error when the provider has deprecated the requested model
scenarios.expectedBehavior: model_not_found triggers fallback to fallbackModel defined in provider config; retry with correct model name
scenarios.failureMode: FallbackModel is also deprecated causing immediate second failure; fallback chain loops through all providers with deprecated models
scenarios.prerequisites: Provider with deprecated active model and fallbackModel

scenarios.description: setProvider called with invalid provider name 'nonexistent_provider'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: setProvider returns error indicating provider not found; current provider unchanged; no crash
scenarios.failureMode: Invalid provider name sets provider to undefined; subsequence getCurrentProvider returns null; all LLM calls fail
scenarios.prerequisites: llm-manager.js loaded

scenarios.description: readEnv returns undefined for PROVIDER key because .env file does not exist
scenarios.expectedBehavior: readEnv returns empty object or default provider; bot starts with default provider configuration
scenarios.failureMode: readEnv throws file not found error; bot fails to start; no default provider fallback
scenarios.prerequisites: Missing .env file

scenarios.description: Concurrent requests to proxy exceed available connection pool causing socket hang
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Requests are queued; each request completes in order; no requests are dropped
scenarios.failureMode: Socket pool exhaustion causes ECONNREFUSED; some requests are silently dropped; proxy enters deadlock state
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple concurrent LLM requests via proxy

scenarios.description: tryParseStructuredOutput receives response with ``` without closing ``` causing incomplete parse
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Parser detects unclosed fenced block; falls back to raw JSON extraction or returns partial data with warning
scenarios.failureMode: Parser hangs or returns truncated corrupt JSON; extraction of any structured data fails completely
scenarios.prerequisites: LLM response with unclosed fenced code block

scenarios.description: buildSystemPrompt with perfSummary containing null values for avgPnl or win_rate
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Performance summary is formatted with 'N/A' for null values; prompt remains coherent
scenarios.failureMode: null reference in template causes TypeError; entire prompt generation fails; bot starts with no system prompt
scenarios.prerequisites: No trading history; perfSummary.avgPnl is null

scenarios.description: ListToolsRequestSchema returns 28 registered tools but one handler throws during registration
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Failed tool registration is isolated; remaining 27 tools are listed and functional
scenarios.failureMode: Single failing handler blocks all 28 tool registrations; server starts with 0 tools; clients see empty tool list
scenarios.prerequisites: collaboration-mcp-server.js starting; one tool has invalid handler function

scenarios.description: normalizeEntry creates UUID-style id that collides with an existing entry in the JSONL store
scenarios.expectedBehavior: normalizeEntry uses timestamp+random combination that is statistically unique; collision probability is negligible
scenarios.failureMode: Random generation uses weak PRNG or truncated timestamp; id collision silently overwrites existing entry in append-only store
scenarios.prerequisites: JSONL store with existing entries

scenarios.description: filterEntries receives all 10 filter parameters simultaneously on a large dataset
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All 10 filters apply in conjunction (AND logic); only entries matching ALL filters are returned; performance is acceptable
scenarios.failureMode: Filter combination produces incorrect results due to operator precedence; or some filters silently ignored; or performance degrades to O(n^2)
scenarios.prerequisites: JSONL store with 1000+ entries

scenarios.description: ensureStore called when the directory exists but is not writable (permission denied)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ensureStore catches permission error and returns descriptive error; server continues running with degraded functionality
scenarios.failureMode: Uncaught EACCES error crashes the MCP server; or silent failure creates file in memory only; subsequent writes are lost on restart
scenarios.prerequisites: Store directory with incorrect permissions

scenarios.description: appendEntry appends a JSONL line while the store file is being read by another concurrent operation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Append and read are serialized via file locks or atomic operations; no partial lines are read
scenarios.failureMode: Concurrent read sees partially written line; JSON parse fails on malformed line; data corruption
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple concurrent operations on same JSONL store

scenarios.description: orchestrator-state.json has a next_id counter that skips a number due to a failed task creation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: next_id increments atomically regardless of task creation success; no gaps or duplicate IDs
scenarios.failureMode: next_id increments even when task creation fails; gaps appear in ID sequence; task with failed creation has no corresponding entry
scenarios.prerequisites: orchestrator-state.json loaded; task creation fails mid-operation

scenarios.description: Task advances from stage 'research' to 'evaluate' but the evaluate owner codex is not available
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Stage transition is allowed; a note is logged that owner is unavailable; task remains in evaluate waiting for owner
scenarios.failureMode: Stage transition is blocked because owner is unavailable; task stuck in research forever; no timeout mechanism
scenarios.prerequisites: Orchestration task in research stage; codex not running

scenarios.description: buildMemoryContext searches semantic memory but the semantic-memory.jsonl file is empty (0 lines)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: buildMemoryContext returns empty context gracefully; no errors; search results are simply empty
scenarios.failureMode: Empty file causes JSON parse error on first line; entire context building fails; task has no memory context
scenarios.prerequisites: Fresh install; no semantic entries yet

scenarios.description: logStageEvent appends to shared-agent-memory.jsonl when the file has grown to 100MB
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Append still works; no size limit check is applied; file system handles large JSONL files
scenarios.failureMode: Append slows down significantly; or file system quota exceeded; or read performance degrades for memory search
scenarios.prerequisites: Long-running collaboration with 100MB+ log

scenarios.description: persistStage called with an invalid stage name not in the 6-stage workflow
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Function validates stage name against known stages; returns error for invalid stage; no partial artifacts created
scenarios.failureMode: Artifact created with invalid stage; cannot be retrieved by stage filter; orphaned artifact in store
scenarios.prerequisites: workflow-bridge.js loaded

scenarios.description: autoSubmitWorkerResult is called with worker='gemini' but the result data is missing findings array
scenarios.expectedBehavior: autoSubmitWorkerResult validates required fields for gemini (findings); returns validation error; no partial artifact stored
scenarios.failureMode: Artifact created with missing fields; downstream orchestration reads undefined findings causing errors
scenarios.prerequisites: Gemini worker with incomplete submission data

scenarios.description: Codex auto-advances from 'execute' to 'review' when testing artifacts are missing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: autoSubmitWorkerResult for codex requires testing artifacts before advancing from execute; validation prevents premature advancement
scenarios.failureMode: Codex advances to review without testing; task reaches Claude for review without verification; buggy code is approved
scenarios.prerequisites: Codex worker active in execute stage

scenarios.description: workflow-artifacts.json next_id counter overflows after 2^53 tasks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: next_id uses BigInt or resets after reaching MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
scenarios.failureMode: Integer overflow causes next_id to wrap to negative or NaN; new artifact creation fails
scenarios.prerequisites: 2^53+ tasks created (theoretical long-term)

scenarios.description: normalizeEntry receives a title that is exactly at the max character length with multi-byte UTF-8 characters
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Slice operates on characters, not bytes; multi-byte characters are not split; full title fits within limit
scenarios.failureMode: Slice on byte length splits multi-byte character producing broken UTF-8; JSON serialization fails on invalid encoding
scenarios.prerequisites: Entry with max-length title containing emoji or CJK characters

scenarios.description: tokenize-based scoring with a query that matches 50% of tokens across many entries
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Scoring function returns ranked results with scores reflecting token match density; top entries have highest token overlap
scenarios.failureMode: Scoring produces ties for many entries; ranking is non-deterministic; or score overflow with many token matches
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple similar semantic entries in store
scenarios.fileRef: semantic-memory.js:scoring logic (37-65): 8 pts per token match, 18 type match, 14 tag match

scenarios.description: mirrorToRuflo is called but the ruflo binary is not installed or not in PATH
scenarios.expectedBehavior: mirrorToRuflo catches execFile error; logs warning; continues without mirroring; semantic memory still works locally
scenarios.failureMode: Uncaught error from execFile crashes the caller; mirrorToRuflo throws instead of returning gracefully
scenarios.prerequisites: Ruflo not installed; semantic-memory.js loaded

scenarios.description: validateTaskPolicy called for a task with spec artifacts but missing plan and testing artifacts
scenarios.expectedBehavior: validateTaskPolicy returns error for missing plan+testing; recommends build artifact too; task cannot be finalized
scenarios.failureMode: Missing artifact check only warns instead of erroring; task is finalized without complete workflow; policy gate bypassed
scenarios.prerequisites: Task with spec artifact only

scenarios.description: finalizeTaskWithPolicy called by agent 'gemini' instead of 'claude'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Policy gate checks agent name; rejects non-claude agent with authorization error
scenarios.failureMode: Agent name check is case-sensitive and 'Claude' (capitalized) is rejected; or 'gemini' is accidentally allowed to finalize
scenarios.prerequisites: Task ready for finalization

scenarios.description: validateTaskPolicy for a task where pending_agent is not claude but no Claude decision note is present
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Policy gate requires a Claude decision note when pending_agent is not claude; returns unmet requirement
scenarios.failureMode: No check for pending_agent identity; non-claude pending agent doesn't require decision note; policy gap allows unapproved actions
scenarios.prerequisites: Task with non-claude pending_agent

scenarios.description: Experiment minimum sample size check in policy gate when experiment has 0 samples
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Validation passes with warning that 0 samples provides no statistical significance; does not block but warns
scenarios.failureMode: Division by zero on sample size calculation; or 0 samples causes hard block preventing any experiment progress
scenarios.prerequisites: Experiment created but no runs recorded

scenarios.description: runGemini with a prompt that exceeds 120-second timeout
scenarios.expectedBehavior: execFile timeout at 120s rejects the promise; error result is returned with timeout message; process is killed
scenarios.failureMode: execFile timeout does not kill child process; orphan gemini process accumulates; memory leak over many calls
scenarios.prerequisites: gemini-bridge-server.js running; gemini CLI responds slowly

scenarios.description: gemini_analyze_file called with a file_path that traverses outside PROJECT_ROOT via '../'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: path.resolve resolves the path; startsWith check against PROJECT_ROOT rejects it; security error returned
scenarios.failureMode: path traversal not detected; attacker reads arbitrary files; or startsWith check bypassed with symlink
scenarios.prerequisites: gemini-bridge-server.js running; attacker has tool access

scenarios.description: ask_gemini called with context parameter exceeding 100KB
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Large context is passed through; Gemini CLI handles large input; response is returned
scenarios.failureMode: Context + prompt exceeds CLI argument limit; execFile fails with E2BIG; or stdin buffer overflows
scenarios.prerequisites: gemini-bridge-server.js running

scenarios.description: gemini_analyze_file with a file_path to a binary file (PNG, .so, etc.) that exceeds 50000 chars after readFileSync
scenarios.expectedBehavior: readFileSync reads the binary; slice(0, 50000) truncates to first 50000 chars; content is sent to Gemini (likely garbled)
scenarios.failureMode: Binary file contains null bytes causing string truncation before 50000 chars; or readFileSync throws on binary encoding
scenarios.prerequisites: Binary file within PROJECT_ROOT

scenarios.description: mcp-server.js readJson helper called when the JSON file is valid but contains a BOM character
scenarios.expectedBehavior: JSON.parse handles BOM character gracefully; or helper strips BOM before parsing
scenarios.failureMode: BOM character causes JSON.parse to fail; entire file is unreadable; tool returns error
scenarios.prerequisites: JSON file with BOM (common on Windows-edited files)

scenarios.description: get_regime_memory computes win_rate as 0/0 for a regime with no trades
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Division by zero is handled; win_rate defaults to 0 or null; regime is still returned with 0 trades
scenarios.failureMode: Division by zero produces NaN; NaN propagates to dashboard; sortByNumberDesc fails on NaN values
scenarios.prerequisites: Regime with trade_count=0 and win_count=0

scenarios.description: sortByDateDesc receives dates in mixed ISO 8601 and Unix timestamp formats
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Sort function normalizes both formats before comparison; correct chronological order is produced
scenarios.failureMode: Mixed formats cause type coercion errors; sort produces wrong order or throws
scenarios.prerequisites: Data with mixed date formats in JSON store

scenarios.description: StdioServerTransport stdin closes unexpectedly while tools are being called
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Transport detects stdin close; server initiates graceful shutdown; in-flight tools complete or are cancelled
scenarios.failureMode: Server continues running with no stdin; subsequent tool calls hang indefinitely; zombie process accumulates
scenarios.prerequisites: MCP server connected via stdio transport

scenarios.description: buildMemoryContext with semantic search returning 0 results and recent memory returning 0 entries
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Both empty results are handled; context is built with empty sections; no errors thrown
scenarios.failureMode: Empty array causes crash in context assembly code; task has no context at all
scenarios.prerequisites: Fresh collaboration store with no entries

scenarios.description: Two entries with identical title and summary are stored; deduplication on search returns both
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Semantic memory can store duplicates but search should ideally deduplicate or include both with identical scores
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicate entries corrupt scoring; one overwrites the other in JSONL; or both are returned causing redundant processing
scenarios.prerequisites: Duplicate entry submitted to semantic memory

scenarios.description: finalizeTaskWithPolicy succeeds but the corresponding workflow-artifact state is not updated
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Both policy gate state and workflow artifact state are updated atomically or in sequence with rollback on failure
scenarios.failureMode: Task is finalized in policy gate but artifact still shows 'in_review'; inconsistency between systems
scenarios.prerequisites: Task passing all policy gate checks

scenarios.description: persistStage creates artifact, advances stage, and logs to semantic memory but the middle step (advance) fails
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Partial failure handling rolls back the completed steps or at minimum logs the inconsistency
scenarios.failureMode: Artifact created but stage not advanced; semantic memory logged but artifact missing; inconsistent state across stores
scenarios.prerequisites: Network or filesystem error during persistStage middle step

scenarios.description: Gemini CLI returns non-zero exit code with useful error in stderr
scenarios.expectedBehavior: execFile catch captures stderr; errorResult returns structured error with both message and stderr content
scenarios.failureMode: Only exit code is logged; useful stderr context is lost; debugging is difficult
scenarios.prerequisites: Gemini CLI returns non-zero exit code

scenarios.description: Codex auto-submit includes changes array with 50 modified files; review step cannot handle large changeset
scenarios.expectedBehavior: changes array is stored as-is; review step displays all changes; no truncation of changeset
scenarios.failureMode: Large changeset overflows artifact JSON field; or review step times out processing 50 files
scenarios.prerequisites: Major refactoring task with 50+ files

scenarios.description: Append-only JSONL store grows unbounded; no rotation or archival mechanism
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Append operations remain fast regardless of file size (O(1) append); reads filter efficiently
scenarios.failureMode: Read performance degrades linearly with file size; 1GB+ file causes multi-second reads on every operation
scenarios.prerequisites: Long-running bot with months of collaboration data

scenarios.description: Task owner is set to a non-existent agent ID; stage advancement is blocked because owner cannot be reached
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Stage advancement should detect unreachable owner and escalate or reassign
scenarios.failureMode: Task indefinitely blocked on non-existent owner; no timeout or escalation path; manual intervention required
scenarios.prerequisites: Orchestration task with invalid owner

scenarios.description: Search query with special regex characters (. + * [ ]) causes tokenize-based matching to malfunction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Tokens are split on whitespace; special characters are treated as literal parts of tokens; no regex injection
scenarios.failureMode: Special characters interpreted as regex; search returns wrong results or throws on invalid regex
scenarios.prerequisites: Semantic memory entries; search query with regex metacharacters

scenarios.description: sortByNumberDesc receives array of numbers mixed with string representations ('42' vs 42)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Sort function coerces strings to numbers before comparison; correct numeric order is produced
scenarios.failureMode: Lexicographic sort ('9' > '100'); incorrect ordering; dashboard shows wrong top performers
scenarios.prerequisites: JSON store with mixed number types

scenarios.description: advanceOrchestrationTask called with a stage that is not in the sequential order (skipping from research to decide)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Stage advancement validates sequential ordering; rejects non-sequential jumps with error message
scenarios.failureMode: Stage is advanced non-sequentially; review step is skipped; code goes to production without review
scenarios.prerequisites: Task in research stage

scenarios.description: CRDT merge conflict when two collaboration servers concurrently append to the same JSONL store via NFS
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Append-only JSONL is naturally conflict-free for concurrent appends (no overwrites); both entries are preserved
scenarios.failureMode: NFS caching causes one append to overwrite the other; partial lines from concurrent writes corrupt the file
scenarios.prerequisites: Shared NFS mount; two MCP server instances

scenarios.description: Server starts on port 3000 but the port is already in use by a non-Node process
scenarios.expectedBehavior: EADDRINUSE handler uses fuser/lsof to identify the process; kills it or logs clear message; server retries
scenarios.failureMode: fuser/lsof not available in container; handler fails silently; server never starts; no useful error message
scenarios.prerequisites: Port 3000 occupied by non-Node process

scenarios.description: First-time user navigates to dashboard root but walletAddress cookie is not set
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Server detects missing walletAddress; redirects to /wizard for initial setup
scenarios.failureMode: Redirect loop; or empty dashboard renders with no data; or wizard crashes because no config exists
scenarios.prerequisites: Fresh install; no user-config.json

scenarios.description: WebSocket server starts but an old connection from a previous session is still lingering with CLOSE_WAIT
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Old connection is detected and cleaned up; new WebSocket connection succeeds
scenarios.failureMode: Socket exhaustion from accumulated CLOSE_WAIT connections; new connections are rejected
scenarios.prerequisites: Previously crashed dashboard server

scenarios.description: Log buffer streaming sends log lines to WebSocket clients faster than they can consume
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Backpressure is applied; slow clients are disconnected; server memory does not grow unbounded
scenarios.failureMode: Unbounded buffer growth for slow clients; server OOM due to accumulated log lines in memory
scenarios.prerequisites: Many WebSocket clients; high log output rate

scenarios.description: Auth token comparison uses regular comparison instead of timingSafeEqual
scenarios.expectedBehavior: timingSafeEqual is used for token comparison to prevent timing side-channel attacks
scenarios.failureMode: String comparison with !== is timing-vulnerable; attacker can brute-force token character by character
scenarios.prerequisites: Auth token set; attacker with network access

scenarios.description: Token is persisted to dashboard-token.txt but the file is world-readable
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Token file is created with 0600 permissions; only the bot process owner can read it
scenarios.failureMode: Default umask makes file world-readable; any user on system can read dashboard auth token
scenarios.prerequisites: Auth initialized; token written to file

scenarios.description: Request with both Bearer token and cookie token where they differ
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Server checks Bearer first, then cookie; if either matches, auth passes; explicit priority order
scenarios.failureMode: Differing tokens cause auth confusion; valid request rejected; or mismatched tokens both pass when one should fail
scenarios.prerequisites: Auth token set; request with both auth methods

scenarios.description: readBotState is called when state.json is temporarily missing (e.g., during atomic write tmp+rename)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: readBotState catches file missing error; returns empty state for that file; does not block dashboard render
scenarios.failureMode: File missing causes uncaught error; entire dashboard fails to load; state.json atomic write race
scenarios.prerequisites: Concurrent state.json write happening

scenarios.description: hold_minutes computation in state-reader when deployed_at is in the future (clock skew)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: hold_minutes returns 0 or negative value is clamped to 0; no NaN or negative display
scenarios.failureMode: Negative hold_minutes displayed on dashboard; duration calculations produce negative values
scenarios.prerequisites: Clock skew between server and client; position with future deployed_at

scenarios.description: All 15 feature flags are exposed by state-reader but one flag name is misspelled in the exposure map
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All 15 flags are correctly mapped from their camelCase config paths; misspelling causes a flag to always return undefined
scenarios.failureMode: Misspelled flag always reads as falsy; toggle in dashboard appears to work but never changes behavior; operator confused
scenarios.prerequisites: Feature flag exposure map defined

scenarios.description: Atomic write to config file via atomicWriteJsonAsync while another write is in progress
scenarios.expectedBehavior: withFileLock mutex serializes writes; tmp file is created with pid+timestamp suffix; rename is atomic
scenarios.failureMode: No locking; concurrent writes interleave; config file ends up as mix of both writes; corrupt config
scenarios.prerequisites: Rapid config changes from dashboard UI

scenarios.description: Dashboard writes a config value with an invalid type (string instead of number for a numeric field)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Config writer validates types before writing; rejects invalid types with error message
scenarios.failureMode: Invalid type is written; config.js reads it; type-dependent features crash with runtime type errors
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard config editor UI

scenarios.description: IPC message with a command larger than 64 characters is received
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Command validation rejects commands exceeding 64 chars with descriptive error
scenarios.failureMode: Overlong command is truncated; truncated command executes wrong action; security bypass via truncation
scenarios.prerequisites: IPC channel open

scenarios.description: IPC message with args array containing 17 items (exceeding the limit of 16)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Validation rejects args array with more than 16 items; error returned to sender
scenarios.failureMode: Args array truncated to 16 items without warning; truncated command executes with different intent
scenarios.prerequisites: IPC channel open

scenarios.description: IPC message with an arg exceeding 256 characters
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each arg validated individually; arg >256 chars rejected with error listing which arg failed
scenarios.failureMode: Overlong arg is truncated; semantic meaning changes (e.g., address truncated); wrong token acted upon
scenarios.prerequisites: IPC channel open

scenarios.description: Feature toggle map with dotted path resolution for a deeply nested key like 'screening.honeypot.enabled'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Dotted path is resolved correctly through nested objects; the exact leaf value is returned
scenarios.failureMode: Path resolution fails on intermediate missing key; returns undefined; toggle appears unset
scenarios.prerequisites: Config with nested structure
scenarios.fileRef: dashboard/routes/api.js:feature toggle map (10-40), dotted path resolution (42-55)

scenarios.description: Smart wallet CRUD: add a wallet with duplicate address
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Add operation detects duplicate; returns error or silently ignores; no duplicate entry created
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicate wallet added; capital_pct calculations double-count; splitting logic sends duplicate payments
scenarios.prerequisites: Smart wallet already exists in list

scenarios.description: Copy trade: confirm action for a token that is already in an active position
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Confirm creates a pending intent; existing position check should warn; duplicate trade guard prevents double entry
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicate position created for same token; bot holds two positions in same token; PnL tracking confused
scenarios.prerequisites: Active position in token X; user confirms copy-trade for token X

scenarios.description: Block_rug_token action for a token that is already in the rug blacklist
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Action detects token already blocked; returns success with 'already blocked' message; no duplicate entry
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicate blacklist entry created; redundant checks on every screening cycle; wasted compute
scenarios.prerequisites: Token already in rug blacklist

scenarios.description: Kelly calculator endpoint receives extreme inputs: win_rate=0.99, avg_win=1000%, avg_loss=1%
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Kelly formula handles extreme values; returns reasonable fraction (capped at 0.25 or similar max)
scenarios.failureMode: Kelly calculation returns >1.0 (bet 100%+); capital allocation exceeds available balance; bankroll risk
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard API server running

scenarios.description: ALLOWED_LIFECYCLE_CMDS receives 'restart' which is not in ['start', 'stop']
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Command validation rejects 'restart'; only 'start' and 'stop' are allowed lifecycle commands
scenarios.failureMode: 'restart' is executed as 'stop' then no automatic 'start'; bot stops permanently; user must manually start
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard API reachable

scenarios.description: Trash-wallets set operation replaces the entire list while concurrent screening reads the old list
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Atomic replacement ensures readers see either old list or new list; never a partial state
scenarios.failureMode: Non-atomic update; screening reads partially updated list; some trash wallets not filtered; scam tokens pass through
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard config update concurrent with screening cycle

scenarios.description: 2-second broadcast interval sends state updates to WebSocket clients even when nothing changed
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Broadcast should compare previous state hash; skip sending if state is identical; reduce bandwidth
scenarios.failureMode: Every 2s sends identical full state; bandwidth waste; client-side unnecessary re-renders
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard running; WebSocket connected

scenarios.description: readBotState reads vault-state.json but the file contains a corrupt JSON (e.g., truncated during write)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: JSON parse error is caught; vault state is returned as empty object; dashboard shows vault as empty
scenarios.failureMode: Uncaught JSON error crashes the read; entire state reading fails; dashboard shows no data for any section
scenarios.prerequisites: Corrupted vault-state.json

scenarios.description: tmp file from atomic write is left behind after a crash; subsequent atomic write finds the stale tmp
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Stale tmp file is overwritten; unique pid+timestamp suffix ensures no collision; tmp file is not read as source

scenarios.description: Express static file serving for / and /wizard paths when the HTML files are missing

scenarios.description: Strategy override set_bulk receives an empty overrides object

scenarios.description: Token-blacklist CRUD: remove operation with non-existent address
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Remove returns success but logs warning that address was not found; no error thrown

scenarios.description: Kill stale process via fuser but the stale process is actually the current process (PID reused)

scenarios.description: Set_strategy for position limits with a value that exceeds the maximum allowed exposure

scenarios.description: 23 ALLOWED_SLASH_CMDS are defined but one command has a typo making it unreachable via slash
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Command matching uses exact string; typo means command never matches; user gets 'unknown command'

scenarios.description: cookieParser middleware fails on malformed cookie from browser

scenarios.description: Dev-wallets CRUD: add operation with wallet address that has invalid base58

scenarios.description: Rapid config writes (10 writes in 1 second) cause tmp file buildup or filesystem churn

scenarios.description: execution-quality.json file is empty (0 bytes) after a failed write

scenarios.description: Config change via dashboard triggers config-writer to write but the bot mid-read from config.js sees partial state

scenarios.description: Dashboard starts but no WebSocket client connects for 30 minutes; broadcast interval keeps running
scenarios.expectedBehavior: No-op broadcasts with 0 clients are cheap; server runs normally; logs periodic 'no clients' message

scenarios.description: adaptiveSwap with multi-wallet DCA mode executes across 3 wallets; one wallet has insufficient SOL for gas

scenarios.description: Execute swap with split execution: 50% now, 50% later with random delay; the second half's delay exceeds the 90s tool timeout

scenarios.description: self_update executes git pull but the working directory has uncommitted changes

scenarios.description: self_update completes git pull and spawns restart, but the restart fails (port in use, config error)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Current process continues if restart fails; spawn error is logged; no service interruption

scenarios.description: Execution quality recording after swap when execution-quality.json is missing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Recording creates the file if missing; appends quality entry; no error thrown

scenarios.description: WithToolTimeout race: swap completes successfully but the timeout fires simultaneously

scenarios.description: swapToken dry_run=true mode: Jupiter quote API returns valid quote but price impact is 50%+

scenarios.description: Jupiter Ultra /execute endpoint returns status='Failed' after successful /order

scenarios.description: Jupiter order endpoint returns HTTP 429 rate limit but no retry logic exists
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 429 triggers exponential backoff retry (or error propagation); configurable retry count

scenarios.description: getJupiterPrice returns null for a valid mint because the mint is not in Jupiter's price feed
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns null; no crash; caller handles null gracefully with fallback price source
scenarios.failureMode: Null return propagates; caller does not handle null; bot uses null price in calculations; NaN PnL
scenarios.prerequisites: Valid mint not tracked by Jupiter price feed

scenarios.description: checkJupiterQuote with amountSol=0 results in 0 lamports quote request
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Zero amount is rejected by Jupiter API; function returns tradeable=false with appropriate error

scenarios.prerequisites: checkJupiterQuote called with 0 amount

scenarios.description: preSwapGuard with 15% price impact threshold: token has 14.9% impact (allowed) vs 15.1% (blocked)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Boundary condition is correct; 14.9% passes, 15.1% fails; no floating point precision issues

scenarios.description: Hot/cold rotation: wallet hits consecutive error threshold; rotated to cold; next active wallet also errors
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Multiple consecutive erroring wallets are rotated through; if all wallets error, all are marked cold; no infinite rotation

scenarios.description: capital_pct split across 3 wallets sums to 101% due to rounding errors

scenarios.description: Background recovery interval (60s) fires while the bot is in the middle of a swap
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Recovery checks are skipped or queued if bot is in critical operation; no concurrent modifications

scenarios.description: getActiveWallet called when no wallet is configured and WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY is not set

scenarios.description: Jito swap path: submitSwapBundle with 4 regions (fra, ny, ams, tyo); one region endpoint is down

scenarios.description: Percentile-based fee estimation with 0 recent transactions in sample

scenarios.failureMode: Tmp file is left behind; error not thrown; caller thinks write succeeded
