scenarios.description: withFileLock mutex per absolute path: two concurrent writes to different files do not block each other
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each file has independent mutex; concurrent writes to different files proceed in parallel
scenarios.failureMode: Global mutex serializes all writes; state.json and config.json writes block each other
scenarios.prerequisites: Concurrent writes to state.json and config.json

scenarios.description: pruneClosedPositions with maxAgeDays=7; position closed 8 days ago should be pruned
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Position closed 8 days ago is removed; state is saved; clean count incremented
scenarios.failureMode: Date comparison incorrect (e.g., using days instead of ms); position not pruned; state file grows
scenarios.prerequisites: Position closed 8+ days ago

scenarios.description: Deduplication by position_key+closed_at composite key fails when a position was closed and re-opened with same key
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Composite key ensures uniqueness; reopened position has different closed_at; both entries kept if open
scenarios.failureMode: Only position_key used for dedup; reopened position removes closed record; historical data lost
scenarios.prerequisites: Position reopened with same key after being closed

scenarios.description: Circuit breaker trips at BREAKER_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ERRORS=3 for a feature; third consecutive error disables it
scenarios.expectedBehavior: After third consecutive error, feature is disabled; subsequent calls return 'circuit open'; error is logged
scenarios.failureMode: Breaker trips at 2 errors (off-by-one); or never trips due to counter reset bug
scenarios.prerequisites: Feature hitting consecutive errors

scenarios.description: autoResetBreakers at maxAgeMs=10min: breaker tripped 9 min ago should NOT be reset
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Only breakers older than 10 minutes are reset; 9-min-old breaker stays open
scenarios.failureMode: 9-min-old breaker is reset prematurely; feature re-enabled while root cause still exists
scenarios.prerequisites: Breaker tripped 9 minutes ago

scenarios.description: getHealthReport computes error_rate_pct as 0/0 when no calls have been made to the feature
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns 0 for error_rate_pct; no division by zero; health report is valid
scenarios.failureMode: Division by zero; NaN propagates; health dashboard shows NaN% error rate
scenarios.prerequisites: Feature never called

scenarios.description: normalizeBooleanFlag receives unknown string 'maybe'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns false for unknown strings; only true for '1'/'true'/'yes'/'on'; false for '0'/'false'/'no'/'off'
scenarios.failureMode: Unknown string returns undefined; downstream truthy check treats undefined as false; ambiguous behavior
scenarios.prerequisites: runtime-mode.js loaded

scenarios.description: Devnet auto-detection via RPC URL containing 'devnet' while using Helius devnet endpoint
scenarios.expectedBehavior: RPC URL 'https://devnet.helius-rpc.com' contains 'devnet'; auto-detection sets DEMO mode; DRY_RUN becomes true
scenarios.failureMode: Substring check is case-sensitive and 'Devnet' (capitalized) not detected; live mode on devnet; wasted real fees
scenarios.prerequisites: Helius devnet RPC configured

scenarios.description: demoMode=true and dryRun=true both set; demoMode should imply dryRun regardless
scenarios.expectedBehavior: demoMode sets DRY_RUN=true; explicit dryRun=true is redundant but harmless
scenarios.failureMode: demoMode does not set DRY_RUN; demo bot executes real transactions; real SOL lost
scenarios.prerequisites: demoMode=true in configuration

scenarios.description: Cold start: RPC_URL check when no RPC is configured; state.json missing; file missing=warning behavior
scenarios.expectedBehavior: dataFileCheck for state.json returns warning status; cold start is detected; bot continues setup flow
scenarios.failureMode: Missing state.json is treated as error; bot refuses to start even on first run
scenarios.prerequisites: Fresh install; no RPC_URL, no state.json

scenarios.description: Insufficient data: rug memory with only 10 entries (threshold is 15); file exists but below threshold=error
scenarios.expectedBehavior: File exists (10 entries) but below threshold (15); returns error status; rug protection not fully active
scenarios.failureMode: File exists but below threshold reported as warning instead of error; rug protection insufficient
scenarios.prerequisites: rug memory with 10 entries; threshold=15
scenarios.fileRef: readiness.js:insufficient data check (24-40), rug memory threshold (30)

scenarios.description: assertOperationalReadiness throws in live mode when readiness checks fail
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Error is thrown with all failing check details; bot does not enter live trading without passing readiness
scenarios.failureMode: Warning-level failure does not throw; bot enters live mode with degraded capabilities
scenarios.prerequisites: Live mode; some readiness checks failing

scenarios.description: ConfirmMode readiness check when Telegram is not configured (no bot token, no chat ID)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ConfirmMode readiness fails; mode cannot be enabled without Telegram for sending confirm prompts
scenarios.failureMode: ConfirmMode enabled without Telegram; pending intents are created but never confirmed; positions stuck in limbo
scenarios.prerequisites: confirmMode enabled; Telegram not configured

scenarios.description: Regime memory check: threshold=5; only 3 regimes stored; file exists but insufficient
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns error status; insufficient regime memory for reliable regime-aware trading
scenarios.failureMode: Only checks file existence; 3 regimes accepted as sufficient; regime detection unreliable
scenarios.prerequisites: regime-memory.json with 3 entries

scenarios.description: 8 default features with weights summing to 1.17 (not normalized to 1.0); multi-criteria decision uses raw weights
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Weights are used as-is; total >1.0 means some decisions get disproportionate feature influence
scenarios.failureMode: Unnormalized weights cause decision bias; features with lower weights are never selected
scenarios.prerequisites: Feature registry loaded with default weights

scenarios.description: config.js loads a user-config.json with a key that has been deprecated but still present for backward compatibility
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Deprecated key is read but mapped to new config path; warning is logged; new config path takes precedence
scenarios.failureMode: Deprecated key overwrites new key; old config value used despite user setting new value
scenarios.prerequisites: user-config.json with deprecated key

scenarios.description: State file read: load() returns cached _stateCache; in-memory state and disk state diverge
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Cache is invalidated on save; reads always return latest state; consistency between memory and disk
scenarios.failureMode: Stale cache returns old data after external write; bot operates on outdated state; missed position close
scenarios.prerequisites: External process modified state.json while bot is running

scenarios.description: Token replay via timingSafeEqual: send a stolen token cookie from a different IP/network within the validity window
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Server validates token is valid; no IP-binding or session pinning is enforced, so replayed token is accepted
scenarios.failureMode: Stolen dashboard tokens can be replayed from any origin until expiry, enabling persistent unauthorized access
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker has captured a valid dashboard token (e.g. via XSS or network sniffing on same LAN)

scenarios.description: Token generated via randomBytes(32) without rotation policy; determine if long-lived sessions are possible
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Token is created once per session; no expiry or rotation mechanism is present
scenarios.failureMode: Sessions are effectively permanent — once authenticated, a token never expires unless the server restarts
scenarios.prerequisites: Victim authenticates to dashboard

scenarios.description: WebSocket broadcast contains full state including wallet private keys or seed phrases if present in state
scenarios.expectedBehavior: State is serialized and broadcast to all connected WebSocket clients every 2 seconds
scenarios.failureMode: If state contains sensitive key material, any WebSocket client (including unauthenticated connections) receives it
scenarios.prerequisites: State object includes wallet key material; WebSocket upgrade does not require auth token

scenarios.description: WebSocket connections are accepted without authentication; determine if WS upgrade path checks token
scenarios.expectedBehavior: WebSocket server accepts all upgrade requests without token challenge
scenarios.failureMode: Unauthenticated clients can subscribe to full bot state stream including positions, balances, and config
scenarios.prerequisites: Bot is running and dashboard server is listening

scenarios.description: Port conflict resolution uses fuser/lsof which can be tricked if attacker binds to the dashboard port first
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Server kills the process holding the port and binds; attacker-controlled process could be restarted continuously
scenarios.failureMode: A local attacker can cause repeated port conflicts, preventing dashboard from stabilizing
scenarios.prerequisites: Local user access on the same machine

scenarios.description: IPC command injection via writeAutomationCommand: attacker writes a crafted command to the JSON file that overrides lifecycle
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Commands are validated against ALLOWED_LIFECYCLE_CMDS before writing
scenarios.failureMode: If allowlist is missing entries or uses partial matching, arbitrary commands could be injected
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker gains filesystem write access to the IPC directory

scenarios.description: Slash commands validated against ALLOWED_SLASH_CMDS; determine if allowlist is comprehensive or can be bypassed
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Only predefined slash commands are accepted
scenarios.failureMode: Missing or incomplete allowlist entries could allow dangerous operations via slash commands
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker has dashboard access or can forge IPC file writes

scenarios.description: Telegram HTML messaging without explicit allowlist of HTML tags; xss in rendered messages
scenarios.expectedBehavior: htmlEscape is called on user-controlled content before sending
scenarios.failureMode: If htmlEscape is bypassed or incomplete, malicious HTML/JS could be rendered in Telegram clients
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker controls a token name, symbol, or other field that gets included in Telegram output

scenarios.description: Telegram long-polling for incoming commands without HMAC or sender verification
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All messages from configured chat are processed as commands
scenarios.failureMode: Anyone who gains access to the Telegram chat can send commands; no cryptographic sender verification
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker is a member of the Telegram group or compromises a group member's account

scenarios.description: Pilot mode capping in computeDeployAmount: verify pilot caps cannot be bypassed by negative or NaN values
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Deploy amount is capped by pilot limits
scenarios.failureMode: If input validation is missing for edge values (NaN, Infinity, negative), pilot caps could be bypassed
scenarios.prerequisites: User-config provides a deploy amount that passes through computeDeployAmount

scenarios.description: Tool timeout at 90s may allow long-running operations to complete after caller has abandoned them
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Promise.race rejects after 90s timeout; underlying operation is NOT aborted
scenarios.failureMode: Dangling operations (e.g. swap transactions) may complete asynchronously after timeout, causing unexpected state transitions
scenarios.prerequisites: Network latency or RPC congestion causes operation to exceed 90s

scenarios.description: Confirm-mode intercept for BUYs: determine if confirm dialog can be bypassed by race condition or rapid orders
scenarios.expectedBehavior: BUY transactions pause for human confirmation
scenarios.failureMode: Race condition between multiple rapid BUY orders could bypass confirm-mode gate
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple high-priority BUY triggers arrive simultaneously

scenarios.description: Safety checks run after balance verification but before swap; verify atomicity of check-then-act
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Balance check occurs and swap proceeds if sufficient
scenarios.failureMode: TOCTOU race: balance changes between check and swap execution, causing overspend or failed tx
scenarios.prerequisites: Concurrent operations modify wallet balance (e.g. vault sweep runs simultaneously)

scenarios.description: ProBuyDecision with 8 signals: determine if any single signal can dominate and bypass risk checks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All 8 signals are weighed; no single signal overrides others
scenarios.failureMode: A heavily weighted signal (e.g. regime confidence at 100%) could mask negative signals from other subsystems
scenarios.prerequisites: Market regime strongly favors one dimension while other risk metrics are negative

scenarios.description: PRO_THRESHOLDS for buy/sell/cutloss are hardcoded; determine if thresholds can be manipulated via config injection
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Thresholds are loaded from configuration and validated
scenarios.failureMode: If config injection is possible, thresholds could be set to 0 or negative values bypassing all gates
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker has write access to user-config.json or environment variables that override thresholds

scenarios.description: 7-component strategy readiness validation: determine if component scores can be inflated by crafted input
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each component has independent scoring logic with bounded output
scenarios.failureMode: If any component accepts unvalidated external input, scores could be artificially inflated
scenarios.prerequisites: External data source (e.g. market data API) feeds into component scoring

scenarios.description: KNOWN_SCAM_PATTERNS with multi-language (CN,RU,KR,ES): test for false positive via legitimate foreign terms matching scam patterns
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Pattern matching flags tokens with scam indicators
scenarios.failureMode: Legitimate foreign-language token names could match scam patterns, causing false-positive blocks
scenarios.prerequisites: Token name contains characters or phrases that overlap with scam keyword lists

scenarios.description: LEGITIMATE_PROJECTS hardcoded list for copycat detection: verify list is version-controlled and auditable
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Tokens matching known legitimate projects bypass certain trash checks
scenarios.failureMode: Stale or incomplete LEGITIMATE_PROJECTS list could allow copycats to bypass detection
scenarios.prerequisites: Copycat token uses name similar to a project not yet in the legitimate list

scenarios.description: RugCheck.xyz integration response parsing: test for SSRF or data injection via malicious API response
scenarios.expectedBehavior: API response is parsed as structured data with validation
scenarios.failureMode: If response is parsed without schema validation, malicious API responses could inject fake risk scores
scenarios.prerequisites: RugCheck.xyz API is compromised or returns crafted response

scenarios.description: WebSocket with exponential backoff 1-30s: test for reconnection storm if server rapidly connects/disconnects
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Backoff reduces reconnection frequency
scenarios.failureMode: If server-side closes connections rapidly (e.g. rate limiting), the backoff-reset logic could cause a reconnection storm
scenarios.prerequisites: Helius endpoint returns 429 or WebSocket rate limit errors

scenarios.description: API key redaction in logs: verify key pattern is consistently redacted across all log paths
scenarios.expectedBehavior: API keys are redacted in log output
scenarios.failureMode: If a new log path or error handler misses redaction, API keys leak to log files
scenarios.prerequisites: Error occurs in a code path not covered by the redaction regex

scenarios.description: DRY_RUN mode for vault sweep: verify dry-run cannot accidentally execute real transfers
scenarios.expectedBehavior: DRY_RUN skips actual transfer execution
scenarios.failureMode: If DRY_RUN flag is incorrectly evaluated (e.g. type coercion), real transfers could execute during dry-run mode
scenarios.prerequisites: vault sweep is triggered with DRY_RUN=true

scenarios.description: Profit-sweep transfer to external wallet: verify destination address validation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Destination address is validated before transfer
scenarios.failureMode: If destination validation is missing, funds could be sent to an invalid or attacker-controlled address
scenarios.prerequisites: Vault destination address is misconfigured or compromised

scenarios.description: File-locked state publishing: test for TOCTOU in file lock acquisition
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Lock prevents concurrent writes to state file
scenarios.failureMode: TOCTOU between lock check and lock acquisition could allow concurrent writes, corrupting state
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple processes or threads attempt to write state simultaneously

scenarios.description: Supervisor/automation command IPC: verify IPC channel is local-only and not exposed to network
scenarios.expectedBehavior: IPC commands are written to local filesystem, not network sockets
scenarios.failureMode: If IPC directory is shared (NFS, Docker volume mount), remote processes could inject commands
scenarios.prerequisites: Bot runs in environment with shared filesystem access

scenarios.description: ScoreDevReputation uses external data that could be manipulated via Sybil attacks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reputation score is computed from multiple data sources
scenarios.failureMode: If a single data source dominates, attacker could Sybil-farm reputation for malicious deployers
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker controls multiple test wallets or social accounts

scenarios.description: MarkDevCoinOutcome writes to persistent file; test for injection via malicious dev address
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Dev address is validated before writing to outcome tracking
scenarios.failureMode: If dev address is not sanitized, path traversal or injection into outcome file is possible
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker controls a token deployer address with crafted characters

scenarios.description: 17 narrative categories with keyword matching: test for regex injection via crafted token metadata
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Keywords are matched safely against predefined patterns
scenarios.failureMode: If keyword patterns are constructed dynamically from user input, regex injection is possible
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker controls token name or metadata that feeds into keyword pattern construction

scenarios.description: Cross-batch velocity tracking writes to persistent file; test for file corruption under concurrent access
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Velocity data is updated atomically
scenarios.failureMode: Concurrent narrative updates from multiple triggers could corrupt velocity tracking data
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple token screenings occur simultaneously

scenarios.description: 5 detection subsystems (GROUP,SOLO,CONFLICT,DISTRIBUTION,FOMO): test for algorithmic bias in scoring
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each subsystem produces independent scores
scenarios.failureMode: If any subsystem has algorithmic bias (e.g. flags all high-volume tokens as GROUP manipulation), cascade into false positives
scenarios.prerequisites: Token exhibits legitimate high trading volume from organic users

scenarios.description: 2s broadcast loop sends full state; determine if state object contains user-config.json secrets
scenarios.expectedBehavior: State is broadcast with all properties
scenarios.failureMode: Sensitive config values (API keys, wallet seed, RPC endpoints) may be exposed in state broadcast
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard is accessible on network; WebSocket client connects

scenarios.description: REST endpoints for status/config/command/toggle: determine if auth middleware is applied to all routes
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All routes require valid token via cookie or header
scenarios.failureMode: If any route is missing auth middleware, unauthenticated access to sensitive operations is possible
scenarios.prerequisites: A new route is added without auth middleware; or existing route has conditional auth

scenarios.description: CRUD endpoints for trash-wallets, smart/dev/token-blacklist: test for mass assignment or unauthorized modification
scenarios.expectedBehavior: CRUD operations check authorization before modifying data
scenarios.failureMode: If authorization is checked only at route level (not operation level), a user could modify lists they shouldn't
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple user roles or access levels exist for list management

scenarios.description: ANSI/CTRL character stripping in sanitizeLogText: test for bypass via Unicode control characters
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Control characters are stripped from log text
scenarios.failureMode: If regex only covers ASCII control characters, Unicode control characters (e.g. Unicode reverse) could bypass sanitization
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker injects Unicode control characters in token metadata that gets logged

scenarios.description: Telegram error notification sends logs to external service; test for log content leakage
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Error logs are sent to Telegram for operator awareness
scenarios.failureMode: If error messages include sensitive data (keys, balances, addresses), Telegram becomes a data leak channel
scenarios.prerequisites: Error occurs in a context with sensitive data in scope

scenarios.description: toolMap routing determines which execution path is used; test for path traversal in tool name resolution
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Tool names are matched against a predefined map
scenarios.failureMode: If tool name is partially user-controlled, an attacker could route execution to an unexpected handler
scenarios.prerequisites: Tool name is derived from external input (e.g. strategy output)

scenarios.description: ProSellDecision with 5 signals: test for sell-decision lockup if all signals return undefined/NaN
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Sell decision is reached via signal aggregation
scenarios.failureMode: If all signals return undefined or NaN, aggregation could produce unexpected sell behavior (never sell or always sell)
scenarios.prerequisites: Market data feeds are temporarily unavailable or return malformed data

scenarios.description: ProCutlossDecision: test for infinite loop or recursive evaluation if price keeps dropping
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Cutloss decision is reached and position is closed
scenarios.failureMode: If cutloss logic re-evaluates without state checkpoint, a rapidly dropping price could cause infinite re-evaluation
scenarios.prerequisites: Token price drops rapidly, triggering repeated cutloss evaluation

scenarios.description: Helius API key in WebSocket URL construction: verify key is not exposed in URL logs or error messages
scenarios.expectedBehavior: API key is sent as query parameter but redacted in logs
scenarios.failureMode: If connection error includes full URL in stack trace or error message, API key leaks
scenarios.prerequisites: WebSocket connection fails with error that echoes the connection URL

scenarios.description: reloadScreeningThresholds hot-reload: test for race condition where thresholds are partially updated during evaluation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Thresholds are updated atomically
scenarios.failureMode: If config reload is not atomic, a screening evaluation could read a mix of old and new thresholds
scenarios.prerequisites: Config reload occurs simultaneously with token screening evaluation

scenarios.description: getExitSlippage with progressive slippage: test for slippage exceeding configured maximums
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Slippage is bounded by configuration maximum
scenarios.failureMode: If progressive slippage calculation exceeds configured max without clamping, trades may execute at extreme slippage
scenarios.prerequisites: Volatile market conditions cause progressive slippage to increase

scenarios.description: File locking for cooldown state: test for deadlock if multiple tokens are evaluated simultaneously
scenarios.expectedBehavior: File lock is acquired, state read/modified/written, lock released
scenarios.failureMode: If file lock is not released on error, all subsequent cooldown checks deadlock
scenarios.prerequisites: Error occurs during cooldown file write, leaving lock acquired

scenarios.description: scanRefundableTokenAccounts: test for excessive RPC calls causing rate limit or resource exhaustion
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Scans token accounts and computes refundable rent
scenarios.failureMode: If scanning does not batch or limit RPC calls, Helius rate limits could block other bot operations
scenarios.prerequisites: Wallet holds many token accounts (100+)

scenarios.description: recordLossAnalysis writes to persistent file; test for malicious input in loss analysis data
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Loss data is sanitized before storage
scenarios.failureMode: If loss analysis includes unsanitized market data fields, injection into learning records is possible
scenarios.prerequisites: Malicious token metadata is captured in loss analysis

scenarios.description: recordObservations stores patterns from market data; test for adversarial pattern poisoning
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Observations are recorded faithfully from market data
scenarios.failureMode: Attacker can craft token behavior that produces misleading observation patterns, poisoning the learning model
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker controls tokens that the bot screens and observes

scenarios.description: pruneConvictionMemory and related functions write to persistent files; test for deletion of wrong entries via path traversal
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Pruning targets specific records by validation criteria
scenarios.failureMode: If record identifiers are not validated, path traversal could delete unintended data files
scenarios.prerequisites: Record identifier contains path traversal characters

scenarios.description: attachExitMonitor checks priceDrop; test for false triggers from micro-dust or flash crashes
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Exit monitor triggers only on sustained price drops
scenarios.failureMode: If threshold is too sensitive, micro-dust or brief flash crashes could trigger false exits
scenarios.prerequisites: Token experiences normal volatility near the exit threshold

scenarios.description: Kelly/VaR/CVaR/drawdown calculations: test for division by zero or NaN propagation in risk calculations
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Risk metrics are computed with guard rails for edge cases
scenarios.failureMode: If input validation is missing, division by zero or NaN values could cascade into all dependent systems
scenarios.prerequisites: Market data with zero volatility or undefined price movement

scenarios.description: simulateTrade through strategy.js exit logic: test for infinite loop if exit condition never triggers
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Simulation completes within bounded iterations
scenarios.failureMode: If exit condition is never met, simulation could loop indefinitely consuming CPU
scenarios.prerequisites: Price sequence never triggers exit criteria in backtest

scenarios.description: Environment variable overrides loaded from user-config.json; test for prototype pollution via config JSON
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Config values are assigned to env object safely
scenarios.failureMode: If JSON.parse is used without prototype pollution protection, __proto__ payloads could pollute global state
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker can modify user-config.json content

scenarios.description: Cookie+header auth: verify both must be present; test for bypass by providing only one
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Both cookie and header must match for authentication
scenarios.failureMode: If auth logic uses OR instead of AND, providing only one factor could bypass auth
scenarios.prerequisites: Attacker has either cookie or header but not both

scenarios.description: user-config.json loads sensitive values (RPC keys, wallet configs); test for file permissions exposure
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Config file is loaded from predictable path
scenarios.failureMode: If file permissions are too permissive (644+), other processes/users on the machine can read sensitive config
scenarios.prerequisites: Shared hosting or multi-user environment

scenarios.description: logAction logs all trade operations; test for sensitive data in trade action logs
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Trade actions are logged with relevant details
scenarios.failureMode: If full transaction data including keys or signatures is logged, persistent log files become a data leak vector
scenarios.prerequisites: Trade action includes verbose debug data in log output

scenarios.description: filterPreyAdvanced 5-step pipeline: test for short-circuit logic allowing bypass of later steps
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All 5 pipeline stages execute sequentially
scenarios.failureMode: If early stage returns 'pass' without executing later stages, tokens skip critical validation
scenarios.prerequisites: Pipeline implements early-return optimization that skips remaining stages

scenarios.description: DexScreener API response parsing; test for prototype pollution in deeply nested response objects
scenarios.expectedBehavior: API response is parsed into structured data
scenarios.failureMode: If JSON.parse is used without depth limiting, deeply nested or __proto__ payloads could pollute objects
scenarios.prerequisites: DexScreener API returns crafted payload with prototype pollution attempt

scenarios.description: Jupiter quote/swap API integration; test for insufficient response validation allowing malicious quote manipulation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Quote response is validated before swap execution
scenarios.failureMode: If quote validation is minimal, a man-in-the-middle could modify quote parameters leading to unfavorable swap

scenarios.description: Wallet discovery scans on-chain; test for excessive RPC usage causing rate limit cascade
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Wallet discovery respects rate limits
scenarios.failureMode: If discovery scans too aggressively, Helius rate limits block critical path operations (swap, screening)
scenarios.prerequisites: Large wallet discovery scan is triggered

scenarios.description: Devnet faucet requests; test for abuse if production mode accidentally uses devnet endpoint
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Devnet tools are isolated from production paths
scenarios.failureMode: If mode detection fails, production bot could request from devnet faucet or vice versa
scenarios.prerequisites: Runtime mode detection returns incorrect environment

scenarios.description: Kill switch mechanism; test for false triggers or inability to disarm once triggered
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Kill switch stops all trading and can be disarmed
scenarios.failureMode: If kill switch disarming is not implemented, all trading stops permanently until manual intervention

scenarios.description: Readiness check probes all subsystems; test for information disclosure via readiness endpoint
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Readiness endpoint returns pass/fail for each subsystem

scenarios.description: Dashboard sends lifecycle command via writeDashboardCmd; verify command-writer correctly parses and routes to automation-control

scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard sends any lifecycle command (start, stop, pause, resume)

scenarios.description: Pro-orchestrator buy decision triggers executor.adaptiveSwap; verify the full decision-to-execution pipeline
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Buy decision parameters (token, amount, slippage) are correctly passed to executor
scenarios.failureMode: Parameter mapping mismatch (field names, types, units) causes incorrect swap parameters
scenarios.prerequisites: Pro-orchestrator reaches buy decision with populated signal data

scenarios.description: Executor calls Jupiter quote then swap; verify quote parameters match swap execution
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Quote output (route, amountOut) is passed faithfully to swap function
scenarios.failureMode: Quote-to-swap parameter drift causes slippage violations or failed transactions
scenarios.prerequisites: Executor processes a buy or sell order through Jupiter

scenarios.description: Geyser stream events trigger exit monitor; verify account update parsing correctly routes to monitoring

scenarios.description: Trash-layer passes token through community detector; verify screening results are correctly merged
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Community detector scores are folded into final filter decision
scenarios.failureMode: Score normalization mismatch (0-1 vs 0-100 scale) causes incorrect filtering decisions
scenarios.prerequisites: Token passes basic trash checks and enters community assessment

scenarios.description: Community detector feeds trade data into cabal play analysis; verify data pipeline integrity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Trade history is passed to cabal analyzer for manipulation detection
scenarios.failureMode: Data format mismatch (aggregated vs raw trades) causes incorrect cabal score
scenarios.prerequisites: Token has trade history available for analysis

scenarios.description: Config hot-reload propagates to all dependent modules; verify modules pick up new values without restart
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Modules re-read config values on next access after reload

scenarios.description: System clock jumps forward or backward (NTP sync, daylight saving, VM pause/resume)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Time-dependent operations use monotonic clock or handle negative intervals
scenarios.failureMode: Clock jump causes cooldown calculations to expire early (jump forward) or never expire (jump back)
scenarios.prerequisites: System clock is adjusted by NTP or VM management

scenarios.description: Executor has no circuit breaker for repeated Jupiter API failures (missing resilience pattern)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Multiple consecutive API failures should trigger circuit breaker to prevent waste
scenarios.failureMode: Bot keeps attempting swaps despite API failure, wasting transaction fees and timeout delays
scenarios.prerequisites: Jupiter API is intermittently failing

scenarios.description: Dashboard has no rate limiting per IP (missing rate limiter middleware)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: API endpoints should rate-limit requests per client IP
scenarios.failureMode: Single client can flood API with requests, degrading dashboard performance for others
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard is exposed on network

scenarios.description: Dashboard has no CORS configuration (missing cors middleware)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: CORS should restrict which origins can access dashboard
scenarios.failureMode: Any website can make cross-origin requests to the bot dashboard API
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard is accessible from browser contexts

scenarios.description: No session management or token revocation endpoint exists (missing session lifecycle)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Sessions should be manageable: list active sessions, revoke specific tokens
scenarios.failureMode: Once a token is compromised, no way to revoke it without server restart
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard token is compromised

scenarios.description: WebSocket has no per-message rate limiting (missing WS rate limiter)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: WebSocket messages should be rate-limited per client
scenarios.failureMode: Malicious client can flood the broadcast loop with messages, starving legitimate connections
scenarios.prerequisites: WebSocket connection is established by a malicious client

scenarios.description: API routes have no request body size validation (missing payload size limit)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Request bodies should be limited to reasonable sizes
scenarios.failureMode: Attacker sends multi-megabyte JSON payload causing OOM or slow parsing
scenarios.prerequisites: Express body parser has no size limit configured

scenarios.description: No HMAC or cryptographic verification of Telegram commands (missing command auth)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Telegram commands should be cryptographically verified
scenarios.failureMode: Any group member can send commands; bot cannot distinguish operator from attacker
scenarios.prerequisites: Bot is in a Telegram group with multiple members

scenarios.description: No config schema validation at startup (missing config validator)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Config should be validated against a schema at startup
scenarios.failureMode: Invalid config values pass silently, causing unpredictable runtime behavior
scenarios.prerequisites: User provides invalid config values or types

scenarios.description: No audit log for config changes (missing config audit trail)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All config changes should be logged with timestamp and previous value
scenarios.failureMode: Cannot determine what config changed or when, making debugging difficult
scenarios.prerequisites: Config is changed and causes behavioral change

scenarios.description: No transaction simulation before swap execution (missing tx simulation)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Transactions should be simulated locally before submission to verify success probability
scenarios.failureMode: Transaction submitted without simulation fails on-chain, wasting fee
scenarios.prerequisites: Swap transaction conditions are marginal

scenarios.description: No mempool monitoring for executed transactions (missing tx confirmation tracking)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Submitted transactions should be monitored in mempool for confirmation status
scenarios.failureMode: Bot assumes transaction failed and retries, but original tx confirms later (duplicate trade)
scenarios.prerequisites: Network congestion delays transaction confirmation

scenarios.description: No portfolio-level risk check before buy decision (missing portfolio correlation check)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Buy decisions should consider existing portfolio correlation
scenarios.failureMode: Bot accumulates correlated positions that amplify portfolio volatility
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple correlated meme tokens are identified simultaneously

scenarios.description: No daily loss limit or circuit breaker for consecutive losses
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Trading should halt after N consecutive losses in a day
scenarios.failureMode: Bot continues trading after multiple losses, potentially losing more capital
scenarios.prerequisites: Market conditions cause streak of losing trades

scenarios.description: No cache for RugCheck results (missing response cache)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: RugCheck results for the same token should be cached with TTL
scenarios.failureMode: Same token is checked against RugCheck multiple times, wasting API quota
scenarios.prerequisites: Same token appears in multiple screening cycles

scenarios.description: No health check endpoint for WebSocket connection status (missing WS health probe)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: There should be a way to query Geyser connection status
scenarios.failureMode: Cannot determine if Geyser WebSocket is connected without reading logs
scenarios.prerequisites: Geyser connection status is needed for operational monitoring

scenarios.description: No connection pool or fallback to secondary RPC endpoint (missing RPC failover)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Geyser should have secondary connection endpoint for failover
scenarios.failureMode: Single RPC endpoint failure causes complete loss of on-chain data stream
scenarios.prerequisites: Primary Helius endpoint becomes unavailable

scenarios.description: No maximum sweep amount safety cap (missing vault limit)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Vault sweep should have a configurable maximum per transfer
scenarios.failureMode: Single vault transfer could drain wallet in one transaction if configured incorrectly
scenarios.prerequisites: Vault sweep is configured with aggressive settings

scenarios.description: No automation state backup before modification (missing state backup)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Previous state should be backed up before overwriting
scenarios.failureMode: Corrupted state file written during automation control update, losing configuration
scenarios.prerequisites: Power loss or crash occurs during state write

scenarios.description: No feedback loop to verify learning recommendations actually improve performance (missing validation)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Learning recommendations should be tracked and validated against outcomes
scenarios.failureMode: Bot learns and reinforces patterns that do not actually improve trading results
scenarios.prerequisites: Learning system has been operating long enough to accumulate patterns

scenarios.description: No data quality scoring for observations (missing quality filter)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Observations should be scored for quality before being used for learning
scenarios.failureMode: Low-quality or misleading observations pollute the learning model
scenarios.prerequisites: Market noise produces observation-like data

scenarios.description: No maintenance scheduling preview or dry-run mode (missing dry-run maintenance)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Maintenance should offer dry-run mode to preview what will be removed
scenarios.failureMode: Maintenance removes data operator intended to keep; no undo capability
scenarios.prerequisites: Operator runs maintenance without understanding what will be pruned

scenarios.description: No community detection confidence threshold configuration (missing threshold config)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Community detection thresholds should be configurable per deployment
scenarios.failureMode: Hardcoded thresholds may be too strict or too lenient for specific market conditions
scenarios.prerequisites: Community detection needs tuning for current market

scenarios.description: No narrative decay function for stale narratives (missing narrative decay)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Narratives that have not been active should decay in importance over time
scenarios.failureMode: Old narratives retain full weight, potentially causing stale trading signals
scenarios.prerequisites: Narrative has been inactive for extended period but still in heat tracking

scenarios.description: No cabal play score threshold for automatic alerting (missing alert integration)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: High cabal scores should trigger alerts via Telegram or dashboard
scenarios.failureMode: Manipulation detected but operator is not notified
scenarios.prerequisites: Cabal activity is detected with high confidence score

scenarios.description: No trailing stop-loss logic (only fixed percentage drops monitored)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Exit monitoring should support trailing stop-loss in addition to fixed drop check
scenarios.failureMode: Trailing stop-loss logic missing; profits are not protected as price rises
scenarios.prerequisites: Token price rises significantly then retraces partially

scenarios.description: No fallback if neural-trader npm package fails to load or is not installed (missing graceful degradation)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Risk module should fall back to simple heuristic risk if neural package unavailable
scenarios.failureMode: Risk evaluation fails entirely, blocking all trading decisions that depend on it
scenarios.prerequisites: neural-trader package is not installed or fails to load

scenarios.description: No backtest result comparison against actual live results (missing backtest validation)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Backtest predictions should be compared to live results to validate simulation accuracy
scenarios.failureMode: Cannot measure how accurately backtest simulates real trading conditions
scenarios.prerequisites: Live trades have been executed that were previously backtested

scenarios.description: No slippage configuration per DEX or routing path (missing per-DEX slippage config)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Slippage configuration should be customizable per liquidity source
scenarios.failureMode: Uniform slippage across all DEXes may be too tight for low-liquidity venues
scenarios.prerequisites: Jupiter routes trade through multiple DEX targets with different liquidity profiles

scenarios.description: No per-token cooldown override capability (missing manual override)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Operator should be able to override cooldown for specific tokens
scenarios.failureMode: Operator cannot re-enter a position even when new information warrants
scenarios.prerequisites: Operator identifies a token on cooldown that should be re-evaluated

scenarios.description: No automatic re-scan after rent refund execution (missing verification loop)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: After refund execution, accounts should be re-scanned to verify closure
scenarios.failureMode: Refund process claims success but accounts remain open; no verification
scenarios.prerequisites: Rent refund transaction succeeds but accounts are not actually closed

scenarios.description: No readiness dependency graph (missing dependency-aware readiness)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Readiness should reflect dependency health: if Geyser is down, dependent modules are degraded
scenarios.failureMode: Readiness reports healthy even when critical dependencies are unavailable
scenarios.prerequisites: Geyser connection fails but other modules initialize

scenarios.description: No kill switch test mode (missing test trigger for kill switch)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Kill switch should support a test mode that validates the mechanism without stopping trading
scenarios.failureMode: Cannot verify kill switch works without actually triggering it
scenarios.prerequisites: Operator wants to validate kill switch functionality

scenarios.description: No state file checksum or integrity verification (missing state integrity)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: State files should include checksum to detect corruption
scenarios.failureMode: Corrupted state file is loaded silently, causing incorrect bot behavior
scenarios.prerequisites: State file is partially corrupted by filesystem error or incomplete write

scenarios.description: No state pruning rollback capability (missing pruning undo)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Pruned state data should be archived before deletion
scenarios.failureMode: Critical state data pruned unintentionally; no recovery option
scenarios.prerequisites: State pruner removes entries that were still needed

scenarios.description: No metrics export to external monitoring system (missing metrics integration)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Metrics should support export to Prometheus, Grafana, or similar
scenarios.failureMode: Performance and trading metrics only available via dashboard; no historical trend analysis
scenarios.prerequisites: Operator wants long-term metrics tracking and visualization

scenarios.description: Dashboard has no HTTPS support (missing TLS configuration)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Dashboard should support HTTPS for encrypted communication
scenarios.failureMode: All dashboard traffic, including auth tokens, transmitted in plaintext over network
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard is accessed over network (not localhost only)

scenarios.description: Dashboard has no Content Security Policy headers (missing CSP)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: HTTP responses should include CSP headers to prevent XSS
scenarios.failureMode: XSS vulnerability in dashboard could be exploited without CSP mitigation
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard serves user-controlled content in any field

scenarios.description: No priority fee estimation for transaction confirmation (missing dynamic fee)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Transaction fees should be dynamically estimated based on network conditions
scenarios.failureMode: Static fee may be too low during congestion (tx stuck) or too high (wasted SOL)
scenarios.prerequisites: Solana network is congested

scenarios.description: No transaction retry with different parameters on failure (missing smart retry)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Failed transactions should be retried with adjusted parameters (slippage, fee)
scenarios.failureMode: First failure is final; potentially executable trade is abandoned
scenarios.prerequisites: Transaction fails due to slippage or fee conditions, not fundamental error

scenarios.description: No end-to-end integration test suite validating full pipeline from screening to trade to exit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: There should be integration tests covering the full trade lifecycle
scenarios.failureMode: Cannot validate full pipeline behavior; regressions go undetected until production
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple modules are modified across different development cycles
